en: 11D43. Original RD-253 as used on the UR-500. testedBurnTime=450

1961 proposed design for a manned spacecraft to take humans to the moon, but passed over in favour of the familiar Apollo CSM. Remarkably similar to the later Soyuz in design, the D-2 consists of a propulsion module, descent capsule, and a detachable mission module, providing efficient use of space and capability for a wide range of missions, including circumlunar flights. Supports a crew of three for up to maximum 14 days of active operations but it will require fuel cells. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall. THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 1961 年提出的载人飞船方案，用于把人送上月球，但最终被熟悉的 Apollo CSM 方案取代。D-2 在设计上与此后的联盟号惊人相似，由推进舱、下降舱和一个可分离的任务舱组成，空间利用率高，可执行包括绕月飞行在内的多种任务。可支持 3 名乘员最多 14 天的主动运行，但需要燃料电池。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s), is lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes the boosters are dropped and Atlas continues to orbit under the power of the LR105 (with the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for better performance. As a sustainer, the LR105 has sea level and vacuum efficiencies somewhere between a booster and an upper stage engine. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （RO 已弃用） 用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油液氧燃气发生器主级发动机。它与宇宙神的助推发动机（LR89）一样在地面点火，但两分钟多一点后助推器被抛掉，宇宙神靠 LR105 的推力继续飞向轨道（游动发动机负责滚转控制与末段调整）。LR105 的最终构型（与 LR89 一样）采用 RS-27 部件以获得更好性能。作为主级发动机，LR105 的海平面与真空效率介于助推级与上面级发动机之间。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able, Thor-Agena, Thor-Delta, and Delta. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （RO 已弃用） 泵压或挤压式煤油液氧游动发动机。用于宇宙神上的 MA-x 系统（2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101），以及雷神-Able、雷神-Agena、雷神-Delta 与 Delta 上的 MB-x 系统（LR79 或 RS-27 + 2xLR101）的姿态控制与末速修正。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A retractable, short range parabolic antenna for high speed telecommunications. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 可收放的短程抛物面天线，用于高速通信。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A simple RF receiver and time-delay circuit for sounding rockets. Allows staging and for information to be reported, but no yaw/pitch/roll control. [0.380m diameter] From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 用于探空火箭的简易射频接收机与延时电路。可分级并回传信息，但没有偏航/俯仰/滚转控制。[直径 0.380 m] 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A simple RF receiver and time-delay circuit for sounding rockets. Allows staging and for information to be reported, but no yaw/pitch/roll control. [0.3m diameter] From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 用于探空火箭的简易射频接收机与延时电路。可分级并回传信息，但没有偏航/俯仰/滚转控制。[直径 0.3 m] 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) A small (0.5m) satellite designed to study the variation in solar X-ray radiation. From SXT mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 一颗小型（0.5 m）卫星，用于研究太阳 X 射线辐射的变化。 来自 SXT mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) Apollo Ascent Module. Contains two astronauts. From SXT mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 阿波罗上升舱。可载两名航天员。 来自 SXT mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) Beginning its life as the etholox-powered XLR43-NA-3, this was the first US engine to use tubular-wall construction for its combustion chamber. It served as the basis for early orbital US engines, with its lineage stretching to the 21st century. The LR43 was converted to run on kerosene for Atlas and was later renamed LR89, and the LR79 derivative powered Thor. Later LR89s used RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （RO 已弃用） 它最初是烧乙醇液氧的 XLR43-NA-3，是第一台采用管束壁燃烧室的美国发动机。它成为美国早期入轨发动机的基础，其血脉一直延续到 21 世纪。LR43 改为烧煤油以用于宇宙神，随后更名为 LR89；其衍生型 LR79 则为雷神提供动力。后期 LR89 采用 RS-27 部件以提高效率，而当时 RS-27 本身已用于 Delta。由于底层是同一台发动机，LR89 各构型与同时代 -79 构型的性能相当。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) Deprecated, do not use From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （RO 已弃用） 已弃用，请勿使用 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) Gemini retro solid derived from the Star 13 orbit insertion motor. Place in 4x symmetry in the gaps of the retro module cruciform. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 由 Star 13 入轨发动机派生的 Gemini 反推固体发动机。以 4 重对称安装在反推段的十字形空隙中。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) Please do not use this part, it will be removed in the future. From ROCapsules mod
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 请勿使用此部件，它将在未来版本中移除。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) The vernier engine for the RD-0110 power plant. Four of them are used on the Block I upper stage of the Soyuz U and FG launch vehicle variants for attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （RO 已弃用） RD-0110 动力装置的游动发动机。联盟 U 与 FG 运载器变型的 Block I 上面级各用四台，用于姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) This part contains four way RCS thrusters to help orient the Mercury capsule and the main parachute. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 此部件装有四向 RCS 推力器，用于帮助调整 Mercury 座舱与主降落伞的姿态。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: (DEPRECATED BY RO) This part contains fuel for landing, experiments, and importantly legs to set down softly. From SXT mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: （已被 RO 弃用） 该部件内含着陆用燃料、实验设备，以及至关重要的——用于软着陆的支腿。 来自 SXT mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Not intended to hold fuel and far heavier and more expensive than standard fuel tanks, these specialized tanks are for batteries, payloads and life support. There are different levels of service modules that you can unlock. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. These are the only types of tanks that can have life support resources added to them. From ROTanks mod
zh: 不用于贮存燃料，这类专用贮箱比标准燃料贮箱重得多、也贵得多，用于电池、载荷与生命保障。可解锁不同等级的服务舱。每种贮箱类型的基准质量、造价与可用利用率各不相同。只有这类贮箱才能添加生命保障资源。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: Not intended to hold fuel and far heavier and more expensive than standard fuel tanks, these specialized tanks are for batteries, payloads and life support. There are different levels of service modules that you can unlock. Each tank type has a different base mass, different cost, and different amounts of utilization it can have. These are the only types of tanks that can have life support resources added to them. From RealFuels mod
zh: 不用于装载燃料，且比标准燃料罐重得多、贵得多；这类专用罐体用于电池、载荷和生保系统。可解锁不同等级的服务舱。每种罐体的基础质量、成本和可支持的利用率各不相同。只有这类罐体才能加装生保资源。 来自 RealFuels mod

en: FPS: # | Frame Time: # ms | Jitter (p#−p#): # ms | Heap growth estimate: # KB/f
zh: 帧率： # | 帧耗时： # ms | 抖动（p#−p#）： # ms | 堆增长估计： # KB/f
状态： [已过期 - 插件离线 / 未在飞行]

en: A 1970s low TWR staged combustion hydrolox upper stage engine intended for use on the N1/N1M. A later version designated RD-57M had an extendable nozzle and was intended for the Vulkan and Energia-M rockets. The engine was marketed by Aerojet in the 1990s under the designation D-57 for use on an SSTO demonstrator. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款 1970 年代的低推重比分级燃烧氢氧上面级发动机，拟用于 N1/N1M。后一型号 RD-57M 采用可延伸喷管，拟用于火山号与能源-M 火箭。1990 年代该发动机由 Aerojet 以 D-57 的型号营销，用于一款单级入轨验证机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 1970s low-TWR vacuum engine, the NERVA (Nuclear Engine for Rocket Vehicle Applications) is designed for orbital tugs and large rocket upper stages. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1970 年代的低推重比真空发动机，NERVA（核发动机火箭飞行器应用计划）为轨道拖船与大型火箭上面级设计。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 1980s afterburning turbofan, designed for the Yak-41. It was equipped with an engine gimbal system that allowed the nozzle to rotate 95 degrees, to support vertical flight, and was the first engine of this type equipped with an afterburner, allowing the Yak-41 to achieve supersonic flight. It powered the Yak-141/41, and was proposed to power the Su-47 with the thrust vectoring system removed. From SXT (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1980 年代为雅克-41 研制的加力涡扇发动机。它装有发动机万向系统，可使喷管转动 95 度以支持垂直飞行；它也是同类发动机中第一台装加力燃烧室的，使雅克-41 得以超声速飞行。它驱动了雅克-141/41，并曾被提议在拆除推力矢量系统后用于苏-47。 来自 SXT (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 1980s medium TWR engine for atmospheric and vacuum use. The RD-0120 is a fuel-rich staged combustion engine developed to power the core stage of the Energia launcher. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1980 年代的中推重比发动机，可在大气层内与真空中工作。RD-0120 是富燃分级燃烧发动机，为能源号运载火箭的芯级提供动力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 1990s atmospheric engine using technology developed for the Space Shuttle SSME, the RS-68 is a single-use engine. It features a simplified design with fewer parts and an easier construction and uses exhaust from the gas generator for roll control. The RS-68 powers the Delta IV launch vehicle family and is the most powerful LH2/LOX engine ever flown. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RS-68 是一款 1990 年代的大气层发动机，采用了为航天飞机 SSME 研制的技术，属于一次性使用发动机。它设计简化、零件更少、更易制造，并利用燃气发生器的排气做滚转控制。RS-68 为德尔塔 IV 运载火箭系列提供动力，是史上推力最大的液氢/液氧发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 2.5m high section for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the tower sections to the top of the base. This section has multiple detail options, with the side panels, platforms, front poles and back detail all swichable among various settings. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔2号式服务塔模块化版本的2.5米高节段。塔架节段可拼接到基座顶部。该节段有多种细节选项，侧板、平台、前立柱与背部细节均可切换多种设置。提供8种配色。请搭配通用脐带、摆臂以及小型脐带使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A 2000s medium TWR vacuum engine, the J-2X was intended to be used on the upper stages of Ares I and Ares V. Development continued after the cancellation of Ares, and early designs of SLS incorporated the engine, but the project was mothballed after the RL10-powered Exploration Upper Stage was selected. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 2000 年代的中推重比真空发动机，J-2X 原拟用于阿瑞斯 I 与阿瑞斯 V 的上面级。阿瑞斯取消后研制仍在继续，SLS 的早期设计也纳入了该发动机，但在选用以 RL10 为动力的探索上面级后，项目被封存。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 225 N hydrazine thruster, used on all Ranger and early Mariner spacecraft for midcourse corrections. Since reliable hydrazine catalysts had not yet been developed, the engines were only capable of two starts. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 225 N 肼推力器，用于所有游骑兵号与早期水手号航天器的中途修正。由于当时尚未研制出可靠的肼催化剂，这些发动机只能启动两次。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 2m high core section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach the mast core sections to the top of the base. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas V斜置式服务桅杆模块化版本的2米高核心段。桅杆核心段可拼接到基座顶部。提供8种配色。请搭配通用脐带、摆臂以及小型脐带使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A 4.5kW fuel cell. Consumes about 245 liters of LH2 and 175 liters of LOX per week. These figures were determined by ground tests and include boil-off. The actual hydrogen boil-off rate may be considerably higher depending on the situation and the surface to volume ratio of your storage tanks. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 4.5 kW 燃料电池。每周约消耗 245 升液氢与 175 升液氧。这些数字来自地面试验，并已计入蒸发损失。实际的氢蒸发率可能高得多，取决于具体情况与贮箱的表面积体积比。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A 490 N bipropellant thruster found in the propulsion system of the ESA ATV and the Orion MPCV Service Module. It performs orbit-raising maneuvers for many communication satellite platforms, including the Astrium Eurostar 3000, Boeing Space Systems 702HP, MELCO DS-2000, and the Loral LS-1300. The R-4D has also played a role in NASA missions, such as Cassini's orbital insertion around Saturn. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款 490 N 双组元推力器，见于 ESA 的 ATV 与猎户座 MPCV 服务舱的推进系统。它为许多通信卫星平台执行升轨机动，包括 Astrium Eurostar 3000、Boeing Space Systems 702HP、MELCO DS-2000 与 Loral LS-1300。R-4D 也在 NASA 的任务中发挥作用，例如卡西尼号在土星附近的轨道插入。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A 750W fuel cell. Consumes about 41 liters of LH2 and 29 liters of LOX per week. These figures were determined by ground tests and include boil-off. The actual hydrogen boil-off rate may be considerably higher depending on the situation and the surface to volume ratio of your storage tanks. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 750 W 燃料电池。每周约消耗 41 升液氢与 29 升液氧。这些数字来自地面试验，并已计入蒸发损失。实际的氢蒸发率可能高得多，取决于具体情况与贮箱的表面积体积比。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A British kerolox booster engine for the Blue Streak missile and the first stage of the Europa launch vehicle. It was derived from the Rocketdyne S-3, with minor modifications. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款英国煤油液氧助推发动机，用于蓝光导弹与欧罗巴运载火箭的第一级。它由洛克达因 S-3 衍生而来，仅有少量修改。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Cubic Octagonal Strut that's even longer! Use multiple struts no longer! With these ultra-light extensions, you can now strut all the things! From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 更长的立方八边形支杆！不必再搭多根了！有了这些超轻延长件，万物皆可支杆！ 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A German pressure-fed vacuum engine burning Aerozine50 and NTO. It was used on the stage of the same name on the Europa I and II launch vehicles. From Ven Stock Revamp mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 德国研制的挤压式真空发动机，使用混肼 50（Aerozine50）与四氧化二氮作为推进剂，曾用于「欧罗巴」1 号、2 号运载火箭上的同名级段。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A LOX/Ammonia gas generator engine which powered the X-15 spaceplane. It was the first large rocket engine capable of throttling and restarting. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一台液氧/氨燃气发生器循环发动机，为 X-15 试验机提供动力。它是第一台能够节流与重启的大型火箭发动机。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. Designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fuelling before launch. It was used on the R-16 and R-36 ICBMs, and Tsiklon-2 and Tsiklon-3 LVs. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联双燃烧室燃气发生器发动机。它在 1950 年代末研制，目的是让洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂——当时 R-7 所用的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要长时间加注。它被用于 R-16 与 R-36 洲际弹道导弹，以及旋风-2 与旋风-3 运载火箭。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet dual chamber gas generator engine. It was designed in the late 1950s to use storable propellants for ICBMs because the cryogenic propellants in the current R-7 could not be stored for long periods, requiring lengthy fueling before launch. It was used in clusters of up to three in many Soviet ICBMs, and later in the Kosmos and Tsiklon launch vehicles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联双燃烧室燃气发生器发动机。它在 1950 年代末研制，目的是让洲际弹道导弹使用可贮存推进剂——当时 R-7 所用的低温推进剂无法长期贮存，发射前需要长时间加注。它曾以最多三台并联的方式用于多款苏联洲际弹道导弹，后来又用于宇宙号与旋风号运载火箭。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Luna E-6 spacecraft bus. It was used for the first Soviet lunar landers and lunar orbiters. When used on a lunar lander, it was switched to verniers only for terminal descent. From Stock (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联燃气发生器循环的自燃推进剂真空发动机，用于月球 E-6 航天器平台的推进系统。它曾用于苏联最早的月球着陆器与月球轨道器。装在着陆器上时，末段下降会切换为只用游标发动机。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet gas generator hypergolic vacuum engine. Designed for use in the propulsion systems of the Mars and Venera 3MV, 4MV and 5MV spacecraft buses. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联燃气发生器自燃推进剂真空发动机，为火星与金星 3MV、4MV、5MV 探测器平台的推进系统设计。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet high-performance semi-cryogenic upper stage engine. Originally developed as an upper stage for the R-7, it was never used due to Korolev's refusal to use toxic propellants. It was later adapted for the Kosmos-2 Launch Vehicle, which needed a high performance upper stage due to the low performance of its R-12 first stage. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联高性能半低温上面级发动机。它最初作为 R-7 的上面级研制，但因科罗廖夫拒绝使用有毒推进剂而从未采用。后来它被改用于宇宙-2 运载火箭——该火箭的 R-12 第一级性能偏低，因此需要一台高性能上面级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15 was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-253, using NTO, was chosen to power the UR-500/Proton, becoming the workhorse of the Soviet space program. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。它源于一项为 N1 研制 150 吨推力助推发动机的计划，先后有烧硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧配偏二甲肼的多个版本。尽管最终选中 NK-15 作为 N1 的动力，但采用四氧化二氮的 RD-253 被选定为 UR-500/质子号的动力，成为苏联航天计划的主力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet hypergolic staged combustion engine. Developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust vacuum engine for the N1, versions were created burning nitric acid, NTO, or LOX with UDMH. Although the NK-15V was ultimately selected to power the N1, the RD-254, using NTO, was chosen to power the upper stages of the UR-700. The RD-254 was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联自燃推进剂分级燃烧发动机。它源于一项为 N1 研制 150 吨推力真空发动机的计划，先后有烧硝酸、四氧化二氮或液氧配偏二甲肼的多个版本。尽管最终选中 NK-15V 作为 N1 的动力，但采用四氧化二氮的 RD-254 被选定为 UR-700 的上面级动力。RD-254 随整个 UR-700 项目一同下马，从未飞行。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Soviet-built derivative of the Nene used in many early Soviet jet aircraft, including the MiG-15, MiG-17, Tu-14, and Il-28. From SXT (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 苏联仿制「尼恩」的派生型，用于许多早期苏联喷气机，包括米格-15、米格-17、图-14 与伊尔-28。 来自 SXT (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Thiel alcolox booster engine used on the A-4 Series B/V-2 missile. The Model 39b was an interim design, but went into production. Used 18 x 1.5 tonne thrust chambers that fed a common mixing chamber, as combustion instability issues of a single large injector were unable to be resolved. Work began 1936, testing in 1939, and mass production from 1943-1945. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Thiel 研制的醇氧助推发动机，用于 A-4 B 系列/V-2 导弹。Model 39b 本是过渡设计，却投入了量产。由于单个大喷注器的燃烧不稳定问题无法解决，它采用 18 个 1.5 吨推力的推力室，共同向一个混合室供气。1936 年开始研制，1939 年试车，1943 至 1945 年批量生产。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A Wasserfall derivative engine developed by German and French engineers after WW2 for the sounding rocket of the same name. It was the first French high altitude sounding rocket. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Wasserfall 的衍生发动机，二战后由德国与法国工程师为同名探空火箭研制。它是法国第一枚高空探空火箭。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A aerospike engine using proven technology from the J-2 and introducing an aerospike nozzle to the developing J-2S machinery. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款塞式（aerospike）发动机，采用 J-2 的成熟技术，在 J-2S 的机件上引入塞式喷管。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A capsule containing a monkey, or a small dog. Returning the sample is crucial for scientific and ethical reasons. From Kerbalism (SXT model) mod
zh: 一个装着猴子或小型犬的舱体。无论出于科学还是伦理考虑，把样本回收都至关重要。 来自 Kerbalism (SXT model) mod

en: A collapsable relay antenna. Intended to be placed on the mounting bracket of the Apollo Service Engine Block III. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward) From ROCapsules mod
zh: 可折叠中继天线。设计用于安装在 Apollo Block III 服务发动机的安装支架上。虚构（Eyes Turned Skyward） 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A collapsible relay antenna consisting of a high gain dish, for transmitting the many exciting things you've discovered. Intended to be placed on the mounting bracket of the Apollo Service Engine Block V. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward) From ROCapsules mod
zh: 由高增益碟形天线构成的可折叠中继天线，用于传回你发现的许多激动人心的东西。设计用于安装在 Apollo Block V 服务发动机的安装支架上。虚构（Eyes Turned Skyward） 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A crew access elevator for Gemini spacecraft, inspired by the erector used for the Titan II-Gemini. Designed for use with the mtaching Titan II Launch Stand, but also can be used with other Launch Stands, Plates and Bases. The elevator tower fits around the Titan II or other rocket, with the access floor in the top white room fitting close to the capsule. Both the elevator car maximum height and the access floor height can be adjusted with their deploy limit sliders so they match up with each other. The elevator tower has three height variants, and is a downward rotating type, with an exterior elevator car. The front white panels on the tower can be retracted if desired. There is only one color option for the tower. Hatches on the elevator car allow an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 双子座号飞船用乘员通行升降机，灵感取自Titan II-Gemini所用的起竖装置。针对配套的Titan II发射支架设计，但也可用于其他发射支架、发射板与发射基座。升降机塔包在Titan II或其他火箭周围，顶端白色舱室内的通道地板紧贴太空舱。电梯轿厢的最高高度与通道地板的高度均可用各自的展开限制滑块调节，使两者相互对齐。升降机塔有三种高度变体，为下翻式，轿厢设在外部。塔体前部的白色面板可根据需要收回。塔架只有一种配色。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A crew access elevator for small manned spacecraft, inspired by the emergency egress and umbilical tower used for Mercury-Atlas and designed for the Tier 1 launch pad and the Atlas Launch Stand, but can be used with some other launch bases and stands. The elevator tower is a fixed type, with 8 colors available. The stopping height of the elevator car is adjusted with a deploy limit slider. Use with the Mercury-Atlas Elevator Crew Walkway, which attaches to one of the front nodes, and flips up to retract. The separate Mercury Umbilical Mast attaches to a node on the front platform of the tower. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型载人飞船用乘员通行升降机，灵感取自Mercury-Atlas所用的紧急撤离与脐带塔，针对Tier 1发射台与Atlas发射支架设计，但也适用于部分其他发射基座与支架。升降机塔为固定式，提供8种配色。电梯轿厢的停靠高度用展开限制滑块调节。请搭配Mercury-Atlas升降机乘员走道使用，该走道附着在前侧某个节点上，向上翻起即收回。独立的Mercury脐带桅杆附着在塔前平台的节点上。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A crew access elevator for small manned spacecraft, inspired by the rollback gantry used for Mercury-Redstone and designed for the Tier 1 launch pad and the Redstone Launch Stand, but can be used with some other launch bases and stands. The elevator tower is an animated rollback type, with 8 colors available. The stopping height of the elevator car is adjusted with a deploy limit slider. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型载人飞船用乘员通行升降机，灵感取自Mercury-Redstone所用的后撤式龙门塔，针对Tier 1发射台与Redstone发射支架设计，但也适用于部分其他发射基座与支架。升降机塔为动画后撤式，提供8种配色。电梯轿厢的停靠高度用展开限制滑块调节。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A custom droop-style umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower, with three switchable arm styles. For reference, from the top down, there were two large angled arms, then two large straight arms, then a small beam arm, then at the bottom another large straight arm. The separate Gemini Spacecraft umbilical attaches to the top of the large angled arm style. Umbilical has an extension tube that is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔的定制下垂式脐带，有三种可切换的臂样式。供参考：自上而下原本是两条大型斜臂、两条大型直臂、一条小型梁式臂，最下方又是一条大型直臂。独立的双子座号飞船脐带附着在大型斜臂样式的顶端。脐带带有一根可伸缩延长管，长度可用展开限制滑块调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A custom umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower, with three switchable arm styles. For reference, from the top down, there were two large angled arms, then two large straight arms, then a small beam arm, then at the bottom another large straight arm. The separate Gemini Spacecraft umbilical attaches to the top of the large angled arm style. Umbilical pipe is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔的定制脐带，有三种可切换的臂样式。供参考：自上而下原本是两条大型斜臂、两条大型直臂、一条小型梁式臂，最下方又是一条大型直臂。独立的双子座号飞船脐带附着在大型斜臂样式的顶端。脐带管路长度可用展开限制滑块调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A decal that can display custom text in a variety of fonts From Conformal Decals mod
zh: 可显示自定义文字、并提供多种字体的贴纸。来自 Conformal Decals mod

en: A deeply-throttleable pressure-fed engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. The version on J-class missions had slightly higher isp, which helped give payload capacity for the rover and other equipment. A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta P series as an upper stage engine; this was a low-cost model with more restarts and slightly higher thrust but with lower efficiency and no throttling. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于 Apollo 登月舱下降段的可深度节流挤压式发动机。J 级任务所用的版本比冲略高，从而腾出载荷能力来携带月球车及其他设备。后来的变体（TR-201）曾作为上面级发动机用于 Delta P 系列；那是一款低成本型号，可多次重启、推力略高，但效率较低且不具备节流能力。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A deeply-throttleable pressure-fed engine used for the descent module of the Apollo lunar lander. The version on J-class missions had slightly higher isp, which helped give payload capacity for the rover and other equipment. A later variant (TR-201) was used on Delta P series as an upper stage engine; this was a low-cost model with more restarts and slightly higher thrust but with lower efficiency and no throttling. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于阿波罗登月舱下降级的深度节流挤压式发动机。J 级任务上的版本比冲略高，从而为月球车及其他设备留出载荷能力。后期的变型（TR-201）作为上面级发动机用于 Delta P 系列：它成本低、重启次数更多、推力略高，但效率较低且不能节流。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A derivative of the Castor 1 motor, the Castor 2 featured higher specific impulse and propellant load, a lower dry mass fraction, and a longer burn time. It was used as strap-on booster starting with Delta E and in all but the early Scouts. Burn time 39s. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: Castor 2 是 Castor 1 发动机的衍生型，比冲与装药量更高、干质量比更低、燃烧时间更长。自 Delta E 起用作捆绑助推器，并用于除早期型号外的历次侦察兵发射。燃烧时间 39 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A distinctive feature of the Saturn tower was this hammerhead crane that sat on the very top. This crane has no hoist capability, but it can be rotated up to 180 degrees via an animation; set the rotation limit to 50 to rotate only 90 degrees to the launch position. For launches, the crane was rotated 90 degree in the clockwise direction. A gray variant is also available. The lightning mast on top can be switched between the original Saturn tower mast or the new Shuttle mast, which was first used for the ASTP Saturn IB launch, or can be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星塔的一个显著特征就是位于塔顶的这台锤头起重机。它没有吊装能力，但可通过动画旋转最多180度；把旋转限制设为50，就只会旋转90度到发射位。发射时，起重机向顺时针方向旋转90度。另有灰色变体可选。顶部的避雷桅杆可在原版土星塔桅杆与新型航天飞机桅杆（最早用于ASTP任务的土星1B发射）之间切换，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A expander bleed cycle engine developed in the 2000s. It was a Mitsubishi and Boeing joint project for Delta IV cryogenic upper stages. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 2000 年代研制的一款膨胀排放循环发动机。它是三菱与波音为 Delta IV 低温上面级开展的联合项目。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A first stage solid rocket motor developed from Algol I and used on the Scout launch vehicles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 由 Algol I 发展而来的第一级固体火箭发动机，用于侦察兵系列运载火箭。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A first stage solid rocket motor used on many sounding rockets including Nike-Deacon, Nike-Cajun, Nike-Apache, Nike-Aerobee170, Nike-Aerobee350, and more. From ROEngines mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 用于多种探空火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机，包括 Nike-Deacon、Nike-Cajun、Nike-Apache、Nike-Aerobee170、Nike-Aerobee350 等。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: A first stage solid rocket motor used on the early X-1 and X-2 Scout launch vehicles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 用于早期 X-1 与 X-2 侦察兵运载火箭的第一级固体火箭发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A fixed 2.5m high additional section for the Titan III and IV Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. The front mount rail can be toggled on or off. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 泰坦III与IV模块化服务塔的固定2.5米高附加节段，提供8种配色。前部安装导轨可开启或关闭。还可选配多种配置的侧板。需搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A fixed Cassegrain parabolic antenna for general applications. Features a composite protective cover for the reflector. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 固定式卡塞格伦抛物面天线，适用于一般用途。反射面配有复合材料防护罩。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A fixed Gregorian - style parabolic antenna for deep space telecommunications. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 固定式格里高利型抛物面天线，用于深空通信。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A fixed axial feed parabolic antenna for deep space telecommunications. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 固定式轴向馈源抛物面天线，用于深空通信。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A flat slab service mast styled after that used for the Ariane V rocket, with multiple height options and available in 3 colors. Both the lower and upper sections can be switched from zero to 10 meters in height. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 平板式服务桅杆，造型仿阿丽亚娜5号火箭所用的那种，提供多种高度，并有3种配色。上下两段的高度均可在0到10米之间切换。请搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A folding Yagi antenna designed to enhance gathering of VHF radar sounding data. Can be used as a communications antenna in a pinch. Attach to the node on the Apollo engine mount just under the science bay. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 可折叠八木天线，用于增强 VHF 雷达探测数据的采集。必要时也可用作通信天线。安装在 Apollo 发动机座上、科学舱正下方的节点。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A four segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor, one of the most powerful rocket motors ever built and flown. Two of them were used by the Space Shuttle for liftoff and the initial part of the flight, providing more than 75% of the overall stack thrust. Manufactured by Thiokol and later by ATK. From ReStock Plus mod
zh: 四段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机，是有史以来推力最强的火箭发动机之一。航天飞机在起飞及飞行初始阶段使用两台，提供了全组合体推力的 75% 以上。先由 Thiokol 制造，后由 ATK 制造。 来自 ReStock Plus mod

en: A four segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor, one of the most powerful rocket motors ever built and flown. Two of them were used by the Space Shuttle for liftoff and the initial part of the flight, providing more than 75% of the overall stack thrust. Manufactured by Thiokol and later by ATK. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 四段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机，是有史以来建造并飞行过的最强劲的火箭发动机之一。航天飞机用两台在升空与飞行初始段工作，提供全箭 75% 以上的推力。由 Thiokol 制造，后由 ATK 制造。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A fuel-rich staged combustion engine used on the core stage of H-II series launchers. The original LE-7 was replaced by the LE-7A, which sacrificed some performance in favor of reduced cost and better reliability. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于 H-II 系列运载器芯级的富燃分级燃烧发动机。原始 LE-7 由 LE-7A 取代，后者以略微牺牲性能换取更低成本与更好可靠性。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A further continuation of the RD-170/171 series, featuring a single combustion chamber and nozzle. The RD-191 powers the Angara family of launchers, while the RD-151 was used on the Naro-1 launch vehicle and the RD-181 will be used on the Antares 200-series. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-170/171 系列的进一步延续，采用单个燃烧室与喷管。RD-191 为安加拉系列运载器提供动力，RD-151 曾用于罗老一号运载火箭，而 RD-181 将用于安塔瑞斯 200 系列。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A gas generator cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Fregat upper stage series. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款用于弗雷加特上面级系列的燃气发生器循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A gas generator vernier engine cluster found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 见于 UR-200 第二级与 UR-500/质子号系列运载器第三级的燃气发生器游动发动机组。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A general rectangular node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters with two small side boosters. Center and optional outer hold-down support plates can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit sliders. There are different combinations of integrated hold-down bolts and clamp arms, each of which can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The bolts can also be switched between short, tall and extended heights. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用矩形节点式发射夹具，面向生涯早期，可适配直径2.5米、1.875米、1.5米、1.25米、0.9375米与0.625米并带两个小型侧助推器的火箭。中央与可选的压紧支撑板可用各自的展开限制滑块调节长度。内置压紧螺栓与夹具臂有多种组合，每项均可用其展开限制滑块向内调节，以对准贮箱或发动机座的底部。螺栓还可在矮、高、加长三档高度之间切换。加长档螺栓另有高度微调滑块。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A general round node-attached launch clamp, intended for early career, that can accomodate rockets of 2.5m, 1.875m, 1.5m, 1.25m, 0.9375m and 0.625m diameters. The stand can be configured as the base flat ring or with a conical extension. Support plates for the integrated hold-downs are configured separately, allowing a mix of bolts and clamp arms. The hold-down bolts are non-animated and have 4 configurations and 3 heights, and can be adjusted inwards with their deploy limit slider to align with the bottom of a tank or engine mount. The extended height bolts have an additional height adjust slider. There are optional integrated side clamps available in different configurations, and are also adjusted with their deploy limit slider. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用圆形节点式发射夹具，面向生涯早期，可适配直径2.5米、1.875米、1.5米、1.25米、0.9375米与0.625米的火箭。支架可配置为底部平垫环，也可加装锥形延伸段。内置压紧装置的支撑板可单独配置，因此螺栓与夹具臂可以混用。压紧螺栓无动画，有4种配置与3档高度，可用其展开限制滑块向内调节，以对准贮箱或发动机座的底部。加长档螺栓另有高度微调滑块。另有可选的多种配置内置侧夹具，同样用其展开限制滑块调节。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A generic RCS 3-Way Angled Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for medium stages and spacecraft. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 通用三向斜置 RCS 组件。用于中型级段与航天器的沉底和姿态控制。 RCS 需要高压罐才能工作。 来自 ReStock Plus mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A generic RCS 3-Way Angled Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for small probes. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 通用三向斜置 RCS 组件。用于小型探测器的沉底和姿态控制。 RCS 需要高压罐才能工作。 来自 ReStock Plus mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A generic RCS 3-Way Angled Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for small upper stages or medium probes. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 通用三向斜置 RCS 组件。用于小型上面级或中型探测器的沉底和姿态控制。 RCS 需要高压罐才能工作。 来自 ReStock Plus mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A generic RCS 3-Way Angled Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for small upper stages or small probes. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 通用三向斜置 RCS 组件。用于小型上面级或小型探测器的沉底和姿态控制。 RCS 需要高压罐才能工作。 来自 ReStock Plus mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A generic RCS 5-Way Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for medium stages and spacecraft. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 通用五向 RCS 组件。用于中型级段与航天器的沉底和姿态控制。 RCS 需要高压罐才能工作。 来自 ReStock Plus mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A generic RCS 5-Way Pod. Use this for ullage and attitude control for small probes. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From ReStock Plus mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.

en: A highly-streamlined cockpit for experimental planes. Rated for Mach 3 flight. Similar in role to the Bell X-1 Cockpit that was used to break the sound barrier. From Realism Overhaul mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 为试验机设计的高度流线型座舱。可在马赫 3 下飞行。作用类似当年用于突破音障的 Bell X-1 座舱。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: A hinged wing-like solar panel design that starts in an upright-folded position to better fit inside a fairing. Once deployed, it is locked into place and does not track the sun. Level 1, 1.4137m^2 Solar Panels degrade, affecting the power output over time. Check this effect in the PAW. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 铰接式翼状太阳能板，初始为竖立折叠状态，以便更好地收纳在整流罩内。展开后会锁定到位，不会追踪太阳。1 级 1.4137m^2 太阳能板会发生衰减，随时间推移影响输出功率。可在 PAW 中查看该效果。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: A hollow structural adapter with mounting points for 4 retrorockets, and a passage for crew. Hold ALT to make attaching the retrorockets easier. Decoupler detaches the bottom node (adapter module). Designed for the MOL program, it was tested uncrewed, but the program was cancelled before any manned launches. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 空心结构转接器，设有 4 台反推火箭的安装点，并留有一条乘员通道。按住 ALT 可让安装反推火箭更容易。分离器可脱离底部节点（转接器模块）。为 MOL 计划设计，曾进行无人试验，但该计划在任何载人发射之前就被取消。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: A hydrolox gas generator upper stage engine, directly descended from the HM4 testbed engine and used on the upper stages of the Ariane launch vehicle family. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款氢氧燃气发生器上面级发动机，直接源自 HM4 试验发动机，用于阿里安系列运载火箭的上面级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A hypergolic upper stage engine. The baseline Aestus engine is pressure fed and is used on the Ariane 5 G, GS and ES series, while the Aestus II (also known as RS-72) variant is pump-fed with better overall performance. From ReStock Plus mod
zh: 自燃推进剂上面级发动机。基准型 Aestus 发动机采用挤压式供给，用于 Ariane 5 G、GS 和 ES 系列；Aestus II（又称 RS-72）变体则为泵压式供给，整体性能更好。 来自 ReStock Plus mod

en: A kerolox gas generator vacuum engine which served in R-7 upper stages (Luna, Vostok). The RD-0105 was designed for Luna launches; it was the first upper stage for the R-7 series and was reused for uncrewed Vostok tests. An enhanced version, the RD-0109, was used for crewed Vostok launches. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款煤油液氧燃气发生器真空发动机，曾用于 R-7 的上面级（月球号、东方号）。RD-0105 为月球号发射设计，是 R-7 系列的第一个上面级，后又用于无人的东方号试验。增强型 RD-0109 则用于载人的东方号发射。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A kerolox gas-generator sustainer engine used in the Atlas launch vehicle. It, like the Atlas's booster engines (LR89s), is lit on the ground, but after a bit over 2 minutes the boosters are dropped and Atlas continues to orbit under the power of the LR105 (with the verniers for roll control and final adjustment). The final configuration of the LR105 (like the LR89) uses RS-27 components for better performance. As a sustainer, the LR105 has sea level and vacuum efficiencies somewhere between a booster and an upper stage engine. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于宇宙神运载火箭的煤油液氧燃气发生器主级发动机。它与宇宙神的助推发动机（LR89）一样在地面点火，但两分钟多一点后助推器被抛掉，宇宙神靠 LR105 的推力继续飞向轨道（游动发动机负责滚转控制与末段调整）。LR105 的最终构型（与 LR89 一样）采用 RS-27 部件以获得更好性能。作为主级发动机，LR105 的海平面与真空效率介于助推级与上面级发动机之间。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A large 2.5m+ service module for the 1969 Big Gemini concept. Includes a large pressurized volume in the aft for cargo and crew space. This Service Module is also compatible with Apollo (although it will need a custom adapter, and the internal compartment will be inaccessable since Apollo doesn't have a hatch in it's heat shield), and the Apollo Service Module is also compatible with Big Gemini (Adapter not included). NOTE: This contains no propulsion, add RCS thrusters. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 为 1969 年 Big Gemini 方案研制的大型 2.5m+ 服务舱。后部有较大的增压容积，可用作货舱与乘员空间。该服务舱也可与 Apollo 兼容（不过需要定制转接器，且其内部隔舱无法进入，因为 Apollo 的隔热罩上没有舱门）；反过来，Apollo 服务舱也与 Big Gemini 兼容（不含转接器）。注意：该部件不含推进系统，请自行加装 RCS 推力器。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A large aerodynamic Heatshield to protect your cockpit. Decouple before landing. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 大型气动隔热罩，用于保护你的座舱。着陆前请分离。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A large harvesting device which harvests oxide-rich regolith for smelting or water extraction. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 一款大型采集装置，可采集富含氧化物的风化层，用于冶炼或提取水。 来自 Kerbalism mod

en: A large launch stand styled after the concrete "stool" used at the original LC-34/37 for the Saturn I and IB rockets. Has switchable hold-down arm configurations in 4.25m, 3.75m, 3.125m, 2.5m and 1.875m. Integrated hold-down arms have switchable configurations, and can be turned off. Optional base block for the tower is available in four different positions. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型发射支架，造型仿照最初为土星1号与1B火箭在LC-34/37使用的混凝土“凳台”。压紧臂配置可在4.25米、3.75米、3.125米、2.5米与1.875米之间切换。内置压紧臂有多种配置可切换，也可关闭。塔架的可选基座块提供四种不同位置。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A large nosecone for covering up exposed areas of big rockets. Enhanced to fit stock solid rocket motors too. Capable of some fuel carriage as well. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 用于遮盖大型火箭外露部位的大型头锥。经过改型，也能适配原版固体火箭发动机。还能携带少量燃料。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A large part for turning gaseous fuel or oxygen into liquid to be used. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 用于将气态燃料或氧气液化为可用资源的大型部件。来自 Kerbalism mod

en: A large retractable External Active Thermal Control System radiator. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 大型可收放式外部主动热控系统散热器。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A large surface - mounted External Active Thermal Control System radiator panel. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 大型表面安装式外部主动热控系统散热板。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A large-size fallback-type service tower inspired by the transporter-erector used for the Falcon 9. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 3 height and 2 color options. The upper clamp has two size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted vertically with its deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals are moved vertically with the upper clamp, and their length can be adjusted with their deploy limit slider, or turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型后倒式服务塔，灵感取自猎鹰9号所用的运输起竖车。后倒收回有两种方式：一种是简单的一步式，整座塔完全收回，仅由分级触发；另一种是两步手动方式，可在发射前先将塔体少量收回，起飞时再单独完成后倒收回。塔体有3种高度与2种配色可选。上夹具提供两种尺寸，也可关闭，可用其展开限制滑块做竖向调节。固定脐带随上夹具一同竖向移动，长度可用其展开限制滑块调节，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A larger version of the chemical plant, for housing ISRU processes. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 化工厂的加大版本，可容纳ISRU工艺。来自 Kerbalism mod

en: A late 1960s turbojet. The ultimate version of the Olympus turbojet, designed for sustained Mach 2 operation to power Concorde. Although thirsty at sea level, when mated to a well-optimized intake this engine can supercruise at Mach 2, achieving relatively good efficiency. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1960 年代末的涡轮喷气发动机。奥林匹斯（Olympus）涡喷的终极版本，为「协和」号客机的持续 2 马赫飞行而设计。它在海平面很费油，但与优化良好的进气道配合时，可在 2 马赫实现超巡航，效率相对不错。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A late 50s turbojet based on the Pratt & Whitney J57, the Model 304-2 was a liquid-hydrogen-fueled turbojet, designed for project SUNTAN, a high-performance replacement for the U-2 spyplane. The project required the development of large-scale liquid hydrogen production and handling techniques, at the cost of hundreds of millions of dollars. Various jet engines were converted to hydrogen power, where they showed incredible stability and efficiency. This information, along with many of the engineers involved, were later transferred to working on the RL-10 where the information gained proved invaluable. The Model 304 and project SUNTAN, however, were ultimately cancelled, as the conventionally-fueled A-12/SR-71 was showing much greater promise. From Advanced Jet Engines mod
zh: 1950 年代末基于普惠 J57 的涡轮喷气发动机，型号 304-2 是一台烧液氢的涡喷发动机，为 SUNTAN 计划研制——该计划旨在以高性能平台取代 U-2 侦察机。计划需要开发大规模液氢生产与操作技术，耗费数亿美元。多台喷气发动机被改装为烧氢，表现出惊人的稳定性与效率。这些资料连同许多参与其中的工程师后来转入 RL-10 的研制，所获知识极有价值。然而 304 型与 SUNTAN 计划最终都被取消，因为使用常规燃料的 A-12/SR-71 前景要好得多。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod

en: A late 50s turbojet originally developed for the Tu-121 cruise missile, the R-15 was modified instead for use on the MiG-25, which became the fastest serially produced fighter, capable of reaching Mach 3.2, although at the risk of severe engine damage. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: R-15 是 1950 年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，原本为图-121 巡航导弹研制，后来改为用于米格-25——后者成为量产战斗机中速度最快的型号，可达 3.2 马赫，但代价是发动机可能严重受损。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A late 50s turbojet, the R-11 was developed in parallel with the less sophisticated RD-9. It became the powerplant for the MiG-21, Yak-28 and Su-15. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-7, where it powered the JJ-7, J/F-7, and J-8. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1950 年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，R-11 与相对简易的 RD-9 并行研制。它成为米格-21、雅克-28 与苏-15 的动力装置。中国对其逆向仿制为涡喷-7（WP-7），驱动了歼教-7、歼-7 与歼-8。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A late 60s turbojet, the R-13 was developed from the earlier R-11 to improve the performance of the MiG-21. It became the powerplant for late model MiG-21s and Su-15s. It was reverse-engineered in China and built as the WP-13, where it powered the J-7III onwards and J-8II. From Advanced Jet Engines mod
zh: 1960 年代末的涡轮喷气发动机，R-13 由早期的 R-11 发展而来，用以提升米格-21 的性能。它成为后期米格-21 与苏-15 的动力装置。中国对其逆向仿制为涡喷-13（WP-13），驱动了歼-7III 及之后的型号与歼-8II。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod

en: A late 60s turbojet. Developed to replace the R-11 and R-13, the R-25 added an extremely powerful "extra-power" afterburner, that allowed it to nearly double it's thrust for short periods of time. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1960 年代末的涡轮喷气发动机。R-25 为取代 R-11 与 R-13 而研制，加装了功率极强的「超功率」加力燃烧室，可在短时间内把推力几乎提高一倍。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A later 1970s atomic engine with relatively low TWR but high ISP and a power generation of 4200 MW. Derived from the Phoebus 2A ground demonstrator, tested in 1968. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1970 年代后期的核发动机，推重比相对较低但比冲很高，功率 4200 MW。它派生自 1968 年试车的 Phoebus 2A 地面验证机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A lighter nosecone for Gemini without the docking port. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 用的更轻头锥，不带对接端口。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A long strongback truss for carrying cargo. From SXT mod
zh: 用于运货的长强背桁架。 来自 SXT mod

en: A long, structural strongback truss, perfect for landers. From SXT mod
zh: 一根细长的结构性强背桁架，非常适合着陆器。 来自 SXT mod

en: A long-lasting US kerolox gas-generator booster engine. The same components and broadly the same performance as the LR89, the LR79 (also known as S-3D in Jupiter / Juno II) powered the Jupiter, Thor, and Thor-Delta (Delta) rockets. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款长寿命的美国煤油液氧燃气发生器助推发动机。LR79（在木星 / Juno II 上亦称 S-3D）与 LR89 部件相同、性能大体相当，为木星、雷神与雷神-Delta（Delta）火箭提供动力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A low thrust pressure-fed hypergolic engine used on the Space Shuttle for orbital insertion, maneuvering, and deorbiting. Currently used by the Orion MPCV. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 低推力挤压式自燃推进剂发动机，用于航天飞机入轨、机动与离轨。目前用于 Orion MPCV。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A matching top for the Modular Multi Tower, with a base plate variant for each tower size and 3 optional masts. The masts have various height and size combinations, and the top detail cab configured in 3 ways as well. The center mast is fixed, and the two outer masts can be adjusted in horizontal position in both the X and Z axis with the deploy limit sliders, and all three masts can be turned off individually as well. The masts also have 9 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 模块化多用途塔的配套塔顶，每种塔体尺寸都有对应的底板变体，并可加装3根桅杆。桅杆有各种高度与尺寸组合，顶部细节也有3种配置方式。中央桅杆固定，两根外侧桅杆可用展开限制滑块沿X轴与Z轴调节水平位置，三根桅杆也均可单独关闭。桅杆另有9种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A medium length strongback truss for carrying cargo. From SXT mod
zh: 用于运货的中长强背桁架。 来自 SXT mod

en: A medium retractable External Active Thermal Control System radiator. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 中型可收放式外部主动热控系统散热器。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A mini-size modular pole-type service tower for the launch stands and smaller rockets, with 3 height options. There are 2 pole width options and 3 styles of pole details. The sections can be stacked in various ways to create taller towers, with the base pad disabled on the additional sections; the large size sections go on the bottom part of the tower. The tower sections have 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Small Drop Umbilicals which are node-attached to the front of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 迷你模块化立柱式服务塔，适用于发射支架与较小火箭，有3种高度选项。立柱有2种宽度选项与3种立柱细节样式。各节段可按多种方式叠放，搭出更高的塔，附加节段上不启用底座垫板；大尺寸节段装在塔的下段。塔节另有8种配色。需搭配独立的小型垂降脐带，该脐带以节点附着方式装在塔的前部。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A mini-size modular truss-type service tower for the launch stands and smaller rockets, with 3 height options. Additional tower sections can be stacked to create taller towers, with the base pad turned off. There are also optional side panels available in multiple configurations. The tower section has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Small Drop Umbilicals which are node-attached to the front of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 迷你模块化钢架式服务塔，适用于发射支架与较小火箭，有3种高度选项。关闭底座垫板后即可叠放附加塔节，搭出更高的塔。还可选配多种配置的侧板。塔节另有8种配色。需搭配独立的小型垂降脐带，该脐带以节点附着方式装在塔的前部。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A mini-size modular truss-type service tower with two style variants. The tower section has 6 height options, and the base pad can be turned off, allowing multiple sections to be stacked for a taller tower. The front details can be toggled off in different ways to have a space for the Atlas-Agena Umbilical Arm to retract into. The tower section has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Small Drop Umbilicals which are node-attached to the front of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 迷你模块化钢架式服务塔，有两种样式变体。塔节有6种高度选项，底座垫板可以关闭，从而能叠放多个节段搭出更高的塔。前部细节可按不同方式关闭，为Atlas-Agena脐带臂腾出收回空间。塔节另有8种配色。需搭配独立的小型垂降脐带，该脐带以节点附着方式装在塔的前部。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A miniature version of the large MK1 spotlight that's perfect for small rovers; or for the more adventurous, a large headlamp. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 大型 MK1 聚光灯的缩小版，非常适合小型巡视器；胆子大一点的话，也可以当大号头灯。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A modern, streamlined, two-seater cockpit, designed for jet trainer aircraft. Max altitude 20 km. From Realism Overhaul mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 现代流线型双座座舱，为喷气式教练机设计。最大高度 20 km。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: A modified version of the Atlas Launch Stand without a frame and with separately adjustable center and side section. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas发射支架的改型，取消了框架，中央段与侧段可分别调节。支架有8种配色，夹具臂与侧脐带有2种配色。侧脐带与Atlas管路接头可以关闭，以便用于其他直径1.875米的火箭。支架还装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A more advanced alternative to the Mk-10 landing system. Rather stronger. From SXT mod
zh: Mk-10 着陆系统的进阶替代方案，强度更高。 来自 SXT mod

en: A more complex, but lightweight tank. Isogrid structure tanks use machined walls that are also load-bearing and form the entire structure of the tank, so no additional structure is needed to maintain rigidity. Manufacturing them can be difficult, however. The first level of isogrid tanks are 40% (standard) or 55% (HP) lighter than Al stringer conventional structure tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 40% more once tooled. From ROTanks mod
zh: 结构更复杂、但更轻的贮箱。等网格结构贮箱采用同时承力的机加工壁板，壁板本身构成贮箱的全部结构，因此无需额外结构来维持刚度。不过制造起来可能很困难。第一级等网格贮箱比铝制桁条常规结构贮箱轻 40%（标准型）或 55%（高压型），但工装成本高 50%，工装完成后成本高 40%。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: A more complex, but lightweight tank. Isogrid structure tanks use machined walls that are also load-bearing and form the entire structure of the tank, so no additional structure is needed to maintain rigidity. Manufacturing them can be difficult, however. The first level of isogrid tanks are 40% (standard) or 55% (HP) lighter than Al stringer conventional structure tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 40% more once tooled. From RealFuels mod
zh: 一种更复杂但更轻的罐体。等网格结构罐采用兼具承载能力的机加工壁板，壁板本身构成整个罐体结构，因此无需额外结构来维持刚度。不过制造难度较大。第一等级等网格罐比铝制桁条常规结构罐轻 40%（标准）或 55%（HP），但加工成本高 50%，加工完成后成本高 40%。 来自 RealFuels mod

en: A multi-height additional section for the Large General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用模块化服务塔的多高度附加节段，提供8种配色。还可选配多种配置的侧板。请搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height additional section for the Medium General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型通用模块化服务塔的多高度附加节段，提供8种配色。还可选配多种配置的侧板。请搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height additional section for the Small General Modular Service Tower, available in 8 colors. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用模块化服务塔的多高度附加节段，提供8种配色。还可选配多种配置的侧板。请搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height core section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach the mast core sections to the top of the base. Four height variants and eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas V斜置式服务桅杆模块化版本的多高度核心段。桅杆核心段可拼接到基座顶部。提供4种高度变体与8种配色。请搭配通用脐带、摆臂以及小型脐带使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height core section for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the tower sections to the top of the base. This section only has a toggle for the side panels, as it is for the main part if the tower. Add the detail section to get switchable detail options. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔2号式服务塔模块化版本的多高度核心段。塔架节段可拼接到基座顶部。该节段属于塔架主体部分，因此只有侧板一项开关。若要获得可切换的细节选项，请加装细节节段。提供8种配色。请搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height section for the Extra Large General Crew Elevator tower, switchable between regular tower core and crew-access types. The section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in either 3 or 4-side configurations are also available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 超大型通用乘员升降机塔的多高度节段，可在常规塔芯与乘员通道两种类型之间切换。该节段有8种配色，钢架样式可在通用型与土星型之间切换。还可选配三面或四面配置的侧板。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height section for the Large General Crew Elevator tower, switchable between regular tower core and crew-access types. The section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in multiple configurations are also available. The side pipes can also be turned off in different ways for use with the Extra Large General Crew Elevator. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员升降机塔的多高度节段，可在常规塔芯与乘员通道两种类型之间切换。该节段有8种配色，钢架样式可在通用型与土星型之间切换。还可选配多种配置的侧板。侧边管路也可按不同方式关闭，以便与超大型通用乘员升降机搭配使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A multi-height section for the Small General Crew Elevator tower, switchable between regular tower core and crew-access types. The section also has 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用乘员升降机塔的多高度节段，可在常规塔芯与乘员通道两种类型之间切换。该节段同样有8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A nose cone with built in parachute. Ensure you properly configure it to work with your craft. Can be resized in the PAW. From RealChute mod
zh: 内置降落伞的头锥。请确认已正确配置以配合你的飞行器使用。尺寸可在 PAW 中调整。 来自 RealChute mod

en: A nose cone with two built in parachutes. One drogue, one main. Ensure you properly configure it to work with your craft. Can be resized in the PAW. From RealChute mod
zh: 内置两具降落伞的头锥，一具减速伞、一具主伞。请确认已正确配置以配合你的飞行器使用。尺寸可在 PAW 中调整。 来自 RealChute mod

en: A one-person pod. Comes with built-in RCS thrusters running off High-Test Peroxide (HTP) and a large battery. Heat shield not included. From Stock (RO Config) mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 单人返回舱。内置使用高浓度过氧化氢（HTP）的 RCS 推力器与一块大电池。不含热防护罩。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 此零件不允许 EVA！

en: A post-war Russian version of the German Taifun anti-aircraft barrage rocket booster. Developed and tested in 1947-1951 but abandoned in favor of the R-110. A cluster of 8 of these rockets formed the first stage of the MR-1 sounding rocket. Length without payload - 1.36 meters. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 战后苏联仿制的德国“台风”防空弹幕火箭助推器。1947 至 1951 年研制并试车，但最终放弃，转而发展 R-110。8 枚该火箭并联构成 MR-1 探空火箭的第一级。不含载荷长度 1.36 米。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A powerful hypergolic engine used in the launch abort system of the Dragon 2 capsule. Other potential applications include hypersonic deceleration and landing for crew and cargo modules. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一台用于龙 2（Dragon 2）飞船逃逸系统的强劲自燃推进剂发动机。其他潜在应用还包括高超声速减速，以及乘员舱与货舱的着陆。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A powerful hypergolic upper stage engine. Developed as the second stage of Juno IVB, it was the most powerful upper stage engine of its time. It was cancelled with the rest of the Juno program in favor of Atlas and Thor based LVs. Tested, but never flew. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 强大的自燃推进剂上面级发动机。它作为 Juno IVB 的第二级研制，是当时最强的上面级发动机。它随 Juno 计划整体取消，转而发展以宇宙神与雷神为基础的运载火箭。经过试车，但从未飞行。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pressure-fed engine used for the ascent module of the Apollo lunar lander. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于 Apollo 登月舱上升段的挤压式发动机。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pressure-fed engine used for the ascent module of the Apollo lunar lander. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于阿波罗登月舱上升级的挤压式发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pressure-fed hypergolic rocket engine, burning either MMH and NTO (R-42) or hydrazine and NTO (R-42DM). Used as an apogee kick motor for geostationary satellites. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 挤压式自燃推进剂火箭发动机，可烧 MMH 与 NTO（R-42）或肼与 NTO（R-42DM）。用作地球同步卫星的远地点发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pressure-fed vacuum hypergolic engine used for attitude control on the Space Shuttle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于航天飞机姿态控制的挤压式真空自燃推进剂发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A protective nose cone for the NASA Docking System of the CST-100 Starliner. From ROCapsules mod
zh: CST-100 Starliner 的 NASA 对接系统保护头锥。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A pump or pressure-fed kerolox vernier engine. Used for attitude control and final velocity adjustment in the MA-x system (2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101) on Atlas, and MB-x system (LR79 or RS-27 + 2xLR101) on Thor-Able, Thor-Agena, Thor-Delta, and Delta. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 泵压或挤压式煤油液氧游动发动机。用于宇宙神上的 MA-x 系统（2x LR89 + LR105 + 2x LR101），以及雷神-Able、雷神-Agena、雷神-Delta 与 Delta 上的 MB-x 系统（LR79 或 RS-27 + 2xLR101）的姿态控制与末速修正。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pump-fed gas generator hydrolox engine, developed as an upper stage for the Black Knight and Blue Streak. The use of furnace brazing, rather than hand brazing as used in many earlier designs, significantly reduced manufacturing costs. The design was tested, but cancelled in the late 60s due to funding concerns. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款泵压式燃气发生器氢氧发动机，作为黑骑士与蓝光的上面级研制。采用炉中钎焊而非早期许多设计的手工钎焊，大幅降低了制造成本。该设计经过试验，但因经费问题在 60 年代后期取消。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the first stage of the R-16, R-36, and Tsyklon rockets. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款泵压式自燃推进剂游动发动机，用于 R-16、R-36 与旋风号火箭的第一级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pump-fed hypergolic vernier thruster used on the second stage of the R-16 and R-36 ICBM, and the Tsyklon (Cyclone) launch vehicle series for attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款泵压式自燃推进剂游动发动机，用于 R-16 与 R-36 洲际弹道导弹以及旋风号运载火箭系列的第二级，负责姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A pump-fed upgrade for the AJ10 developed in the 1980s as a high performance upper stage and tug. It was based heavily on the Shuttle OMS, with the same nozzle and combustion chamber, but had turbomachinery installed in place of a pressure-fed system. The program was cancelled after the Challenger disaster, but Transtar 1 flew as the Titan Launch Dispenser on Titan IV. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: AJ10 的泵压式改进型，1980 年代研制，作为高性能上面级与轨道拖船。它大量沿用航天飞机 OMS 的喷管与燃烧室，但以涡轮泵机组取代挤压式供给系统。该计划在“挑战者号”事故后取消，不过 Transtar 1 曾作为 Titan 发射分配器随泰坦 IV 飞行。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A radial surface - mounted External Active Thermal Control System radiator panel. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 径向表面安装式外部主动热控系统散热板。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A radially mounted part containing a parachute. Ensure you properly configure it to work with your craft. Can be resized in the PAW. From RealChute mod
zh: 内含一具降落伞的径向安装部件。请确认已正确配置以配合你的飞行器使用。尺寸可在 PAW 中调整。 来自 RealChute mod

en: A redesigned nozzle extension allowed for the LE-7A to achieve its intended performance, at the cost of slightly more weight. testedBurnTime=2241
zh: 重新设计的喷管延伸段使 LE-7A 达到预期性能，代价是质量略有增加。testedBurnTime=2241

en: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass. This part contains all variants with fixed (non-extendable) nozzles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款可多次启动的膨胀循环氢氧发动机，用于多种上面级，包括半人马座、土星 I 的 S-IV 级以及德尔塔低温第二级。它推力低，但比冲极高、质量很小。本部件包含所有采用固定（不可延伸）喷管的变体。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass. This part contains the RL-10-A-4N and -4-1N variants, which feature an extendable nozzle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款可多次启动的膨胀循环氢氧发动机，用于多种上面级，包括半人马座、土星 I 的 S-IV 级以及德尔塔低温第二级。它推力低，但比冲极高、质量很小。本部件包含 RL-10-A-4N 与 -4-1N 两个变体，均带可延伸喷管。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A restartable expander-cycle hydrolox engine used in multiple upper stages, including Centaur, the Saturn I S-IV, and the Delta Cryogenic Second Stage. It has low thrust, but very high ISP and low mass. This part contains the RL-10B-2 and -C-2 variants, which feature an extremely large extendable nozzle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款可多次启动的膨胀循环氢氧发动机，用于多种上面级，包括半人马座、土星 I 的 S-IV 级以及德尔塔低温第二级。它推力低，但比冲极高、质量很小。本部件包含 RL-10B-2 与 -C-2 两个变体，喷管延伸段极大。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A retractable, short range parabolic antenna for high speed telecommunications. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 可收放的短程抛物面天线，用于高速通信。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A secondary propulsion system developed for the Gemini program on the Agena Target Vehicle. It allowed for fine control and orbital maneuvers without igniting the main engine. It was later offered to commercial customers as an upgrade for Agena. The system is a completely contained unit including propellant tanks, one 16-lb thrust chamber, and one 200-lb thrust chamber. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为 Gemini 计划的 Agena 目标飞行器研制的辅助推进系统。它能在不点燃主发动机的情况下进行精细控制与轨道机动，后来作为 Agena 的升级项提供给商业客户。该系统是一个完全独立的单元，包含推进剂贮箱、一个 16 磅推力室和一个 200 磅推力室。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A separate crew access floor for the crew access tower section of the Saturn tower, used to provide access from the tower elevator to the crew access arm when a command pod's hatch does not align with the bottom of the crew access section. Attach the floor to the node in the elevator shaft of the crew access section, and adjust its height with the offset gizmo. The floor has two configurations: Saturn Crew Arm access from the back with the walkway or Milkstool access from the front. The floor also has two color options, default red and alternate gray. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星塔乘员通道塔段的独立乘员通道地板，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通道段底部不对齐时，提供从塔内升降机到乘员通道臂的通路。把地板附着到乘员通道段电梯井内的节点上，并用偏移工具调节其高度。地板有两种配置：从后方经走道接土星乘员臂，或从前方接挤奶凳通道。地板另有两种配色：默认红与替代灰。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A separate crew access floor for the crew access tower section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, used to provide access from the tower elevator to the crew access arm when a command pod's hatch does not align with the bottom of the crew access section. Attach the floor to the node in the elevator shaft of the crew access section, and adjust its height with the offset gizmo. The floor has three configurations: Shuttle Arm access, Rodan Arm access and Launch Platform access. The floor also has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 专为航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔乘员通行段设计的独立乘员通行地板，用于在指令舱舱门与乘员通行段底部不对齐时，打通塔内电梯到乘员通道臂的通路。将地板附着到乘员通行段电梯井内的节点上，并用偏移操纵器调节其高度。地板有三种构型：航天飞机臂通行、Rodan 臂通行和发射平台通行。地板另有两种配色：默认灰色与备选黑白。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A separate version of the Soyuz Gantry crew elevator only. Elevator tower has 7 height options and two color options. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlock can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 仅含联盟号桁架塔乘员电梯的独立版本。电梯塔有 7 种高度和两种配色可选。乘员电梯平台的高度、步道平台的高度以及平台延伸段的长度，都可用展开限制滑块调节。可选配转乘气闸，开启后可通过乘员转移功能让乘员登上位于整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢上以及塔底的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A separate version of the animated fallback umbilical pole from the Redstone Launch Stand. The pole has 9 height options and the umbilical at the end has three length variants. Drop the pole either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Redstone发射支架上那根动画后倒脐带立柱的单件版本。立柱有9种高度选项，末端的脐带有三种长度变体。立柱既可手动切换动画落下，也可由分级触发落下。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A separate version of the original Saturn tower lightning mast that was mounted on the hammerhead crane, for use with other towers. Red and gray versions can be selected, and the mounting plate can be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 原版土星塔避雷桅杆（安装在锤头起重机上）的单件版本，可供其他塔架使用。可选红色与灰色版本，安装板也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A service module with batteries a simple de-orbit engine that has only 1 ignition. This is the same service module that you use for Vostok, Voskhod, and Zenit. Attach the Decoupler to the Descent Module first and attach this to the bottom of the Descent Module. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 带电池与一台仅能点火 1 次的简易离轨发动机的服务舱。Vostok、Voskhod 与 Zenit 用的都是这个服务舱。请先把分离器装到下降舱上，再把它装到下降舱底部。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A set of generic warning decals and signs to add to your vehicles. From Conformal Decals mod
zh: 一套通用警告贴纸与标牌，可用于装饰你的载具。来自 Conformal Decals mod

en: A set of inflatable balloons that can handle impacts of moderate speed on planetary surfaces. These airbags are well suited for landing small landers and probes on rough terrain when a skycrane or internal propulsion is lacking or imprecise. First used on Russian Luna landers like Luna 9, airbags served well as Mars landing systems during various missions. From SXT mod
zh: 一组可充气的气囊，能承受中等速度的行星表面撞击。当缺少空中吊车或内部推进、或精度不够时，这些气囊非常适合把小型着陆器与探测器投放到崎岖地形上。气囊最早用于苏联「月球」9 号等着陆器，此后在多次任务中作为火星着陆系统表现良好。 来自 SXT mod

en: A short flip-up crew access walkway for the Mini General Crew Elevator. It attaches to one of the large center nodes on the elevator tower. Has 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于迷你通用乘员升降机的短款上翻式乘员通行走道。该走道附着在升降机塔中央的某个大节点上。有8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A short range omnidirectional antenna. Perfect for reentry vehicles and landers. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 短程全向天线。非常适合再入飞行器与着陆器。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A short strongback truss for carrying cargo. From SXT mod
zh: 用于运货的短强背桁架。 来自 SXT mod

en: A short, structural strongback truss. From SXT mod
zh: 一根短结构性强背桁架。 来自 SXT mod

en: A side-mount walkway extension section for the Large General Crew Elevator. It attaches to one of the center nodes on the front of a tower section, or onto the tower section's optional side nodes, or onto the top of a tower section. The top floor is accessible, and there are optional middle and bottom floors as well. The four walls can be independently switched off to creat different walkway types. The wall trusses have two switchable styles: General and Saturn types. Optional bottom brace beams can also be separately switched on. There are also 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员升降机的侧挂式走道延伸段。它可接到塔节段正面的任一中线节点上，也可接到塔节段的选配侧面节点上，或接到塔节段顶部。顶层可以通行，此外还有可选的中层与底层。四面墙体可各自独立关闭，以拼出不同的走道样式。墙体钢架有两种可切换样式：通用型与土星型。还可单独开启选配的底部支撑横梁。共有8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A simple nose cone for unmanned launches. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 用于无人发射的简易头锥。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A simple switchable flag. Can either use the mission flag or select a specific flag to use. From Conformal Decals mod
zh: 一款可切换的简易旗帜。既可使用任务旗帜，也可指定某一面旗帜。来自 Conformal Decals mod

en: A single separate mast from the full Modular Multi Tower Top, this mast has the same featiures and is able to be surface attached. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 从完整版模块化多用途塔顶中拆出的单根独立桅杆，功能与之一致，还可直接表面附着安装。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A single-part version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast, with multiple height variants. Eight color options are also available. Uses the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas V斜置式服务桅杆的单件版本，有多种高度变体。另有8种配色。需搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A single-part version of the Delta II-style unmanned service tower, with 5 height variants. Various structural details can be configured in different ways to create alternate versions of the tower for earlier Deltas. Default color is "Delta Blue", but 7 others are also available. Uses the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔2号式无人服务塔的单件版本，有5种高度变体。各项结构细节可有不同配置，从而复现早期德尔塔各型号的塔架。默认配色为“德尔塔蓝”，另有7种配色可选。需搭配通用脐带与摆臂使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A single-piece version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower, sized and customized for the Bluedog Design Bureaau Titan II GLV rocket. Uses separate Titan II Tower umbilicals or the General Umbilicals. Use with the Titan II Launch Stand for the full LC-19 recreation. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔的单件版本，尺寸与细节均针对Bluedog Design Bureau的Titan II GLV火箭定制。需搭配独立的Titan II塔脐带或通用脐带。搭配Titan II发射支架使用，即可完整复现LC-19工位。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A slim strut perfect for mounting things on other things! From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 细长的支杆，非常适合把东西装到别的东西上！ 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: A slimline general-use launch clamp platform, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the mini frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow). From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 薄型通用发射夹具平台，尺寸介于一体式发射支架与更大的通用发射基座之间。此为迷你框架，方形与矩形排气孔各有多种尺寸。塔架与压紧装置需另行搭配。内置梯子可切换高度（矮梯或高梯）与颜色（默认色或黄色）。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A slimline general-use launch clamp platform, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the small frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow). From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 薄型通用发射夹具平台，尺寸介于一体式发射支架与更大的通用发射基座之间。此为小型框架，方形与矩形排气孔各有多种尺寸。塔架与压紧装置需另行搭配。内置梯子可切换高度（矮梯或高梯）与颜色（默认色或黄色）。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A slimline general-use launch clamp, in between the integrated launch stands and the larger general launch bases. This is the medium frame type, and has multiple sizes of both square and rectangular exhaust holes. Uses separate towers and hold-downs. Built-in ladders can be switched both in height (short or tall) or color (default or yellow). From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 薄型通用发射夹具，尺寸介于一体式发射支架与更大的通用发射基座之间。此为中型框架，方形与矩形排气孔各有多种尺寸。塔架与压紧装置需另行搭配。内置梯子可切换高度（矮梯或高梯）与颜色（默认色或黄色）。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A small apogee kick motor for satellites, introduced in 1968 on Delta 57. Max thrust 12.34kN, burn time 18 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款用于卫星的小型远地点发动机，1968 年在德尔塔 57 上首次使用。最大推力 12.34 kN，燃烧时间 18 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small apogee kick motor used for geosynchronous satellites. It was used on the first geosynchronous satellite, Syncom 1. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款用于地球同步卫星的小型远地点发动机。它曾用于世界第一颗地球同步卫星辛康 1 号。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small but powerful solid fueled booster used as the first stage for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 小巧而强劲的固体助推器，用作 Aerobee 系列探空火箭的第一级。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 和 SmokeScreen。

en: A small decoupler for your 11x Baby Sargeant engine cluster. Place this on the node on top of the 3x Cluster (after placing the 3x Cluster) and attach your 11x Cluster to this. From ROEngines mod
zh: 用于 11 联 Baby Sergeant 发动机集束的小型分离器。先装好 3 联集束，再把本分离器装在 3 联集束顶部的连接点上，然后将 11 联集束接到它上面。来自 ROEngines mod

en: A small decoupler for your 3x Baby Sargeant engine cluster. From ROEngines mod
zh: 用于 3 联 Baby Sergeant 发动机集束的小型分离器。来自 ROEngines mod

en: A small extending antenna used for maintaining communications between the Gemini spacecraft and the ground. Attaches to the equipment section From ROCapsules mod
zh: 小型可伸缩天线，用于维持 Gemini 飞船与地面之间的通信。安装在设备段上 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A small gas-generator vacuum engine, developed as an upper stage for the R-14 to create the Kosmos-3 launch vehicle. Also known as the 11D49 or DU-49. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款小型燃气发生器真空发动机，作为 R-14 的上面级研制，由此产生了宇宙-3 运载火箭。又称 11D49 或 DU-49。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small harvesting device which harvests oxide-rich regolith for smelting or water extraction. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 一款小型采集装置，可采集富含氧化物的风化层，用于冶炼或提取水。 来自 Kerbalism mod

en: A small hypergolic engine developed for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars. Ultimately never used in space, as the R-4D was chosen for the Apollo program and Voyager Mars was cancelled. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为阿波罗计划与 Voyager Mars 研制的小型自燃推进剂发动机。最终从未上过太空：阿波罗计划改用了 R-4D，而 Voyager Mars 计划被取消。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small lamp made to light up everything, whether you like it or not. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 一盏小灯，用来照亮一切——不管你是否乐意。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small maneuvering engine used on the Soviet 1MV and 2MV spacecraft busses and KAUR-2 comsat bus. Used on early Venera, Mars, Zond, and Molniya satellites. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款小型机动发动机，用于苏联 1MV、2MV 航天器平台与 KAUR-2 通信卫星平台，曾用于早期的「金星」号、「火星」号、「探测」号与「闪电」号卫星。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small part for turning gaseous fuel or oxygen into liquid to be used. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 用于将气态燃料或氧气液化为可用资源的小型部件。来自 Kerbalism mod

en: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This is the original Vanguard second stage / Able / Delta configuration, without restart capability. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。AJ10 派生自美国第一台液体火箭发动机，是寿命最长的发动机家族：从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗 CSM，甚至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。这是最初的先锋号第二级 / Able / Delta 构型，不具备重启能力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents advanced AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Transtage and the Delta F and Delta K upper stages. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。AJ10 由美国第一台液体发动机派生而来，是寿命最长的发动机族：从美国第一颗卫星的运载火箭 Vanguard，经 Apollo CSM，一直到计划中的 Orion 服务舱。此项代表带喷管延伸段与重启能力的先进 AJ10。用于 Transtage 以及 Delta F 与 Delta K 上面级。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small pressure-fed hypergolic engine. A derivative of the first US liquid engine, the AJ10 is the longest-lived of any engine family, from the US's first satellite launch vehicle, Vanguard, through the Apollo CSM, and even planned for an Orion service module. This represents mid-period AJ10s with a nozzle extension and restart capability. Used on Thor-Ablestar and Delta E through Delta N. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型挤压式自燃推进剂发动机。AJ10 派生自美国第一台液体火箭发动机，是寿命最长的发动机家族：从美国首颗卫星运载火箭“先锋号”，到阿波罗 CSM，甚至曾计划用于“猎户座”服务舱。本型号代表中期 AJ10，带喷管延伸段并具备重启能力，用于 Thor-Ablestar 以及 Delta E 到 Delta N。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small pressure-fed sustainer for MR-1 Meteo sounding rockets, developed in response to the American Aerobee. Used after a small solid booster. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款小型挤压式供应主发动机，用于 MR-1「气象」探空火箭——该火箭是为回应美国「空蜂」而研制的。它在一台小型固体助推器之后点火工作。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small pressure-fed sustainer for the WAC Corporal and Aerobee sounding rockets. Used after a small solid booster. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于 WAC Corporal 与 Aerobee 探空火箭的小型挤压式主级发动机。在小固体助推器之后点火。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small probe and drogue docking system capable of crew transfer, useful for basic space stations. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 小型探杆-锥套式对接系统，可进行乘员转移，适用于基础型空间站。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A small radial decoupler. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 一个小型径向分离器。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small retractable External Active Thermal Control System radiator. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 小型可收放式外部主动热控系统散热器。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small solid fueled booster originally used to power anti-shipping rockets during WW2. It was used as the kick stage on the WAC Corporal, the USA's first sounding rocket, and reused in a modified form for the Aerobee line of sounding rockets. From Realism Overhaul mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 一种小型固体助推器，最初在二战期间用于为反舰火箭提供动力。它曾作为美国首枚探空火箭 WAC Corporal 的末助推级，后又以改进形式沿用至 Aerobee 系列探空火箭。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: A small solid fueled booster taken from the AIM-7 Sparrow missile. It was used as the third stage on the Aerobee 300 and 300A sounding rockets. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 取自 AIM-7 Sparrow 导弹的小型固体助推器。在 Aerobee 300 与 300A 探空火箭上用作第三级。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 和 SmokeScreen。

en: A small solid kick motor developed as a braking motor for the Ranger Block II rough lander. Repeated failures of the Ranger spacecraft meant the rough lander was never able to be deployed. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体末级发动机，为“游骑兵”Block II 硬着陆器的制动发动机而研制。由于游骑兵探测器接连失败，该硬着陆器始终未能实际部署。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid kick motor developed as alternative Vanguard third stage. It was reused on many later LVs with the Able/Delta upper stage (or simply "Thor Burner") to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Burn time 39 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体末级发动机，作为先锋号第三级的替代方案研制。后被大量后期运载器沿用（配 Able/Delta 上面级，或直接称“雷神 Burner”），用于在远地点圆化轨道或对载荷做末次加速。燃烧时间 39 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid kick motor used on the Jupiter-C sounding rocket (and later the Juno I and II launch vehicles) as upper stages in clusters of 11, 3 and, finally, one attached to the payload. The standard version uses the T17-E2 grain mixture while the higher performance one uses the JPL-532A. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
