zh: 小型固体末级发动机，用于木星-C 探空火箭（及其后的 Juno I、Juno II 运载火箭）的上面级：以 11 联、3 联，最后是单个直接连在载荷上的形式使用。标准版使用 T17-E2 药柱配方，高性能版使用 JPL-532A。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid kick motor, used as the third stage on all but the last Vanguard launch. Burn time 33 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体末级发动机，除最后一次外的历次先锋号发射都用作第三级。燃烧时间 33 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this final version was used on later Scout B launch vehicles. It was used to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Maximum thrust 25.6 kN, burn time 31 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体末级发动机。由 Altair 发展而来，这一最终版本用于后期的侦察兵 B 运载火箭，用于在远地点圆化轨道或对载荷做末次加速。最大推力 25.6 kN，燃烧时间 31 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid kick motor. Developed from the Altair, this successor was used on Scout and Delta to circularize at apogee or perform a final payload kick. Average thrust 28.48 kN, burn time 22 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体末级发动机。由 Altair 发展而来，这一后继型号用于侦察兵与 Delta，在远地点圆化轨道或对载荷做末次加速。平均推力 28.48 kN，燃烧时间 22 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small solid rocket motor to provide thrust for Agena spin-up. We're sure you can find other uses for it too. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 小型固体火箭发动机，用于为 Agena 提供起旋推力。我们相信你也能给它找到其他用途。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A small strip light ideally used as aircraft navigation lights. We can't stop you from trying to light up your house with em', but you will fail. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 小条形灯，最宜用作飞机航行灯。我们拦不住你拿它去照自家房子，不过你注定要失败。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small surface - mounted External Active Thermal Control System radiator panel. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 小型表面安装式外部主动热控系统散热板。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small, fixed VHF-FM whip antenna for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project Docking Module. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo-联盟号试验计划对接舱的小型固定式 VHF-FM 鞭状天线。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A small, single-person cabin for use on non-atmospheric landers and small spacecraft. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 用于非大气环境着陆器与小型航天器的小型单人舱。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A small-size fallback-type service tower inspired by the transporter-erector used for the Falcon 9, but in a shorter, slimmer form. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 4 height and 2 color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted vertically with its deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals are moved vertically with a separate slider, and their length can be adjusted with their deploy limit slider, or turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型后倒式服务塔，灵感取自猎鹰9号所用的运输起竖车，但造型更矮更瘦。后倒收回有两种方式：一种是简单的一步式，整座塔完全收回，仅由分级触发；另一种是两步手动方式，可在发射前先将塔体少量收回，起飞时再单独完成后倒收回。塔体有4种高度与2种配色可选。上夹具提供三种尺寸，也可关闭，可用展开限制滑块做竖向调节。固定脐带由独立滑块做竖向调节，长度可用其展开限制滑块调节，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A smaller version of the PPD-SM1600. Can hold approximately one third of the resources. From SXT mod
zh: PPD-SM1600 的缩小版，可贮存约三分之一的资源。 来自 SXT mod

en: A special Gemini Spacecraft umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower. It attaches to the top of the large angled arm style of the Titan II Tower Umbilical. Umbilical pipe is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 双子座号飞船专用脐带，用于Titan II GLV服务塔。它附着在Titan II塔脐带的大型斜臂样式的顶端。脐带管路长度可用展开限制滑块调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A special Mercury Spacecraft umbilical for the Mercury-Atlas Crew Elevator, which also doubled as the Launch Umbilical Tower. It attaches to the node on top of the pipe that sits just above the front platform of the elevator tower. The umbilical can be adjusted in lenght with the deploy limit slider. Retraction can be done manually or via staging with Animated Decouplers. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 水星号飞船专用脐带，用于Mercury-Atlas乘员升降机——该升降机同时兼作发射脐带塔。它附着在升降机塔前平台正上方那根管路的顶端节点上。脐带长度可用展开限制滑块调节。收回可手动执行，也可借助Animated Decouplers由分级触发完成。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A special droop-style Gemini Spacecraft umbilical for the Titan II GLV Service Tower. It attaches to the top of the large angled arm style of the Titan II Tower Umbilical. Umbilical has an extension tube that is adjustable in length using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 双子座号飞船专用下垂式脐带，用于Titan II GLV服务塔。它附着在Titan II塔脐带的大型斜臂样式的顶端。脐带带有一根可伸缩延长管，长度可用展开限制滑块调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized giant-sized round launch plate for the new TantaresLV N1 rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为新的TantaresLV N1火箭专门设计的巨型圆形发射板。它与发射台面齐平；将深色的下部埋到VAB地面以下即可确保位置正确。发射板上装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized launch stand for the Atlas SLV and derivatives from Bluedog Design Bureau, based on the real launch mount that the Atlas used. The stand has 8 color options, and the clamp arms and side umbilicals have 2 color options. The side umbilicals and Atlas pipe connectors can be toggled off for use with other 1.875m diameter rockets. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为Bluedog Design Bureau的Atlas SLV及其衍生型号专门设计的发射支架，参照Atlas当年真实使用的发射支座制作。支架有8种配色，夹具臂与侧脐带有2种配色。侧脐带与Atlas管路接头可以关闭，以便用于其他直径1.875米的火箭。支架还装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized module designed to allow the docking of two separate spacecraft to either end of this module. In addition to mating spacecraft, it provides additional living/working space, as well as a platform for experiments. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 专用舱段，可让两艘独立飞船分别对接在其两端。除连接飞船外，它还提供额外的生活/工作空间，以及一个实验平台。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A specialized rectangular launch plate designed for Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy-style rockets. Insert sections can be turned off for Falcon Heavy/tri-core rockets. The plate can accomodate the Large General Fallback Tower, attached to the node on the wider side of the plate. Use the Medium General Drop-Arm Hold-Downs for Falcon 9-sized (2.5m) rockets. There is also a special tower attach node for the Shuttle FSS Tower with Rodan Crew Arm. The plate also has rotattion options, to enable proper rotation of a non-square launch clamps. The plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为猎鹰9号与猎鹰重型式火箭专门设计的矩形发射板。对猎鹰重型/三芯级火箭可关闭插入段。发射板可承载大型通用后倒塔，装在板体较宽一侧的节点上。猎鹰9号尺寸（2.5米）火箭请使用中型通用垂臂式压紧装置。另有一处专用塔架附着节点，供带Rodan乘员臂的航天飞机FSS塔使用。发射板还提供旋转选项，便于非正方形发射夹具正确转向。发射板上装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized rectangular launch plate for the new TantaresLV Energia rocket. It sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为新的TantaresLV能源号火箭专门设计的矩形发射板。它与发射台面齐平；将深色的下部埋到VAB地面以下即可确保位置正确。发射板上装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized service tower for the Delta IV, styled after the actual Delta IV Fixed Service Tower at the Cape. It has two height options, default Delta IV height and a 6m extended variant. The front part of the upper external trusswork can be turned off, which all replaces the default Delta IV swing arm nodes with 7 general-type nodes. The base frame has no colliders on it, so it can be pushed under the VAB floor to help align the tower with the Delta IV rocket. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔4号专用服务塔，造型仿照卡纳维拉尔角真实的德尔塔4号固定服务塔。有两种高度选项：默认的德尔塔4号高度，以及加长6米的变体。上部外置钢架的前部可以关闭，关闭后原本的德尔塔4号摆臂节点会全部替换为7个通用型节点。基座框架没有碰撞体，因此可以推到VAB地面以下，帮助塔架与德尔塔4号火箭对齐。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas I and II rocket. The tower section has 4 height options and 9 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Centaur I/II Umbilical Arms, which attach to the two nodes on the sides of the tower. The Atlas I/II Wind Damper Arm attaches to the lower center node. The uppermost node on the Mast 3 pipe is for a drop umbilical, there is a specialized Atlas I/II umbilical available but the general umbilicals will work also. There are also optional general arm attach nodes. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为Atlas I与II火箭专门设计的单件式服务塔。塔节有4种高度选项，另有9种配色。需搭配独立的Atlas-Centaur I/II脐带臂，两条臂附着在塔侧的两个节点上。Atlas I/II防风缓冲臂附着在较低处的中央节点上。3号桅杆管路上的最高节点用于垂降脐带，可选配专用的Atlas I/II脐带，通用脐带同样可用。另有可选的通用摆臂附着节点。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas-Agena rocket. The tower section has 6 height options. The tower has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Agena Umbilical Arm, which attaches to the node on the cut-out on the front of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为Atlas-Agena火箭专门设计的单件式服务塔。塔节有6种高度选项。塔架另有8种配色。需搭配独立的Atlas-Agena脐带臂，该臂附着在塔前部凹口处的节点上。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialized single-piece service tower for the Atlas-SLV Centaur D rocket. The tower section has 5 height options. The tower has 9 color options as well. Uses the separate Atlas-Centaur Umbilical Arms, which attaches to the node on the top of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 为Atlas-SLV半人马座D火箭专门设计的单件式服务塔。塔节有5种高度选项。塔架另有9种配色。需搭配独立的Atlas-Centaur脐带臂，该臂附着在塔顶节点上。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty launch stand for the Aerobee and other small sounding rockets, inspired by two versions of the real Aerobee launch tower. The Aerobee was indeed placed inside the tower onto a rail. This is actually a launch clamp, and the clamp parts can be turned off for a better look. The tower has both triangular and square styles with multiple height variants. The launch rail inside is purely cosmetic with no collider, and its position can be adjusted with the slider. The optional cover structure has 4 height variants. Tower has 9 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Aerobee及其他小型探空火箭的专用发射支架，灵感取自真实Aerobee发射塔的两种版本。当年Aerobee确实是连同导轨一起被放进塔内的。本件实际上是一种发射夹具，夹具部分可以关闭，以获得更干净的外观。塔架有三角形与方形两种样式，各有多档高度变体。内部发射导轨纯属装饰，没有碰撞体，其位置可用滑块调节。可选的外罩结构有4种高度变体。塔架有9种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty launch stand for the Delta IV rocket, both the single and triple-core versions. By default it is set up for the Delta IV from Bluedog Design Bureau, which has 3.125m diameter core tanks. By adjusting the positions and width of the umbilical masts and hold-down posts with the deploy limit sliders, tank sizes of 2.5m can be accomodated as well. The stand is designed to sit flush on the launch pad surface, so move the stand down until the dark band on the bottom of the large corner support columns is on or slightly extending into the floor of the VAB. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Delta IV Service Tower for the full LC-37 Delta IV recreation. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔4号火箭的专用发射支架，单芯级与三芯级版本均可用。默认按Bluedog Design Bureau的德尔塔4号设定，其芯级贮箱直径3.125米。用展开限制滑块调节脐带桅杆与压紧立柱的位置和宽度后，也可兼容2.5米的贮箱尺寸。支架设计为与发射台面平齐，因此可把支架下移，直到四角大支撑柱底部的深色环带落在VAB地面之上或略微嵌入地面。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。搭配德尔塔4号服务塔使用，即可完整复现LC-37的德尔塔4号工位。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty launch stand for the Titan III and Titan IV, inspired by the real one. The center section can be switched between Titan II style (flat) and Titan IV style (elevated). Integrated hold-down bolts in short and tall variants for both the core and side boosters can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders or separately turned off. The 4-corner support columns and the side wheels can be separately turned on/off. Special attach nodes for the Titan III Auxiliary Mast and Service Tower are located on the stand proper; other attach nodes are also available. The stand also has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources, and 8 color options are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 泰坦III与泰坦IV的专用发射支架，灵感取自真实的同类设施。中央段可在Titan II样式（平置）与Titan IV样式（抬高）之间切换。芯级与侧助推器各自都有短款与高款内置压紧螺栓，可用展开限制滑块调节，也可分别关闭。四角支撑立柱与侧轮可分别开启或关闭。泰坦III辅助桅杆与服务塔的专用附着节点位于支架本体上；另有其他附着节点可用。支架还装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源，并有8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty round node-attached launch clamp designed for the Redstone rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau, but also with optional hold-down bolt positions for standard 1.25m and 1.5m fuel tanks. There is also an integrated version of the Redstone Umbilical Pole, available in 6 heights at either 1.25m and 1.5m tank positions. The pole is dropped with the launch clamp release. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 圆形专用节点式发射夹具，为Bluedog Design Bureau的Redstone火箭设计，同时也提供针对标准1.25米与1.5米燃料箱的压紧螺栓位置选项。还集成了Redstone脐带立柱，在1.25米与1.5米贮箱位置各有6种高度可选。夹具释放时立柱随之落下。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty round quad-tripod node-attached launch clamp designed for the Titan II rocket from Bluedog Design Bureau. It's meant to sit flush with the top of the static launch pad, so move the stand down until the bottom edge is just below the floor of the VAB. The hold-down bolts on the top blocks have configurations for the BDB LR-87 engine or standard 1.875m tanks. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Titan II Service Tower and Titan II Crew Elevator for the full LC-19 recreation. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 圆形专用四组三脚架式节点发射夹具，为Bluedog Design Bureau的Titan II火箭设计。它应与静态发射台的台面平齐，因此可将其下移，直到底缘略微低于VAB地面。顶部块体上的压紧螺栓有对应BDB的LR-87发动机或标准1.875米贮箱的配置。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。搭配Titan II服务塔与Titan II乘员升降机使用，即可完整复现LC-19工位。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A specialty square node-attached launch clamp designed for the Vanguard and Scout rockets from Bluedog Design Bureau. The hold-down structure in the center has configurations for the BDB Vanguard shrouded engine (2 types), bare engine/0.9375m tank and 1.25m tank; the structure can also be turned off so other hold-downs can be used instead. Optional nodes for the separate Redstone Umbilical Pole can be turned on. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. Use with the Vanguard Service Tower for the full LC-18A recreation. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 正方形专用节点式发射夹具，为Bluedog Design Bureau的Vanguard与Scout火箭设计。中央的压紧结构有对应BDB Vanguard带整流罩发动机（2种）、裸机/0.9375米贮箱以及1.25米贮箱的配置；该结构也可关闭，以便改用其他压紧装置。用于安装独立Redstone脐带立柱的可选节点可以开启。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。搭配Vanguard服务塔使用，即可完整复现LC-18A工位。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A stackable part containing two parachutes. One drogue, one main. Ensure you properly configure it to work with your craft. Can be resized in the PAW. From RealChute mod
zh: 内含两具降落伞的可堆叠部件，一具减速伞、一具主伞。请确认已正确配置以配合你的飞行器使用。尺寸可在 PAW 中调整。 来自 RealChute mod

en: A staged combustion cycle hypergolic vacuum engine used on the Briz upper stage series. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款用于微风（Briz）上面级系列的分级燃烧循环自燃推进剂真空发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion engine developed as part of an initiative to build a 150-ton-thrust booster engine for the N1. The NK-15 powered the N1, and the NK-33 was developed to power the upgraded N1F. Though the N1F was scrapped, the engines survived and were sold to Aerojet in the 1990s. Refurbished as AJ26-62 engines, they powered Antares. Modifications made by Aerojet included increasing thrust and adding gimbals. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这是为 N1 研制 150 吨推力助推发动机的计划所开发的分级燃烧发动机。NK-15 为 N1 提供动力，NK-33 则为升级的 N1F 研制。虽然 N1F 被废弃，但发动机保存了下来，并于 1990 年代卖给 Aerojet。经翻新为 AJ26-62 发动机后，它们为 Antares 提供动力。Aerojet 所做的改动包括提高推力与加装万向架。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion engine found on the second stage of the UR-200 and third stage of the UR-500/Proton series launcher. It is fixed, and requires its accompanying vernier module for 3-axis control. It uses UDMH & NTO for propellant. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款见于 UR-200 第二级与 UR-500/质子号系列运载器第三级的分级燃烧发动机。它是固定安装的，需要配套的游动发动机模块来实现三轴控制。推进剂为偏二甲肼与四氧化二氮。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion hydrolox engine intended for the N-1M, considered for Proton and Angara, and eventually licensed to India for its GSLV. Later versions were developed by India for domestic use as the CE-7.5. The main engine bell is fixed in place and two verniers provide combined pitch-yaw-roll control. This engine runs with a somewhat higher than average O/F ratio, resulting in a denser than average hydrolox stage. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 一款分级燃烧循环的氢氧发动机，原为 N-1M 准备，也曾考虑用于质子号与安加拉号，最终授权给印度用于其 GSLV。后续型号由印度自行发展为 CE-7.5。主发动机喷管固定安装，两台游标发动机提供俯仰—偏航—滚转的联合控制。该发动机的氧燃比高于一般水平，使氢氧级的密度高于同类。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: A staged combustion hypergolic rocket engine. Used as a power plant on the first stage of the UR-200 rocket, with 3 RD-0203s and 1 RD-0204 forming a RD-0202 engine module. Features a two-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂火箭发动机。它作为 UR-200 火箭第一级的动力装置，由 3 台 RD-0203 与 1 台 RD-0204 组成一个 RD-0202 发动机模块。具有双轴万向机构用于姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion hypergolic vacuum rocket engine used as a power plant on the second stage of the Proton launch vehicle family. Features a one-axis gimbal mechanism for attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机，作为质子号运载火箭系列第二级的动力装置。具有单轴万向机构用于姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion kerolox booster engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was the basis for the NK-15 used on the N1, and the NK-33 used today. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫 GR-1 项目设计的分级燃烧煤油液氧助推发动机。它是 N1 所用 NK-15 与今日所用 NK-33 的基础。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion kerolox upper/vacuum engine designed by Kuznetsov for the Korolev GR-1 project. It was reused (as NK-19) on the N1 and upgraded for the N1F with restart capability as NK-31. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 由库兹涅佐夫为科罗廖夫 GR-1 项目设计的分级燃烧煤油液氧上面级/真空发动机。它被沿用于 N1（称 NK-19），并为 N1F 升级为具备重启能力的 NK-31。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion sustainer engine developed for the USAF ISINGLASS spaceplane. After the ISINGLASS project was cancelled, it was adapted by P&W for their SSME proposal. It utilized staged combustion, mixture control, and extendable nozzles to allow for versatility and high performance. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为美国空军 ISINGLASS 空天飞机研制的分级燃烧主级发动机。ISINGLASS 项目取消后，P&W 将其改用于自家的 SSME 方案。它采用分级燃烧、混合比控制与可延伸喷管，兼顾通用性与高性能。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A staged combustion, hypergolic vacuum rocket engine. Used as the power plant on the second stage of the UR-200, and third stage of UR-500/Proton launch vehicle family. Features four integrated vernier engines for three-axis attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款分级燃烧自燃推进剂真空火箭发动机。它作为 UR-200 第二级以及 UR-500/质子号运载火箭系列第三级的动力装置。带四台一体化游动发动机用于三轴姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A stand-alone mini milkstool part for use with launch plates and launch bases, to raise a rocket up off the deck of the base or plate. Has 8 color options. Use with the separate hold-downs. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 独立的迷你挤奶凳零件，可与发射板及发射基座搭配，把火箭从基座或板面上垫高。有8种配色。请搭配独立的压紧装置使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A standalone launch clamp version of the Saturn "Milkstool", with two height variants: the regular tall version and an alternate short one, both with two color options. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support pads, which can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. The railings on the ring can also be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星“挤奶凳”的独立发射夹具版本，有两种高度变体：常规高款与替代矮款，两者各有两种配色。顶部中央圆环有多套可切换的压紧臂支撑垫，可用展开限制滑块做水平调节。圆环上的栏杆也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A strap-on booster, improved from the Castor 4A and first tested May 1992. Its 30% performance increase would improve capacity of Atlas IIAS, H-II, and other vehicles. First flight 2001. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 由 Castor 4A 改进而来的捆绑助推器，1992 年 5 月首次试车。性能提升 30%，可提高宇宙神 IIAS、H-II 及其他运载器的运力。2001 年首飞。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: A sturdy retracting landing leg, perfect for landing on other bodies. This part has multiple options to choose the design of the legs. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 坚固的可收起着陆腿，非常适合在其他天体上着陆。此部件提供多种选项以选择着陆腿样式。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A surface mount Telemetry Antenna. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 表面安装式遥测天线。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising medium rockets up from the ground. Has three height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 1.875m or 2.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 高型节点式发射夹具，用于把中型火箭从地面抬起。有三种高度变体与8种配色。顶部的压紧螺栓可对应1.875米或2.5米直径的火箭，分竖向与横向两种样式；螺栓也可关闭。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising small rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.9375, 1.25m or 1.5m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 高型节点式发射夹具，用于把小型火箭从地面抬起。有两种高度变体与8种配色。顶部的压紧螺栓可对应0.9375米、1.25米或1.5米直径的火箭，分竖向与横向两种样式；螺栓也可关闭。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A tall node-attached launch clamp for raising tiny rockets up from the ground. Has two height variants and 8 color options. The hold-down bolts at the top can be configured for 0.3125m or 0.625m diameter rockets, with vertical or horizontal styles; the bolts can also be turned off. The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 高型节点式发射夹具，用于把微型火箭从地面抬起。有两种高度变体与8种配色。顶部的压紧螺栓可对应直径0.3125米或0.625米的火箭，分竖向与横向两种样式；螺栓也可关闭。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A three-person pod. Comes with built-in RCS thrusters running off NTO/MMH and a small battery. Heat shield required for safe reentry. Center of mass can be offset to allow lifting reentry (toggle Descent Mode). From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 三人返回舱。内置使用 NTO/MMH 的 RCS 推力器与一块小电池。安全再入需要热防护罩。可偏置质心以实现升力再入（切换「下降模式」）。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: A throttleable rocket engine designed to turn the MiG-21 into a super-high-performance rocket interceptor. It proved successful in tests, but the destruction of the only prototype due to an engine explosion and the increasing performance of jet-powered aircraft led to the project being abandoned. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款可节流火箭发动机，旨在把米格-21 改造成超高性能的火箭截击机。它在试验中表现成功，但唯一的样机因发动机爆炸而损毁，加之喷气动力飞机性能不断提高，最终导致项目被放弃。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A tiny set of wheel for autonomous rovers From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 用于自主漫游车的超小型车轮组。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: A two chamber version of Gamma, used for the second stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. As the only Gamma not required to operate at sea level, the nozzles were extended to allow better expansion. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Gamma 的双燃烧室型号，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第二级。作为唯一不要求海平面工作的 Gamma，其喷管被加长以获得更好的膨胀。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A two-person pod. Features an offset Center of Mass to allow lifting reentry and an integrated bi-propellant Attitude Control System (ACS) for controlled reentries. Heat shield rated for LEO reentries. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 双人座舱。具备偏置质心以便进行升力再入，并集成双组元姿态控制系统（ACS）以实现可控再入。隔热罩可在近地轨道再入。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: A very early Soviet rocket engine, designed by Glushko in 1936 for use on the KR-212 cruise missile, and modified for the rocket aircraft RP-318. It was the first reliable, regeneratively cooled rocket. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款非常早期的苏联火箭发动机，1936 年由格鲁什科为 KR-212 巡航导弹设计，后改装用于 RP-318 火箭飞机。它是第一台可靠工作的再生冷却火箭发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A very early kerolox gas generator booster engine used on the Vanguard launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一种很早的煤油/液氧燃气发生器循环助推发动机，用于先锋（Vanguard）运载火箭。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: A very expensive and fragile, but also very light tank. Balloon tanks are expensive and complex as they need to be pressurized at all times, but they are much lighter than regular tanks. These are similar to tanks used on the Atlas and Centaur stages. The first balloon tanks are 73% lighter than Al stringer conventional structure tanks while costing 150% more to tool and 60% more once tooled. Min Utilization: 99% - Max Utilization: 100% From ROTanks mod
zh: 一种非常昂贵、非常脆弱，但又非常轻的贮箱。气球式贮箱必须始终增压，因此既贵又复杂，但比常规贮箱轻得多。它们与宇宙神（Atlas）和半人马座（Centaur）级上使用的贮箱类似。最早的气球式贮箱比铝制桁条常规结构贮箱轻 73%，但工装成本高 150%，工装完成后成本高 60%。 最低利用率：99% - 最高利用率：100% 来自 ROTanks mod

en: A very expensive and fragile, but also very light tank. Balloon tanks are expensive and complex as they need to be pressurized at all times, but they are much lighter than regular tanks. These are similar to tanks used on the Atlas and Centaur stages. The first balloon tanks are 73% lighter than Al stringer conventional structure tanks while costing 150% more to tool and 60% more once tooled. Min Utilization: 99% - Max Utilization: 100% From RealFuels mod
zh: 一种极为昂贵且脆弱，但同样非常轻的罐体。气球罐造价高昂、结构复杂，因为必须始终保持增压，但比常规罐体轻得多。它们与 Atlas 和 Centaur 级段上使用的罐体类似。首批气球罐比铝制桁条常规结构罐轻 73%，但加工成本高 150%，加工完成后成本高 60%。 最低利用率：99% - 最高利用率：100% 来自 RealFuels mod

en: A very low profile minimalist round launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 极低矮的极简圆形发射夹具基座，发射板与发射台面齐平；将深色的下部埋到VAB地面以下即可确保位置正确。发射板上装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A very low profile minimalist square launch clamp base, the launch plate sits flush with the launch pad; put the dark lower section under the VAB floor to ensure proper positioning. Square or rectangular exhust hole configurations can be selected. The Plate has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 极低矮的极简方形发射夹具基座，发射板与发射台面齐平；将深色的下部埋到VAB地面以下即可确保位置正确。排气孔可选方形或矩形配置。发射板上装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A very slim and tapered fallback-type service tower. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has only one 15m height option and two color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted up-and-down with a deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals can be adjusted vertically separately from the clamp, and can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit slider, or be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 极为纤细、上端收窄的后倒式服务塔。后倒收回有两种方式：一种是简单的一步式，整座塔完全收回，仅由分级触发；另一种是两步手动方式，可在发射前先将塔体少量收回，起飞时再单独完成后倒收回。塔体只有一种15米高度选项，配色有2种。上夹具提供三种尺寸，也可关闭，可用展开限制滑块上下调节。固定脐带可脱离夹具单独做竖向调节，长度可用其展开限制滑块调节，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: A.K.A. RD-63, 8D63. Verniers for R-16 first stage. testedBurnTime=400
zh: 又名 RD-63、8D63。R-16 第一级的游动发动机。testedBurnTime=400

en: A.K.A. RD-64, 8D64. Verniers for R-16 second stage. testedBurnTime=400
zh: 又名 RD-64、8D64。R-16 第二级的游动发动机。testedBurnTime=400

en: A.K.A. RD-68, 8D68. Verniers for R-36 first stage. testedBurnTime=400
zh: 又名 RD-68、8D68。R-36 第一级的游动发动机。testedBurnTime=400

en: A.K.A. RD-69, 8D69. Verniers for R-36 and Tsyklon second stage. testedBurnTime=400
zh: 又名 RD-69、8D69。R-36 与旋风号第二级的游动发动机。testedBurnTime=400

en: AJ10 variant burning liquid hydrogen and oxygen, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 燃烧液氢液氧的 AJ10 变体，曾提议用于 GE D-2 型 Apollo 飞船。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: AJ23-128, First stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built before May 1960. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-128，1960 年 5 月之前制造的泰坦 I 洲际弹道导弹第一级发动机。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-129, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built before May 1960. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-129，1960 年 5 月之前制造的泰坦 I 洲际弹道导弹第二级发动机。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-130, First stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built after May 1960. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-130，1960 年 5 月之后制造的泰坦 I 洲际弹道导弹第一级发动机。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-131, second stage engine for Titan I ICBMs built after May 1960. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-131，1960 年 5 月之后制造的泰坦 I 洲际弹道导弹第二级发动机。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-132, First stage engine of Titan II. Modified to burn Aerozine50 and Nitrogen Tetroxide to allow storage for long periods of time. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-132，泰坦 II 的第一级发动机。改烧混肼 50 与四氧化二氮，以便长期贮存。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-133, second stage engine of Titan II. Modified to burn Aerozine50 and Nitrogen Tetroxide to allow storage for long periods of time. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-133，泰坦 II 的第二级发动机。改烧混肼 50 与四氧化二氮，以便长期贮存。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-135, second stage engine of Titan II GLV. Modified for the Gemini program to reduce chances of failure and make the engine safer. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-135，泰坦 II GLV 的第二级发动机。为双子座计划做了改动，以降低故障概率、提高发动机安全性。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-136, First stage engine for Titan IIIA, IIIB and IIIC. Longer burn time and slightly higher performance for the stretched fuel tank of Titan III. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-136，泰坦 IIIA、IIIB 与 IIIC 的第一级发动机。为泰坦 III 加长的贮箱提供更长燃烧时间与略高性能。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-137, second stage engine for Titan IIIA, IIIB and IIIC. Longer burn time and slightly higher performance for the stretched fuel tank of Titan III. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-137，泰坦 IIIA、IIIB 与 IIIC 的第二级发动机。为泰坦 III 加长的贮箱提供更长燃烧时间与略高性能。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-139, First stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Modified to light in midair, since the UA120x boosters used by Titan III could lift Titan without assistance. Ignited just before booster burnout. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-139，泰坦 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 与 IIIE 的第一级发动机。改为空中点火，因为泰坦 III 所用的 UA120x 助推器已能把泰坦抬起来。点火时刻就在助推器燃尽之前。testedBurnTime=350

en: AJ23-140, second stage engine for Titan 24B, 34B, IIIBS, IIID, 34D, 34D7 and IIIE. Slightly improved performance. testedBurnTime=350
zh: AJ23-140，泰坦 24B、34B、IIIBS、IIID、34D、34D7 与 IIIE 的第二级发动机。性能略有提高。testedBurnTime=350

en: AKA RD-56M. Upgraded model of the RD-56. Never saw use in the USSR, but was sold to India, and later license built in India. Poor overall reliability testedBurnTime=1600
zh: 又名 RD-56M，是 RD-56 的升级型号。在苏联从未实际使用，但卖给了印度，后来在印度按许可证生产。整体可靠性较差 testedBurnTime=1600
APAS 89/95 主动对接端口（已弃用）（已弃用）
APAS 89/95 被动对接端口（已弃用）（已弃用）

en: Abort motor for block I D-2 configuration. Attach to the decoupler in 4x symmetry around base of vehicle. From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: Block I 构型 D-2 的逃逸发动机。以 4 重对称方式安装在飞行器底部的分离器上。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: Add-on multi-configurable platform for the N1 Tower, which didn't use swing arms or umbilicals as it was not a launch tower. There are 2 size and 5 length variants for the main structure. The walkway has 4 styles, and can be extended in length with the slider. Optional top railings are available as well, and all railings have 9 color options. The walkway can be retracted by staging or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: N1塔架的附加多配置平台。N1塔并非发射塔，因此没有摆臂与脐带。主体结构有2种尺寸与5种长度变体。走道有4种样式，可用滑块延长。还可选配顶部栏杆，所有栏杆均有9种配色。走道可分级收回，也可手动或通过动作组收回。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Large size rail, meant for larger rockets of size 1.25m and up. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 发射基座与支架的附加零件，提供一条可旋转的发射导轨，用于斜发射火箭。这是大型导轨，适用于1.25米及以上的较大火箭。火箭仅以表面附着方式固定在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认正向与反向之间切换。旋转导轨可用B9PD切换器完成；若装有Animated Attachment，也可改用展开限制滑块的动画方式。使用Animated Attachment方式时，要求导轨或发射基座/支架为根部件才能带动已附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨本身不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨正向可旋转100度，反向可旋转20度。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Medium size rail, meant for larger rockets of size 0.937m and up. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 发射基座与支架的附加零件，提供一条可旋转的发射导轨，用于斜发射火箭。这是中型导轨，适用于0.937米及以上的较大火箭。火箭仅以表面附着方式固定在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认正向与反向之间切换。旋转导轨可用B9PD切换器完成；若装有Animated Attachment，也可改用展开限制滑块的动画方式。使用Animated Attachment方式时，要求导轨或发射基座/支架为根部件才能带动已附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨本身不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨正向可旋转100度，反向可旋转20度。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Mini size rail (actually a rod), sized for 0.3125m and 0.625m rockets; the rod can be moved with the deploy limit slider. Rockets can be only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has a built-in decoupler. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 发射基座与支架的附加零件，提供一条可旋转的发射导轨，用于斜发射火箭。这是迷你导轨（实际上是一根杆），对应0.3125米与0.625米的火箭；该杆可用展开限制滑块移动。火箭仅以表面附着方式固定在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。旋转导轨可用B9PD切换器完成；若装有Animated Attachment，也可改用展开限制滑块的动画方式。使用Animated Attachment方式时，要求导轨或发射基座/支架为根部件才能带动已附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨本身不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨正向可旋转100度，反向可旋转20度。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Add-on part for launch bases and stands that provides a rotatable launch rail for angled launching of rockets. This is the Small size rail, meant for smaller rockets. Rockets are only surface-attached to the rail, and the rail has built-in a decoupler. The rail can also be switched between the default forward direction and reverse. Rotating the rail can be done with the B9PD switcher or optionally with Animated Attachment installed via the deploy limit slider animation. The Animated Attachment method requires that the rail or launch base/stand be the root part in order to move the attached rocket. The rail part however can not be the root part after rotation or it will not decouple from the rocket. The rail can be rotated 100 degrees in the forward direction or 20 degrees in the reverse direction. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 发射基座与支架的附加零件，提供一条可旋转的发射导轨，用于斜发射火箭。这是小型导轨，适用于较小的火箭。火箭仅以表面附着方式固定在导轨上，导轨内置分离器。导轨还可在默认正向与反向之间切换。旋转导轨可用B9PD切换器完成；若装有Animated Attachment，也可改用展开限制滑块的动画方式。使用Animated Attachment方式时，要求导轨或发射基座/支架为根部件才能带动已附着的火箭。但旋转后导轨本身不能作为根部件，否则将无法与火箭分离。导轨正向可旋转100度，反向可旋转20度。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Aerodynamic cover for the Mk2 Command Module. Provides protection from the aerodynamic forces inside the dense parts of the atmosphere and from the LES exhaust in the case of an emergency. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: Mk2 指令舱的气动整流罩。在大气稠密段提供气动防护，紧急情况下还能挡住发射逃逸系统（LES）的尾焰。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: Aerodynamic nosecone used on Apollo Block I, since docking missions weren't planned until Block II. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo Block I 上使用的气动头锥，因为直到 Block II 才计划执行对接任务。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Aerojet developed the LR87 engine (used for the Titan series) into a liquid hydrogen/oxygen engine for prospective USAF contracts in the 1958-1960 period, at the same time Aerojet was converting the LR87 to burn Aerozine and NTO. Aerojet also proposed this engine for Saturn upper stage duties, but NASA selected the J-2 over the LR87-LH2 and it was canceled in 1961. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1958 至 1960 年间，Aerojet 把（用于泰坦系列的）LR87 发动机发展为液氢液氧发动机，以争取美国空军的潜在合同；同一时期 Aerojet 也在把 LR87 改为烧混肼与四氧化二氮。Aerojet 还曾提议用该发动机承担土星上面级任务，但 NASA 选择了 J-2 而非 LR87-LH2，项目于 1961 年取消。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: After receiving complaints that their previous product was far too tall, Rockomax Conglomerate created a shorter variant, letting the Rockomax Conglomerate avoid the inevitable lawsuits from rocket builders everywhere. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 在收到「上一款产品实在太高了」的抱怨之后，Rockomax 联合体推出了较矮的版本，从而让自己躲过了各地火箭制造者必然提起的诉讼。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: After several unfortunate mishaps with confusing signage on spacecraft, The Peel-N-Stik™ Corporation teamed up with Kerland-Mutani to unveil the Semiotic Standard for Kerbal Vessels, a set of standardized icons for use on ships and stations. (Based on the work of Ron Cobb) From Conformal Decals mod
zh: 在航天器上因标识难懂而接连发生几起不幸事故之后，Peel-N-Stik™公司与Kerland-Mutani联手推出了坎巴拉载具符号学标准——一套用于飞船与空间站的标准图标。（基于Ron Cobb的作品）来自 Conformal Decals mod

en: After the fervorous response from fans, Rockomax has decide to up the ante with the Extra-Large Rockomax HubMax Multi-Point Connector, seamlessly integrating 2.5 meter parts on a very large hub. Unfortunately, no one died of shock that day. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 在粉丝的热烈反响之后，Rockomax 决定加码，推出超大型 Rockomax HubMax 多点连接件，在一个巨大的枢纽上无缝整合 2.5 米部件。遗憾的是，那天没人被震惊死。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: Agena D HDA. Converted to use high density acid oxidizer to increase performance. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown. testedBurnTime=640
zh: Agena D HDA。改用高密度酸氧化剂以提升性能。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。testedBurnTime=640

en: Agena upgrade for proposed Atlas V upper stage. Tested, but cancelled when studies showed it would be more economical to use single engine centaur instead. testedBurnTime=3600
zh: 为拟议中的 Atlas V 上面级研制的 Agena 升级型。经过试车，但因研究表明改用单台发动机的 Centaur 上面级更经济而被取消。testedBurnTime=3600

en: Air tight pressure hull protected by a thick layer of Kevlar and carbon nanofiber blankets to provide protection against micro-meteorites as well as thermal insulation and limited radiation shielding. These parts provide safe and structurally intact internal spaces to allow crew to move between crewed parts. From Procedural Parts mod
zh: 气密耐压壳体，外覆厚层 Kevlar 与碳纳米纤维毡，可抵御微流星体，同时提供隔热和有限辐射屏蔽。这类部件提供安全且结构完整的内部空间，使乘员能在各载人部件之间移动。 来自 Procedural Parts mod

en: Alouette 1 and 2 were the first Canadian satellites launched in 1962 and 1963 with the purpose of studying the upper ionospheric layers of the Earth. From SXT mod
zh: 「云雀」1 号与 2 号是加拿大 1962 年与 1963 年发射的首批卫星，用于研究地球电离层上层。 来自 SXT mod

en: Also known as the Payload Assistance Module (PAM) B, this kick motor was used for Delta and STS launches to add extra impulse to the payload. This is the short-nozzle version. Maximum thrust 76.11kN, burn time 85 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 又称有效载荷辅助模块 B（PAM B），这台末助推发动机用于德尔塔与航天飞机（STS）发射，为有效载荷提供额外冲量。本型号为短喷管版本。最大推力 76.11kN，燃烧时间 85 秒。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Alternative Dynasoar cockpit, with a rounded nose. Dynasoar (short for "Dynamic Soarer") was an early USAF spaceplane, intended to function as a station tender, reconnaissance craft, and nuclear bomber. Designed for "Dynamic Soaring", dipping deep into the atmosphere and using aerodynamic manuevers to skip back out, or change it's orbit. This would have allowed it to make passes as low as 50 km for precision reconnaissance or bombing before returning to orbit. Although Dynasoar's hot structure TPS made it relatively durable, the same cannot be said of it's Transtage propulsion, so atmospheric manuevers are to be performed at your own risk. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: DynaSoar 的另一种座舱，机头为圆弧形。DynaSoar（“Dynamic Soarer”的简称）是美国空军早期的一款航天飞机，原本打算用作空间站勤务艇、侦察机和核轰炸机。它按“动力滑翔”思路设计，会深入大气层，再用气动机动跳跃出去或改变轨道。这样一来，它就能在返回轨道之前以低至 50 km 的高度掠过，进行精确侦察或投弹。虽然 DynaSoar 的热结构 TPS 让它相对耐用，但其 Transtage 推进系统就没那么可靠了，因此在大气层内进行机动请自行承担风险。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Although still using analog transmitters, improvements in miniaturization allow for practical communication out to the moon. Idle power: 0.3 watts. (TL0 consumes 2 watts at idle.) NOTE: You must purchase this upgrade here before you can use it.
zh: 虽然仍使用模拟发射机，但小型化方面的进步使通信可实用地覆盖到月球。待机功率：0.3 瓦。（TL0 待机时消耗 2 瓦。）注意：你必须在此处购买该升级后才能使用它。

en: Americanized version of the V-2 Model 39 (A-4). It was very similar to its predecessor, but was built using American SAE components rather than metric components, and featured several minor upgrades. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: V-2 39 型（A-4）的美国化版本。它与前身十分相似，但改用美国 SAE 标准零件而非公制零件，并做了若干小幅改进。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An M-1x1 panel, cut in half along the diagonal. For structural designers who are too hip to be square. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: M-1x1 面板沿对角线切成两半。专为不屑于方方正正的结构设计师准备。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: An ablative heat shield that goes on the bottom of the Orion pod. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 装在 Orion 座舱底部的烧蚀隔热罩。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: An adapter that connects your Standard C.O.S. into the standard 0.625m frame. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 把标准 C.O.S. 接入标准 0.625 m 规格框架的适配器。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: An adapter that connects your Standard C.O.S. into the standard Octagonal frame. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 把标准 C.O.S. 接入标准八边形框架的适配器。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: An adjustable landing gear with a single wheel. From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 一款可调节的单轮起落架。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: An adjustable landing gear with a single wheel. This version has heat shielding for orbital use. From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 一款可调节的单轮起落架。此版本带隔热层，可供轨道使用。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: An adjustable landing gear with two wheels and slightly stronger brakes, motor, and default suspension settings. From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 一款可调节的双轮起落架，制动与电机略强，悬挂采用默认设定。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: An adjustable landing gear with two wheels and slightly stronger brakes, motor, and default suspension settings. This version has heat shielding for orbital use. From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 一款可调节的双轮起落架，制动与电机略强，悬挂采用默认设定。此版本带隔热层，可供轨道使用。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: An alternate mini-size modular truss-type service tower for the launch stands and smaller rockets, with 3 height options. Additional tower sections can be stacked to create taller towers, with the base pad turned off. There are also optional platforms available in multiple configurations. The tower section has 8 color options as well. Uses the separate Small Drop Umbilicals which are node-attached to the front of the tower. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 另一种迷你模块化钢架式服务塔，适用于发射支架与较小火箭，有3种高度选项。关闭底座垫板后即可叠放附加塔节，搭出更高的塔。还可选配多种配置的平台。塔节另有8种配色。需搭配独立的小型垂降脐带，该脐带以节点附着方式装在塔的前部。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: An atmospheric booster engine used from the 1980s to present, the RD-170 is the most powerful liquid rocket engine ever flown. Originally developed for the Energia launcher's boosters, the engine consists of four combustion chambers fed by a single turbopump. A modified version, the RD-171, is used on the first stage of the Zenit launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款自 1980 年代沿用至今的大气层助推发动机，RD-170 是史上推力最大的液体火箭发动机。它最初为能源号运载器的助推器研制，由单台涡轮泵供给四个燃烧室。其改进型 RD-171 用于天顶号运载火箭的第一级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early 1950s turbojet, developed from the earlier J35 by General Electric. It powered the F-86, FJ-2, B-36, B-45, and B-48. From SXT mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1950 年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机，由通用电气在早期 J35 基础上发展而来。它驱动了 F-86、FJ-2、B-36、B-45 与 B-48。 来自 SXT mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early 1950s turbojet. Derived from the MetroVick F.2, the first axial-flow jet developed in Britain, the Sapphire powered the Hawker Hunter, Handley Page Victor, and Gloster Javelin. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1950 年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。它源自英国第一台轴流式喷气发动机 MetroVick F.2，「蓝宝石」（Sapphire）驱动了霍克「猎手」、汉德利·佩季「胜利者」与格罗斯特「标枪」。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early 1960s nuclear turbo-ramjet, designed for supersonic bombers. One of the ultimate direct-cycle designs produced by the Aircraft Nuclear Propulsion (ANP) program, the A-136 used a hybrid cycle to improve supersonic performance. By tapping off a small amount of air to cool the turbine, turbine inlet temperatures could be managed, while the remaining air passed straight through the reactor and was heated to full temperature. This gave the engine good performance up to Mach 3. It also included a kerosene burner to improve takeoff thrust. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款 1960 年代初的核动力涡轮冲压发动机，为超声速轰炸机设计。A-136 是飞机核推进（ANP）计划产出的终极直接循环设计之一，采用混合循环来改善超声速性能。它分流少量空气冷却涡轮，从而控制涡轮进口温度，其余空气直接穿过反应堆被加热到最高温度。这使发动机在 3 马赫以内性能良好。它还装有煤油燃烧器以提高起飞推力。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early 1960s small turboprop. Developed for midsize general aviation aircraft, the PT6A was first used on the Beechcraft King Air. It's low cost, low weight, and high reliability led to it becoming one of the most popular turboprop engines ever, with over 60,000 built. It is offered in many large general aviation and small commercial aircraft, and is popular as an upgrade to older piston-engined aircraft. From SXT mod
zh: 1960 年代初的小型涡轮螺桨发动机。PT6A 为中型通用航空飞机研制，最初用于比奇「空中国王」。它成本低、重量轻、可靠性高，因此成为史上最受欢迎的涡轮螺桨发动机之一，产量超过 60,000 台。许多大型通用航空飞机与小型商用飞机都采用它，它也常被用来升级老式活塞发动机飞机。 来自 SXT mod

en: An early 50s turbojet which served as the powerplant for the Su-7, Su-9, Su-11, Tu-128, and Be-10 flying boat. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1950 年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机，是苏-7、苏-9、苏-11、图-128 与别-10 水上飞机的动力装置。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early 50s turbojet. Developed as a scaled down Mikulin AM-3, the RD-9 was designed for fighter aircraft and powered the Yak-25, 26, 27, 28, and MiG-19. It was license-built in China as the WP-6, where it powered the JJ-6, J/F-6, Q/A-5, and J-12. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 1950 年代早期的涡轮喷气发动机。RD-9 由米库林 AM-3 缩小发展而来，为战斗机设计，驱动了雅克-25、26、27、28 与米格-19。中国按许可证仿制为涡喷-6（WP-6），驱动了歼教-6、歼-6、强-5 与歼-12。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An early Soviet four combustion chamber rocket. Developed from the RD-100 for the R-12 IRBM in the mid 1950s, it provided a significant increase in power over earlier Soviet engines. It was later used for the Kosmos-2 launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款苏联早期四燃烧室火箭发动机。它于 1950 年代中期由 RD-100 为 R-12 中程弹道导弹研制而来，功率比苏联早期发动机有显著提升。后来它被用于宇宙-2 运载火箭。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An elongated and slanted nose cone. Useful for solid rocket motors and other radially attached objects. From SXT mod
zh: 加长并带倾角的头锥。适用于固体火箭发动机与其他径向安装的部件。 来自 SXT mod

en: An even larger version of the chemical plant, for housing base-scale ISRU processes. From Kerbalism mod
zh: 化工厂的更大版本，可容纳基地规模的ISRU工艺。来自 Kerbalism mod

en: An even shorter and smaller fallback-type service tower. It has two methods of fallback retraction: A simple one-step type which fully retracts the tower, activated by staging only, and a two-step manual method in which the tower can be first partially retracted by a small amount before launch, followed by a seprate fallback retract for liftoff. The tower has 5 height and two color options. The upper clamp has three size options, or can be turned off, and can be adjusted up-and-down with a deploy limit slider. The fixed umbilicals can be adjusted vertically separately from the clamp, and can be adjusted in length with their deploy limit slider, or be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 更矮小的后倒式服务塔。后倒收回有两种方式：一种是简单的一步式，整座塔完全收回，仅由分级触发；另一种是两步手动方式，可在发射前先将塔体少量收回，起飞时再单独完成后倒收回。塔体有5种高度与2种配色可选。上夹具提供三种尺寸，也可关闭，可用展开限制滑块上下调节。固定脐带可脱离夹具单独做竖向调节，长度可用其展开限制滑块调节，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: An exotic fuel-rich staged combustion vacuum engine. Developed as a high-energy upper stage for Proton by Glushko, the RD-301 burned liquid fluorine and ammonia, which gave very high performance and density. It was tested extensively, but never flew due to toxicity concerns. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 一款特殊的富燃分级燃烧真空发动机。RD-301 由格鲁什科研制，作为质子号的高能上面级，烧液氟与氨，使其性能与推进剂密度都非常高。它经过大量试验，但因毒性顾虑从未飞行。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An extendable omnidirectional antenna. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 可伸展的全向天线。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: An extending dipole antenna used to gather high frequency radar sounding data. Can be used as a communications antenna in a pinch. Attach in a pair to the nodes on the Apollo engine plate. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 可伸长的偶极天线，用于采集高频雷达探测数据。必要时也可用作通信天线。成对安装在 Apollo 发动机板上的节点。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: An innovative multi-purpose design. Allows the storage of multiple and various resources to suit most mission parameters easily accessible by the crew. From SXT mod
zh: 创新性的多用途设计。可贮存多种不同资源，供乘员方便取用，适应大多数任务参数。 来自 SXT mod

en: An innovative multi-purpose design. Allows the storage of multiple and various resources to suit most mission parameters. From SXT mod
zh: 创新性的多用途设计。可贮存多种不同资源，适应大多数任务参数。 来自 SXT mod

en: An open cycle kerolox booster engine developed from LR79/89. It was a backup proposal for the first stage engine on the Titan 1 ICBM, and proposed first stage engine on the Saturn 1, but ultimately never flown (4 E-1s were replaced by 8 H-1s). From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 由 LR79/89 发展而来的开式循环煤油液氧助推发动机。它曾作为泰坦 1 洲际弹道导弹第一级发动机的备份方案，也曾被提议作为土星 1 的第一级发动机，但最终从未上天（4 台 E-1 被 8 台 H-1 取代）。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An upper stage Kerosene/LOX engine designed for new versions of the Soyuz-2 launchers. It will also be used with the Angara family of launchers. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为联盟-2 运载器新版本设计的一款上面级煤油/液氧发动机。它也将用于安加拉运载火箭系列。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: An upper stage kerolox engine designed for the R-9 ICBM and later used on the Molniya, Voskhod. and Soyuz launchers. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为 R-9 洲际弹道导弹设计的一款上面级煤油液氧发动机，后用于闪电号、上升号与联盟号运载器。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Androgynous Peripheral Attach System developed for the Shuttle-Mir program and ISS. This is the active variant, with a deployable capture ring to align the ports and dampen the impact. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 为航天飞机-和平号计划与国际空间站研制的异体同构周边式对接系统。这是主动端变体，带有可展开的捕获环，用于对准对接端口并缓冲撞击。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Androgynous Peripheral Attach System developed for the Shuttle-Mir program and ISS. This is the passive variant, useful for permanent fixtures that won't have to form the active docking partner, such as berthing ports on station modules. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 为航天飞机-和平号计划与国际空间站研制的异体同构周边式对接系统。这是被动端变体，适用于永久固定、无需充当主动对接方的情形，例如空间站舱段上的停泊口。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Androgynous Peripheral Attachment System 75. First fully androgynous docking port, designed for the Apollo Soyuz Test Project. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 异体同构周边式对接装置 75。首个完全异体同构的对接端口，为 Apollo-联盟号试验计划而设计。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Andøya Space Center (formerly Andøya Rakettskytefelt) is a is a rocket launch site, rocket range, and spaceport on Andøya island (the northernmost in the Vesterålen archipelago) in the Andøy Municipality. Since 1962, over 1,200 sounding and sub-orbital rockets of various configurations have been launched from the site.
zh: 安岛航天中心（原名Andøya Rakettskytefelt）是一处集火箭发射场、火箭靶场与航天港于一体的设施，位于安岛市镇的安岛（韦斯特龙群岛中最北端的岛屿）。自1962年以来，该场地已发射了1,200余枚各种构型的探空火箭与亚轨道火箭。

en: Angled base section of the modular Saturn launch tower, with two color options: classic red and new gray. The base has two independent crew elevators, each with four switchable maximum height options; elevators can also be turned off. Adjust the deploy limit of the elevators to make them stop at a lower height than the maximum. Elevators start at the highest point and have to be brought down first. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 模块化土星发射塔的斜角基座段，有两种配色：经典红与新款灰。基座上有两台独立的乘员升降机，各自有四档可切换的最大高度；升降机也可关闭。调节升降机的展开限制，可让它们停在低于最大高度的地方。升降机起始位于最高点，需先降下来。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated "petal" cover used for the deployed Jupiter IRBM sites. It is sized for 1.5m diameter rockets, namely the Jupiter from Bluedog Design Bureau. It attaches to an optional node in the Redstone Launch Stand; adjust the height until the base ring sits on the ground. The opening animation can be be done manually or via staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 动画“花瓣”罩盖，用于部署状态的木星中程弹道导弹阵地。其尺寸对应直径1.5米的火箭，即Bluedog Design Bureau的Jupiter。它附着在Redstone发射支架的一个可选节点上；调节高度直到底环落在地面上即可。开启动画可手动执行，也可由分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated fallback tower for the Thor-Able/Delta rockets, though it was most used with the Able-derived upper stages (Able, Ablestar and Delta). It has three integrated animated drop umbilicals, each with separate color options, and each can be turned off as well. Each umbilical is adjusted vertically and horizontally the associated deploy limit sliders. The tower also has 9 color options. The tower can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. Use with the Thor/Delta Launch Stand for best effect. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Thor-Able/Delta火箭的动画后倒塔，不过它最常搭配的是Able系列衍生上面级（Able、Ablestar与Delta）。塔上集成三条动画垂降脐带，各条可单独配色，也均可关闭。每条脐带可用各自的展开限制滑块做竖向与水平调节。塔架另有9种配色。塔架既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。搭配Thor/Delta发射支架效果最佳。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated general-use truss-type fallback tower with multiple height variants and three integrated animated drop umbilicals. Each umbilical has three size variants and 5 color options, and can be separately moved down up to 15 meters and adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit sliders, and can be turned off as well. The tower also has 8 color options. The tower can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画钢架式后倒塔，有多种高度变体，并集成三条带下垂动画的脐带。每条脐带各有三种尺寸变体与5种配色，可用展开限制滑块分别下移最多15米并作水平调节，也可单独关闭。塔架本身有8种配色。塔架收回既可手动切换动画，也可由分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated retracting clamp arm for the Soyuz Launch Base or other launch base/plate, styled after the actual Soyuz support arms . It surface attaches to the clamp arm pads or the deck of the base, not the auxiliary nodes. There are three color options available. The arm end pad can be adjusted in size with the deploy limit slider. Retraction of the arm can be done manually or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于联盟号发射底座或其他发射底座/发射板的动画收回式压紧臂，外形仿照现实的联盟号支撑臂。它以表面附着方式安装在压紧臂垫或底座甲板上，而非辅助节点。提供三种配色选项。臂端垫的尺寸可用展开限制滑块调节。摆臂收回既可手动完成，也可通过分级完成。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the middle arm, and the umbilicals are placed so they are straddling the bottom of the Centaur stage and the top of the interstage. This arm retracts to the right when looking at the rocket from the tower. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas-Centaur I/II服务塔的动画回收脐带臂。这是中层臂，脐带跨接在半人马座级底部与级间段顶部之间。从塔上望向火箭时，该臂向右收回。臂梁有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the upper arm, and the umbilicals are placed on the flared base of the 4m fairing that was also used with the Atlas V. Alternate straight-on umbilical ends are also available. This arm retracts to the left when looking at the rocket from the tower. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas-Centaur I/II服务塔的动画回收脐带臂。这是上层臂，脐带接在4米整流罩的外扩底部上——该整流罩在Atlas V上也有使用。另提供直插式脐带端头可选。从塔上望向火箭时，该臂向左收回。臂梁有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated retracting wind damper arm for the Atlas-Centaur I/II Service Tower. This is the lower arm, and the end connector is placed just above the bottom of the Atlas I/II interstage. This arm retracts downwards at launch. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas-Centaur I/II服务塔的动画回收防风缓冲臂。这是下层臂，其端头接头位于Atlas I/II级间段底部稍上方。该臂在发射时向下收回。臂梁有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated twin vertical retracting umbilical arms for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 Centaur D rocket. The arms bracket the Centaur stage, with the bottom arm straddling the interdstage-tank division, and the upper arm stradding the tank-fairing junction. Designed to mount on the Atlas-Centaur Service Tower, but can be used with other towers as well. The whole arm frame assembly can be adjusted upward by using the offset gizmo for fine positioning. The upper tall arm (Arm 1) can be adjusted in both horizontal and vertical position using the deploy limit sliders. The lower flat arm can be adjusted horizontally with its slider. The arms and frame also have 8 color options. The arms can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. Use with the Atlas Launch Stand for best effect. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于Atlas SLV-3半人马座D火箭半人马座上面级的动画双联垂直回收脐带臂。两臂夹住半人马座级：下臂跨接在级间段与贮箱的分界处，上臂跨接在贮箱与整流罩的交界处。设计用于装在Atlas-Centaur服务塔上，但也可与其他塔架搭配。整个臂架组件可用偏移工具向上调节，以便精确定位。上方的高臂（1号臂）可用展开限制滑块做水平与竖向位置调节。下方的扁臂可用其滑块做水平调节。两臂与框架另有8种配色。两臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。搭配Atlas发射支架效果最佳。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Atlas-Agena. Designed to mount on the Atlas-Agena Service Tower, but can be used with other towers as well. The arm's umbilical section has two height variants. It has four integrated animated drop umbilicals (with one being a pair), each with separate color options, and each can be turned off as well. Each umbilical is adjusted vertically and horizontally the associated deploy limit sliders. The arm also has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. Use with the Atlas Launch Stand for best effect. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas-Agena的动画垂直回收脐带臂。设计用于装在Atlas-Agena服务塔上，但也可与其他塔架搭配。该臂的脐带段有两种高度变体。臂上集成四条动画垂降脐带（其中一条为成对形式），各条可单独配色，也均可关闭。每条脐带可用各自的展开限制滑块做竖向与水平调节。该臂另有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。搭配Atlas发射支架效果最佳。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Antares III is the third-generation third stage for Vought Corporation's Scout launch vehicle. The design incorporates an 89-percent-solids HTPB propellant in a Kevlar filament-wound case insulated with silica-filled EPDM rubber. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Antares III 是 Vought 公司侦察兵运载火箭的第三代第三级。设计采用 89% 固体含量的 HTPB 推进剂，壳体为 Kevlar 纤维缠绕，并用二氧化硅填充的 EPDM 橡胶绝热。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Apogee kick motor. Modifications: 175 mm straight section added to the Star 17. The 17A has been used for circularized orbits for the Skynet 1, NATO 1, and IMP-H & J satellites. This motor provides the high case safety factor required for this program. The TE-M-521-7 model used for several Air Force missions provides a typical safety factor with a 1.3 pound weight savings. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 远地点发动机。改装内容：在星 17 上加装 175 mm 直筒段。17A 曾用于天网 1、北约 1 以及 IMP-H 与 IMP-J 卫星的圆化轨道。该发动机提供了本计划所需的高壳体安全系数。用于若干空军任务的 TE-M-521-7 型号提供典型安全系数，同时减重 1.3 磅。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。
阿波罗登月舱上升级（已弃用）
阿波罗登月舱下降级（已弃用）

zh: 适用部件：Advanced Command Pod、Gemini Cabin、Big G 乘员舱、Big G 服务舱
Ares LK-S3E 重型行星居住舱

en: As operations in space become more complex, more crew members are needed. This expanded crew module replaces the standard Gemini service module, allowing seven additional crew members to ride to space. To be used with either a modified Apollo Service Module for deep space operations, or the Big Gemini Service Module for LEO operations. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 随着太空作业日益复杂，需要更多乘员。这个扩展乘员舱取代标准的 Gemini 服务舱，可额外搭载 7 名乘员飞向太空。搭配经过改装的 Apollo 服务舱可用于深空任务，搭配 Big Gemini 服务舱则可用于近地轨道任务。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Attach these under each wing. Don’t forget to add them to the GEAR Action group so you can toggle them with the G key. Fiddle with the skid controls at your own risk since they function correctly as is. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 将其分别安装在两侧机翼下方。别忘了把它们加入 GEAR 动作组，这样就可以用 G 键收放。滑橇相关的控制项本身工作正常，若要调整请自行承担风险。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Attach this under the nose. Don’t forget to add this to the GEAR Action group so you can toggle it with the G key. Fiddle with the skid controls at your own risk since they function correctly as is. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 将其安装在机头下方。别忘了把它加入 GEAR 动作组，这样就可以用 G 键收放。滑橇相关的控制项本身工作正常，若要调整请自行承担风险。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: BIG Extra Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Wider than the Sandbox/Tier 3 launch pad static, the support columns will sit in the ground. Has different shapes for 10m, 14m and 18m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. en: Beginning its life as the etholox-powered XLR43-NA-3, this was the first US engine to use tubular-wall construction for its combustion chamber. It served as the basis for early orbital US engines, with its lineage stretching to the 21st century. The LR43 was converted to run on kerosene for Atlas and was later renamed LR89, and the LR79 derivative powered Thor. Later LR89s used RS-27 components for higher efficiency, whereas the RS-27 itself was used on Delta by that point. LR89 configs are comparable to similar-era -79 configs, since they were the same engine underneath. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 它最初是烧乙醇液氧的 XLR43-NA-3，是第一台采用管束壁燃烧室的美国发动机。它成为美国早期入轨发动机的基础，其血脉一直延续到 21 世纪。LR43 改为烧煤油以用于宇宙神，随后更名为 LR89；其衍生型 LR79 则为雷神提供动力。后期 LR89 采用 RS-27 部件以提高效率，而当时 RS-27 本身已用于 Delta。由于底层是同一台发动机，LR89 各构型与同时代 -79 构型的性能相当。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Better known by its western designation, Scud, the S2.253 engine was developed for use in the R-11 Zemlya ballistic missile and sounding rocket. en: Dynasoar cockpit. Dynasoar (short for "Dynamic Soarer") was an early USAF spaceplane, intended to function as a station tender, reconnaissance craft, and nuclear bomber. Designed for "Dynamic Soaring", dipping deep into the atmosphere and using aerodynamic manuevers to skip back out, or change it's orbit. This would have allowed it to make passes as low as 50 km for precision reconnaissance or bombing before returning to orbit. For reentry, a slightly negative perigee is recommended. Supports a crew of one for up to 35 hours of active operations. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: DynaSoar 座舱。DynaSoar（“Dynamic Soarer”的简称）是美国空军早期的一款航天飞机，原本打算用作空间站勤务艇、侦察机和核轰炸机。它按“动力滑翔”思路设计，会深入大气层，再用气动机动跳跃出去或改变轨道。这样一来，它就能在返回轨道之前以低至 50 km 的高度掠过，进行精确侦察或投弹。再入时建议将近地点设为略微负值。 可支持 1 名乘员最多 35 小时的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Early Viking engines with conical nozzles, used for ground tests. The Viking is a hypergolic booster engine developed for the European Ariane launch vehicle. Used as both a first stage engine and second stage engine when equipped with an extended nozzle. A version was also created for the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. Average performance compared to its contemporaries, but reliable. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 早期维京（Viking）发动机，采用锥形喷管，用于地面试车。维京是为欧洲阿丽亚娜运载火箭研制的自燃推进剂助推级发动机，配装延伸喷管后既可用作第一级发动机，也可用作第二级发动机。另有一个版本专供阿丽亚娜 4 的捆绑液体助推器。性能与同代发动机持平，但胜在可靠。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Early exploration into pressure-fed hypergolic upper stage engines. This was designed by JPL to be the third stage on the Juno IV launch vehicle. After cancellation of the Juno IV, it was then selected to power the Vega upper stage for the Atlas-Vega launcher, but the Vega program was canceled in 1959. The "6K" upper stage engine was tested often, but never flew. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 挤压式自燃上面级发动机的早期探索。该发动机由 JPL 设计，作为 Juno IV 运载火箭的第三级。Juno IV 取消后，它被选为宇宙神-织女星运载器的织女星上面级的动力，但织女星计划于 1959 年取消。“6K”上面级发动机经过多次试车，但从未飞行。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Edwards Air Force Base is a United States Air Force installation in California. Edwards is the home of the Air Force Test Center, Air Force Test Pilot School, and NASA's Armstrong Flight Research Center. It is the Air Force Materiel Command center for conducting and supporting research and development of flight, as well as testing and evaluating aerospace systems from concept to combat. It also hosts many test activities conducted by America's commercial aerospace industry. Notable occurrences at Edwards include Chuck Yeager's flight that broke the sound barrier in the Bell X-1, test flights of the North American X-15, the first landings of the Space Shuttle, and the 1986 around-the-world flight of the Rutan Voyager.
zh: 爱德华兹空军基地是美国空军位于加利福尼亚州的一处设施。这里是空军试飞中心、空军试飞员学校以及NASA阿姆斯特朗飞行研究中心的所在地，也是空军装备司令部开展并支持飞行研究与开发、对航空航天系统进行从概念到实战的测试与评估的中心。美国商业航空航天业的许多测试活动也在此进行。爱德华兹见证过不少著名事件：查克·耶格尔驾驶贝尔X-1突破音障、北美X-15的试飞、航天飞机的首次着陆，以及1986年鲁坦“旅行者”号的环球飞行。

en: Following the introduction of more capable lifters for crewed LEO missions, the venerable Apollo Block III+ mission module was replaced with a larger can. Includes a larger attachment node on top for using larger androgynous docking ports. Place it upside down in place of the lunar module, with docking ports on each end. Extract with the CSM after circularization. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 随着更强大的运载器投入载人近地轨道任务，久经使用的 Apollo Block III+ 任务舱被更大的罐体取代。顶部设有更大的安装节点，以便使用较大的异体同构对接端口。请倒置安装在登月舱的位置上，两端各有一个对接端口。圆化轨道后用 CSM 将其取出。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: For when you find yourself free-falling through life (or out of a malfunctioning rocket), FreeFall Parachutes has you covered. Metaphorically, that is. From skydiving on Kerbin to landing probes on distant worlds, their parachutes are the go-to option for any budding space program. Despite their insistence on using 100% reclaimed materials for their chutes, having the brand is generally recognized as being a better option than lithobraking. They boast a generous policy on all their products: Any chute that fails to open during flight can be returned after landing for a partial refund! This policy has proven to be surprisingly unpopular with KSC astronauts, for some reason. FreeFall executives are still working on why that is.
zh: 当你发现自己正以自由落体的方式滑过人生（或者从一架出了故障的火箭里掉出来）时，自由落体降落伞公司替你兜底。当然，这只是比喻。从Kerbin上的跳伞运动，到在遥远星球上让探测器落地，他们的降落伞都是任何新兴航天计划的首选。尽管他们坚持所有降落伞都使用100%回收材料，但大家普遍认为，买牌子货总归比拿地面当刹车强。他们对旗下所有产品都给出豪爽的承诺：任何在飞行中未能打开的降落伞，均可在落地后送修并获部分退款！出于某些原因，这项政策在KSC的宇航员中出乎意料地不受欢迎。自由落体的高管们至今仍在研究这到底是为什么。

en: Further reductions in noise and improvements in encoding and miniaturization improves performance, allowing for practical communication throughout the inner solar system. However, this results in even more power hungry digital equipment, further increasing idle power draw. Idle power: 19.5 watts. NOTE: You must purchase this upgrade here before you can use it.

en: Gantry arm assembly for the Soyuz Launch Base. Three color options are available. It attaches to the auxiliary node in the center of the Soyuz base. There are multiple height options for the arms, and the full arms can be turned off so only the crew elevator is visible. The gantry platform stack has three height variants, and the whole stack can be moved down up to 2.4m with the deploy limit slider. The crew elevator pad's height, the walkway platform's height and platform extension's length can be adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. Optional transfer airlocks can be turned on to allow crew boarding of a spacecraft inside a fairing via the crew transfer function. Hatches on the elevator car and at the bottom of the tower allow an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 联盟号发射底座的桁架塔臂组件。提供三种配色选项。它附着在联盟号底座中心的辅助节点上。摆臂有多种高度可选，也可把全部摆臂关掉，只保留乘员电梯可见。桁架平台组有三种高度变体，整组可用展开限制滑块下移最多 2.4m。乘员电梯平台的高度、步道平台的高度以及平台延伸段的长度，都可用展开限制滑块调节。可选配转乘气闸，开启后可通过乘员转移功能让乘员登上位于整流罩内的航天器。电梯轿厢上以及塔底的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Gaseous Hydrogen Vent Arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. This arm was used to vent hydrogen gas boiling up into the intertank area, and was dropped at liftoff. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the top, with the umbilical touching the External Tank's intertank at about the middle. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的气态氢排放臂。该臂用于排出沸腾上升并积存在级间段区域的氢气，并在起飞时脱落。该臂附着在级间段通道结构顶部的节点上，脐带约在中间位置接触外贮箱的级间段。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Gemini L was one proposal for an advanced Gemini pod capable of reentry from translunar trajectory. This would have included development of an improved TPS similar to the system used on Apollo. Supports a crew of two for up to maximum 14 days of active operations but it will require fuel cells. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini L 是先进 Gemini 座舱的方案之一，可从地月转移轨道再入。该方案本将包含一套类似 Apollo 所用系统的改进型 TPS。可支持 2 名乘员最多 14 天的主动运行，但需要燃料电池。 来自 ROCapsules mod
双子座制动火箭（Star-13E）（已弃用）

en: Gemini retro solid derived from the Star 13 orbit insertion motor. Place in 4x symmetry in the gaps of the retro module cruciform. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 由 Star 13 入轨发动机派生的 Gemini 反推固体发动机。以 4 重对称安装在反推段的十字形空隙中。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: General animated drop-arm style cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes and two colors are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画垂臂式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸与两种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated flat vertical bolt type cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes are available, with two heights of the bolt and an optional extended base. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画平立螺栓式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸，螺栓有两种高度，还可选配加长底座。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated large clamp arm type cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画大型夹具臂式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated side-arm style cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes and two colors are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画侧臂式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸与两种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated small clamp arm type cosmetic hold-down, in classic red and yellow color, for use with any launch base. Three sizes are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画小型夹具臂式纯装饰压紧装置，采用经典红黄配色，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated tripod vertical bolt type cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画三脚架立螺栓式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General animated vertical bolt arm type cosmetic hold-down for use with any launch base. Three sizes are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用动画立螺栓臂式纯装饰压紧装置，可与任何发射基座搭配使用。提供三种尺寸。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General cradle-type test stand for doing horizontal static fire testing of smaller rocket stages. The stand has two size and eight color options. The cradle can be configured with tank rings of various sizes or with a beam of fixed clamp supports. The side support clamp positions can be adjusted horizontally and vertically with their respective deploy limit sliders, or turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用托架式试车台，用于对较小的火箭级进行水平静态点火试车。试车台有2种尺寸与8种配色。托架可配装多种尺寸的贮箱抱箍，也可改配一套固定夹具支撑梁。侧支撑夹具的位置可用各自的展开限制滑块做水平与竖向调节，也可关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General purpose nose cone. Rated for hypersonic (Mach 9) flight. From ReStock Plus mod
zh: 通用头锥。可在高超声速（马赫 9）下飞行。 来自 ReStock Plus mod

en: General test stand for doing static fire testing of smaller liquid fuel engines. The stand has four sizes of mount plates for attaching engines to and eight color options. Has fuel generators and on-board fuel capacity to fuel engines during testing. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用试车台，用于对较小的液体燃料发动机进行静态点火试车。试车台有4种尺寸的发动机安装板，并有8种配色。配有燃料发电机与自带燃料容量，可在试车时为发动机供油。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: General tower-type test stand for doing vertical static fire testing of larger and/or longer rocket stages. The stand has five tower height sizes and eight color options; the tower can also be turned off. The bottom hold-downs can be switched between side-clamp and vertical bolt types. The bottom hold-down and the top clamp positions can be adjusted with their respective deploy limit sliders. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 通用塔式试车台，用于对较大和/或较长的火箭级进行垂直静态点火试车。试车台有5种塔高尺寸与8种配色；塔架也可关闭。底部压紧装置可在侧夹式与立螺栓式之间切换。底部压紧装置与顶部夹具的位置可用各自的展开限制滑块调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Generic (androgynous) version of Apollo docking system. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 阿波罗对接系统的通用（异体同构）版本。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: Guam is a United States territory, home to Andersen Air Force Base. Due to its relative isolation and large size, it's ideal as a pacific staging area for both military aircraft and potential spaceflight companies.
zh: 关岛是美国的一处海外领地，安德森空军基地就坐落于此。得益于相对孤立的位置和可观的面积，这里非常适合作为军用航空器乃至未来航天企业的太平洋中继与集结基地。

en: H-1 Engine that flew on the first 5 Saturn IB launches. It is rated at 200k lbf sea level thrust. testedBurnTime=2025
zh: 在前 5 次土星 IB 发射中飞行的 H-1 发动机。海平面推力额定 200k lbf。testedBurnTime=2025

zh: 耐热、可切换的程序化燃料罐。含常规（结构）和高压（机身）两种选项。可在航天飞机上执行近地轨道（LEO）再入。 来自 Procedural Parts mod

en: Heat-resistant switchable procedural tank. Includes normal (Structural) and highly pressurized (Fuselage) options. Rated for LEO reentries on a spaceplane. From ROTanks mod
zh: 耐高温的可切换程序化贮箱。提供普通（结构式）与高压（机身式）两种选项。可用于空天飞机的低地球轨道再入。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: Heatshield for the Big Gemini capsule From ROCapsules mod
zh: Big Gemini 座舱隔热罩 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Heatshield for the Gemini Capsule, capable of lifting LEO reentry. Can be switched to the Gemini B configuration with a hatch. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 座舱的隔热罩，可进行带升力的近地轨道再入。可切换为带舱门的 Gemini B 构型。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Heavily reworked turbopumps for higher performance on Atlas-Centaur G and Titan-Centaur. testedBurnTime=4500
zh: 大幅重做涡轮泵，以在宇宙神-半人马座 G 与泰坦-半人马座上获得更高性能。testedBurnTime=4500

en: High performance upper stage engine for Proton. Tested extensively by KB Khimavtomatika and P&W, but never flew. testedBurnTime=3600
zh: 质子号的高性能上面级发动机。由 KB Khimavtomatika 与 P&W 大量试车，但从未飞行。testedBurnTime=3600

en: Higher expansion ratio nozzle prototype. Cannot restart between 15 minutes and 3 hours after shutdown. testedBurnTime=1200
zh: 高膨胀比喷管原型。关机后 15 分钟至 3 小时内无法重启。testedBurnTime=1200

en: Highly-pressurized propellant-tank fuselage in the Mk1 form-factor. Rated for LEO reentries. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: Mk1 规格的高压推进剂贮箱机身。可用于低地球轨道再入。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: Highly-pressurized propellant-tank fuselage, 0.625m diameter. Rated for suborbital reentries. X-15 class. From SXT mod
zh: 高压推进剂贮箱机身，直径 0.625 m。可用于亚轨道再入。X-15 级。 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 2 people with 23 days of supplies. A slightly cramped early station module. Features usable handle bars around the side. From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 2 人、23 天补给。早期空间站舱段，略显局促。侧面装有可用的把手杆。 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 2 people with 30 days of supplies. An extension adapter for the PPD-10 Hitchhiker storage container. From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 2 人、30 天补给。PPD-10「搭车客」贮存容器的加长适配段。 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 4 people with 23 days of supplies. A slightly cramped early station module. Features usable handle bars around the side. From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 4 人、23 天补给。早期空间站舱段，略显局促。侧面装有可用的把手杆。 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 6 people with 107 days of supplies. Probodobodyne Inc first and only foray into crew habitation modules. Bulky, but not uncomfortable. It even features a handy set of exterior handrails. From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 6 人、107 天补给。这是 Probodobodyne 公司首次也是唯一一次涉足乘员居住舱。体积笨重，但还算舒适。它甚至配有一组顺手的舱外扶手。 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 8 people with 155 days (5 months) of supplies. A large crew compartment designed for larger, more permanent space stations. Designed and launched in 1973, the Skylab orbital station was the widest space station ever. Given the 270m3 pressurised volume, there is plenty of room for all your IVA activies. It even features a orbital laboratory! From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 8 人、155 天（5 个月）补给。为更大、更永久的空间站设计的大型乘员舱。1973 年设计并发射的「天空实验室」轨道站是史上最宽的空间站。加压容积 270 m³，为你舱内的一切活动留出充裕空间。它甚至配有一个轨道实验室！ 来自 SXT mod

en: Hold 8 people with 45 days of supplies. A top of the line habitat meant for long-term operations. Typically after the initial 'colonists' made their situation more 'permanent' with a bit of lithobreaking. Features cabins, food preparation areas, sofas, space loos, laboratory, and even a home gym. From SXT mod
zh: 可容纳 8 人、45 天补给。这是一流的生活舱，为长期运营设计——通常是在最初的「殖民者」通过一次「岩石刹车」把处境变得更「永久」之后。舱内设有卧舱、备餐区、沙发、太空厕所、实验室，甚至还有家庭健身房。 来自 SXT mod

zh: 空心载荷转接环，用于安装侧整流罩以支撑上方级段。 来自 Procedural Fairings mod

en: Improved version of the H-1 Engine for the Saturn I, Block II. It is rated at 188k lbf sea level thrust. testedBurnTime=775
zh: 用于土星 I Block II 的 H-1 发动机改进型。海平面推力额定 188k lbf。testedBurnTime=775

en: Improved, lunar rated heatshield for the Gemini Capsule. Can be switched to the Gemini B configuration with a hatch. Gemini lacks the radiative heat protection of more advanced capsules. Extremely gentle Lunar reentries only. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 座舱的改进型登月级隔热罩。可切换为带舱门的 Gemini B 构型。 Gemini 缺乏更先进座舱那样的辐射热防护。只可用于极为平缓的月球再入。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: In 2015, ULA announced that Orbital ATK would develop the GEM 63 as a drop-in replacement for the AJ-60A, and replace Aerojet-Rocketdyne for Atlas V SRMs. The GEM 63 is larger than the GEM 60 used on the Delta IV and cannot thrust vector. As with the AJ-60A, launches using the 4 m fairing will be able to use up to three boosters while up to five can be used with the 5 m fairing. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 2015 年，ULA 宣布由 Orbital ATK 研制 GEM 63，作为 AJ-60A 的直接替换，并取代 Aerojet-Rocketdyne 成为宇宙神 V 固体助推器的供应商。GEM 63 比 Delta IV 所用的 GEM 60 更大，且不能推力矢量。与 AJ-60A 一样，用 4 米整流罩的发射最多可用三台助推器，用 5 米整流罩最多可用五台。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: In order to increase the living space and mission duration of the Apollo Block III CSM. This mission module is essentially several more cubic meters of living space for the crew. Place it upside down in place of the lunar module, with docking ports on each end. Extract with the CSM after circularization. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward) From ROCapsules mod
zh: 用于增大 Apollo Block III CSM 的生活空间与任务时长。这个任务舱实质上就是为乘员多提供几立方米的生活空间。请倒置安装在登月舱的位置上，两端各有一个对接端口。圆化轨道后用 CSM 将其取出。虚构（Eyes Turned Skyward） 来自 ROCapsules mod
