en: LEROS is a family of chemical rocket engines manufactured by Moog-ISP. LEROS engines have been used as primary apogee engines for telecommunications satellites such as the Lockheed Martin A2100 as well as deep space missions such as Juno. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: LEROS 是 Moog-ISP 制造的化学火箭发动机系列。LEROS 发动机曾作为洛克希德·马丁 A2100 等通信卫星的主远地点发动机，也用于 Juno 等深空任务。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: LMDE upgraded for J-class missions. Improved performance and more fuel allowed the LEM to carry rovers and extra scientific equipment to the surface. testedBurnTime=1100
zh: 为 J 级任务升级的 LMDE。性能提升、燃料更多，使 LEM 得以为月球表面运送月球车与额外的科学设备。testedBurnTime=1100

en: Landing parachute system for the D-2 descent capsule. From ROCapsules mod
zh: D-2 下降舱的着陆伞系统。 来自 ROCapsules mod
大型阿波罗式发射夹具

en: Large radial decoupler for separating Titan solid rocket boosters from the core stack. Use the attach node to attach the booster at the right height consistently. Has mesh options for each height of UA120 solid rocket. From ROEngines mod
zh: 大尺寸径向分离器，用于把泰坦固体助推器与芯级分离。用其连接节点可稳定地把助推器装到正确高度。针对 UA120 固体火箭的每种高度都配有对应的外形（mesh）选项。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: Large size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform. Has different shapes for 6m and 8m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the sides have 3 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladder can be toggled in 2 height variants, and the ladder and railings are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用发射基座，节点连接的发射夹具平台。6米与8米两种排气孔宽度各有不同形状。基座框架有9种配色，侧板有3种配色。可选配的压紧装置支撑垫可有多种配置方式。梯子有两种高度变体可切换，梯子与栏杆有5种配色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发电机，需开启后才能工作，也可随时关闭。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Large thruster for orbital maneuvers. From Realism Overhaul mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于轨道机动的大型推力器。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Large-size animated drop umbilical pipe for the general and specialty towers, available in 4 colors. The mount also has 2 size options, the normal short one and an extended beam long version, both with 8 color options. The umbilical can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型动画垂降脐带管，适用于通用塔与专用塔，提供4种配色。安装座也有2种尺寸，即常规短型与加长梁长型，两者均有8种配色。脐带长度可用展开限制滑块调节。动画可分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组执行。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Large-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型动画通用摆臂，适用于通用塔与专用塔，提供8种配色。用相应开关可让摆臂按默认方向或反向摆动；由分级触发的摆动只有默认方向。脐带接头可在常规端头型与德尔塔4号侧置型之间切换；侧置型可随摆动方向装在臂的任一侧。端头接头有5种样式，侧置接头分为高型与矮型，中央与外侧两组可分别开关。臂上各条管路均可在4种颜色之间切换。臂长可用展开限制滑块调节。侧置型外侧脐带导轨的间距可用其展开限制滑块收窄。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Large-size simple beam-type animated swing arm for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and arm beam and mount have 8 color options. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型简梁式动画摆臂，适用于小型服务塔与乘员升降机，管路有4种配色。安装座可在标准短型与留出更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁与安装座有8种配色。臂长可用展开限制滑块调节。动画可分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组执行。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Larger solid motor use to help separate one stage from another or perform ullage. Best used with others. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 较大的固体发动机，用于帮助级间分离或执行沉底。最好与其他同类配合使用。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: Later model, with redesigned injectors testedBurnTime=2250
zh: 后期型号，重新设计了喷注器。testedBurnTime=2250

en: Later production variant for Redstone missile featuring slightly higher performance, also used on Mercury-Redstone with stretched propellant tanks and extra HTP.
zh: Redstone 导弹的后继量产型，性能略高；在拉长推进剂贮箱并加装额外 HTP 后，也用于 Mercury-Redstone。

en: Launch Escape System and Boost Protective Cover for the Orion spacecraft. Jettison by decoupling, use by assigning the escape motor and the decoupler on service module to the "abort" action group. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Orion 飞船的发射逃逸系统兼助推保护罩。抛弃时通过解耦实现；使用时把逃逸发动机与服务舱上的分离器指定到“abort”动作组。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Level II Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Mercury and Vostok. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization to simulate the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 50% Can Hold Propellants, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 23% lighter than level I service module tanks while costing 50% more to tool and 8% more once tooled.
zh: II 级服务舱燃料罐，与 Mercury 和 Vostok 上使用的罐体类似。这类罐体笨重、利用率低，以此模拟专用载荷所需的支撑结构与系统。 最高利用率：50% 可装推进剂、电力和生保补给 比 I 级服务舱燃料罐轻 23%，但加工成本高 50%，加工完成后成本高 8%。

en: Level III Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Gemini and Voskhod. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 60% Can Hold Propellants, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 40% lighter than level II service module tanks while costing 15% more to tool and the same once tooled.
zh: III 级服务舱燃料罐，与 Gemini 和 Voskhod 上使用的罐体类似。这类罐体笨重、利用率低，以此模拟专用载荷所需的支撑结构与系统。 最高利用率：60% 可装推进剂、电力和生保补给 比 II 级服务舱燃料罐轻 40%，加工成本高 15%，加工完成后成本相同。

en: Level IV Service Module Tanks are similar to ones used by Apollo. These are heavy tanks with poor utilization that simulates the supporting structures and systems needed for the specialized payloads. Max Utilization: 75% Can Hold Propellants, Electric Charge, and Life Support Supplies These are 45% lighter than level III service module tanks while costing 14% more to tool and 7% more once tooled.
zh: IV 级服务舱燃料罐，与 Apollo 上使用的罐体类似。这类罐体笨重、利用率低，以此模拟专用载荷所需的支撑结构与系统。 最高利用率：75% 可装推进剂、电力和生保补给 比 III 级服务舱燃料罐轻 45%，加工成本高 14%，加工完成后成本高 7%。

en: License-Built version of the Rocketdyne S-3 testedBurnTime=350
zh: 许可生产的洛克达因 S-3 版本。testedBurnTime=350

en: Liquid Fluorine based design, proposed for use on the GE D-2 Apollo vehicle, and later high performance Agena tugs. testedBurnTime=480
zh: 液氟方案设计，曾提议用于 GE D-2 型 Apollo 飞船，以及后来的高性能 Agena 拖船。testedBurnTime=480

en: Longer surface stays require facilities and consumables beyond what can be carried in a single LM lander. This is a dedicated shelter module. Includes fuel cells, deployable insulation, and an expandable airlock - make sure your front leg does not have the "porch". Requires additional oxygen tanks to be added to the descent module to supply the crew and fuel cells. Supports a crew of two for up to 14 days of active operations. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 更长的地表驻留所需的设施与消耗品，超出了单台 LM 着陆器能携带的范围。这是一个专用掩蔽舱，内含燃料电池、可展开隔热层与可扩展气闸——请确保你的前着陆腿没有装“门廊”。需要为下降段加装额外的氧气罐，为乘员与燃料电池供气。可支持 2 名乘员最多 14 天的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Low profile decoupler for separating the Gemini capsule from the Adapter Retrograde Section. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 用于将 Gemini 座舱与转接反推段分离的低矮型分离器。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Low thrust pump-fed expander nuclear engine. Evolved from the original NERVA design, the Bimodal NTR, instead of wasting precious propellant mass on cooling the engine reactor, uses a Brayton cycle electricity generator unit to convert the waste thermal energy into useful electrical power. It also supports liquid oxygen injection (TRITON - trimodal operation) for increased thrust at the cost of lower overall efficiency. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 低推力泵压式膨胀循环核发动机。由原始 NERVA 设计演化而来，双模式核热火箭不再把宝贵的推进剂质量浪费在冷却反应堆上，而以布雷顿循环发电机组把废热转换为可用电能。它还支持液氧注入（TRITON 三模式运行），以牺牲总效率换取更大推力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Lunar Module Descent Engine used up to Apollo 15 testedBurnTime=1100
zh: 至 Apollo 15 为止使用的登月舱下降级发动机 testedBurnTime=1100

en: Lunar heatshield for the Big Gemini capsule. Gemini lacks the radiative heat protection of more advanced capsules. Extremely gentle Lunar reentries only. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Big Gemini 座舱的登月级隔热罩。 Gemini 缺乏更先进座舱那样的辐射热防护。只可用于极为平缓的月球再入。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Lunar-rated heatshield for the Apollo Capsule. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 座舱的登月级隔热罩。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: M-1, uprated to 1.8 mlbf. All M-1 components were designed to handle 1200 psi chamber to allow this upgrade. testedBurnTime=2500
zh: 增推至 1.8 mlbf 的 M-1。M-1 各部件都按 1200 psi 燃烧室压力设计，以支持这一升级。testedBurnTime=2500

en: MA-1 Atlas booster engine. Significantly upgraded and simplified, with both engines sharing turbopumps. Used on Atlas B/C testedBurnTime=350
zh: MA-1 宇宙神助推发动机。大幅升级简化，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神 B/C。testedBurnTime=350

en: MA-1 Atlas sustainer engine. Significantly upgraded and simplified, used on Atlas B/C testedBurnTime=700
zh: MA-1 宇宙神主级发动机。大幅升级简化，用于宇宙神 B/C。testedBurnTime=700

en: MA-3 Atlas Sustainer engine. Developed for the USAF for Atlas D testedBurnTime=700
zh: MA-3 宇宙神主级发动机。为美国空军研制，用于宇宙神 D。testedBurnTime=700

en: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Each engine had its own turbopump allow for engines to be quickly swapped. Developed for the USAF for Atlas D testedBurnTime=350
zh: MA-3 宇宙神助推发动机。每台发动机各有自己的涡轮泵，便于快速更换发动机。为美国空军研制，用于宇宙神 D。testedBurnTime=350

en: MA-3 Atlas booster engine. Slightly upgraded for Atlas E/F testedBurnTime=350
zh: MA-3 宇宙神助推发动机。为宇宙神 E/F 略有升级。testedBurnTime=350

en: MA-3 Atlas sustainer engine. Slightly upgraded for Atlas E/F testedBurnTime=700
zh: MA-3 宇宙神主级发动机。为宇宙神 E/F 略有升级。testedBurnTime=700

en: MA-5.1 booster engine. Both engines shared turbopumps due to NASA preferring that configuration. Used for Atlas-Agena launches testedBurnTime=350
zh: MA-5.1 助推发动机。因 NASA 偏好该构型，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神-Agena 发射。testedBurnTime=350

en: MA-5.1 sustainer engine for Atlas-Agena launches testedBurnTime=700
zh: 用于宇宙神-Agena 发射的 MA-5.1 主级发动机。testedBurnTime=700

en: MA-5.2 booster engine. Both engines shared turbopumps due to NASA preferring that configuration. Used for Atlas-Centaur launches testedBurnTime=350
zh: MA-5.2 助推发动机。因 NASA 偏好该构型，两台发动机共用涡轮泵。用于宇宙神-半人马座发射。testedBurnTime=350

en: MA-5.2 sustainer engine for Atlas-Centaur launches testedBurnTime=700
zh: 用于宇宙神-半人马座发射的 MA-5.2 主级发动机。testedBurnTime=700

en: MR-104 Monopropellant Engine family originally provided in-space propulsion for the Voyager 1 and 2 and Magellan missions. Subsequent MR-104 variants provided propulsion for Landsat and NOAA as well as for other U.S. government programs. A variation of this engine (MR-104G) is to be used on the Orion Deep Space Exploration Vehicle. [Uses RCS Configuration] From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: MR-104 单组元发动机系列最初为旅行者 1 号与 2 号以及麦哲伦任务提供空间推进。后续 MR-104 变型为 Landsat 与 NOAA 以及美国政府的其他计划提供推进。该发动机的一个变型（MR-104G）将用于猎户座深空探测飞行器。[使用 RCS 构型] 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。
MS04 - 气相色谱-质谱联用仪（GC/MS）

en: Made from the finest materials found in the fields around the Space Center. Can be set to any shape required. From Procedural Fairings mod
zh: 取材于航天中心周边田野里最上乘的材料。可塑造成任意所需形状。 来自 Procedural Fairings mod

en: Made from viscoelastic nanopolymers (which were discovered by accident... growing in the back of the office mini-fridge) this decoupler can be stretched to accommodate a range of sizes. From Procedural Parts mod
zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（这东西纯属意外发现……当时它正在办公室小冰箱后部长出来）制成，这款分离器可拉伸以适配各种尺寸。 来自 Procedural Parts mod

zh: 由粘弹性纳米聚合物（这东西纯属意外发现……当时它正在办公室小冰箱后部长出来）制成，这款燃料罐可拉伸以适配各种尺寸与形状的燃料载荷。发射前会硬化成刚性结构！ 来自 Procedural Parts mod

en: Main engine proposal for the Juno IV launch vehicle. testedBurnTime=350
zh: Juno IV 运载火箭的主发动机方案。testedBurnTime=350

en: Main parachute for Gemini. Attaches on top of the Gemini Re-entry Control System. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 的主降落伞。安装在 Gemini 再入控制系统顶部。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Main parachute for the Mercury capsule. Attach to the node in the recovery section. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Mercury 座舱的主降落伞。安装在回收段的节点上。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Man-rated for use on the EUS for Lunar missions. testedBurnTime=9000
zh: 取得载人资格，用于登月任务的 EUS。testedBurnTime=9000

en: Mariner-style extendable high-gain antenna. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「水手」号风格的可伸展高增益天线。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Measured stage sum (incomplete): # ms Smoothed per-call estimates; overlapping scopes and missing callbacks prevent an exclusive frame breakdown.
zh: 实测各阶段合计（不完整）：# ms 平滑后的单次调用估计；作用域互相重叠、回调缺失，无法给出互斥的帧分解。

en: Medium size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has three different shapes for 4m and 6m exhaust hole widths. The base frame has 9 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型通用发射基座，节点连接的发射夹具平台，采用移动轮式。4米与6米两种排气孔宽度共有三种不同形状。基座框架有9种配色。可选配的压紧装置支撑垫可有多种配置方式。梯子可切换多种配置，并有5种配色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发电机，需开启后才能工作，也可随时关闭。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型简梁式动画摆臂，适用于小型服务塔与乘员升降机，管路有4种配色。安装座可在标准短型与留出更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁与安装座有8种配色。臂长可用展开限制滑块调节。动画可分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组执行。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

zh: 微型通用发射基座，节点连接的发射夹具平台。有两个1.5米宽的排气孔，分别为方形与矩形，另有一个2.5米宽的方形排气孔。基座框架有8种配色。梯子可开启或关闭，并有5种配色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发电机，需开启后才能工作，也可随时关闭。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Mid size wheels for serious rovers. Good suspension travel and rugged designs make these ideal for serious roving and snack runs.. From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 适用于专业级漫游车的中型车轮。悬挂行程充足、结构坚固，非常适合正经的漫游——以及跑一趟零食补给。来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: Mid-90s upgrade to improve performance of Proton testedBurnTime=450
zh: 1990 年代中期改进质子号性能的升级。testedBurnTime=450

en: Model 8001, Agena A Prototypes. Effectively a Model 117 with gimbal added, this engine was poorly optimized for upper stage use and only flew twice on the earliest Agena launches. testedBurnTime=300
zh: Model 8001，Agena A 原型。本质上就是在 Model 117 上加装万向节，该发动机并未针对上面级用途优化，只在最早的 Agena 发射中飞过两次。testedBurnTime=300

en: Model 8081, Agena B. Increase burn time and a short nozzle extension increased performance for Agena B. Also featured a restart cartridge to allow restart in space. testedBurnTime=360
zh: Model 8081，Agena B。更长的燃烧时间与一段短喷管延伸段提升了 Agena B 的性能。还配有重启药盒，可在太空中重启。testedBurnTime=360

en: Model 8096, Agena D. Improved injectors and a larger nozzle extension improved performance for Agena D. This was the most-produced variant of Agena, flying hundreds of times. testedBurnTime=360
zh: Model 8096，Agena D。改进的喷注器与更大的喷管延伸段提升了 Agena D 的性能。这是 Agena 产量最大的变体，飞行了数百次。testedBurnTime=360

en: Modern upgrade to improve performance of Proton. AKA RD-276 testedBurnTime=450
zh: 改进质子号性能的现代化升级。又名 RD-276。testedBurnTime=450

en: Modernized model for use on Zenit testedBurnTime=1590
zh: 用于天顶号的现代化型号。testedBurnTime=1590

en: Modification of the RD-58 burning Syntin instead of Kerosene. Used on Proton (Blok DM-2M) testedBurnTime=1800
zh: 烧合成煤油（Syntin）而非普通煤油的 RD-58 改型。用于质子号（DM-2M 段）。testedBurnTime=1800

en: Modification of the RD-58 for use on Proton Blok DM, after the N-1 was cancelled. testedBurnTime=1800
zh: N-1 下马后，RD-58 改用于质子号 DM 段的改型。testedBurnTime=1800

en: Modification of the RD-58M with a Carbon Composite Nozzle extension for better vacuum performance. Used on Zenit Blok DM-SL. testedBurnTime=1800

en: Modified XLR11 used on RTV-A-2 Hiroc missile in Project MX-774. Higher performance, single use. Includes gimbal assembly. testedBurnTime=900
zh: 经改装的 XLR11，用于 MX-774 计划中的 RTV-A-2 Hiroc 导弹。性能更高，一次性使用。含万向支架组件。testedBurnTime=900

en: Modified for the Antares to replace the NK-33. testedBurnTime=1590
zh: 为安塔瑞斯改装，以取代 NK-33。testedBurnTime=1590

zh: HG-3B 的改型，让涡轮泵以更高转速运行，以产生与前代型号相同的质量流量。与正常的 B 型相比推力提高，代价是可靠性略有下降。testedBurnTime=4615

zh: 标准 CSM 与 LM 姿态控制推力器组的改进版，设计安装在 LM-Truck 上，为自主着陆提供独立的姿态控制。 来自 ROCapsules mod

zh: 模块化 RCS，可搭配不同的 RCS 喷管组件，并有用于安装它们的基座结构。 RCS 需要高压贮箱才能工作。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Modular crew access section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, used to allow boarding of spacecraft via a crew access arm and the separate crew access floor. Section has two height options for greater room to align the arm and floor, and two color otions: default gray and alternate black and white. A separate crew access floor is attached to the node inside the section, which then can be moved up and down to align the floor with the elevator exit and the crew arm. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射器FSS塔的模块化乘员通道段，用于让乘员经乘员通道臂与独立乘员通道地板登船。该段有两种高度选项，以便留出更大余量来对齐通道臂与地板，另有两种配色：默认灰与替代黑白配色。独立乘员通道地板附着在该段内部的节点上，可上下移动，使地板与升降机出口及乘员臂对齐。还提供可选的侧板，左右两侧可分别切换。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Modular multi-height core section of the Saturn launch tower. Seven heights of the section are available, each with two color options: default Saturn red and alternate new gray. Nodes for attaching the swing arms are located on the mount rail on the front side of the sections. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星发射塔的模块化多高度核心段。该段有七种高度可用，每种都有两种配色：默认的土星红与替代的新款灰。用于安装摆臂的节点位于各段正面的安装导轨上。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Modular multi-height core section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower. Six heights of the section are available, each with two color options: default gray and alternate black and white. Nodes for attaching the Intertank Access Structure (only one is needed) are located on the right side of the tower core. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的模块化多高度核心段。该段有六种高度可选，每种都提供两种配色：默认灰色与备选黑白。用于安装级间段通道结构（只需一个）的节点位于塔核心的右侧。另有可选的侧板，每侧可单独开关。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

zh: 更多通用改进使带宽略有提升，功耗略有下降。待机功率：23 瓦。注意：你必须在此处购买该升级后才能使用它。

en: More general improvements. Arraying of 32-meter antennas improves Ka-band performance. Idle power: 9.5 watts. NOTE: You must purchase this upgrade here before you can use it.
zh: 更多通用改进。32 米天线组阵提升了 Ka 波段性能。待机功率：9.5 瓦。注意：你必须在此处购买该升级后才能使用它。

en: More general improvements. Idle power: 11.7 watts. NOTE: You must purchase this upgrade here before you can use it.
zh: 更多通用改进。待机功率：11.7 瓦。注意：你必须在此处购买该升级后才能使用它。

en: More general improvements. Idle power: 18.3 watts. NOTE: You must purchase this upgrade here before you can use it.
zh: 更多通用改进。待机功率：18.3 瓦。注意：你必须在此处购买该升级后才能使用它。

en: Mounting point for boattails for a stage bottom. Note: floating node **does not decouple** and **should not be used**. From Procedural Fairings mod
zh: 用于在级段底部安装船尾罩的安装点。注意：浮动节点**不会分离**，**不应使用**。 来自 Procedural Fairings mod

en: Multi-configurable Radial Outward Firing Initiator (ROFI)--"sparker"--for use with all the launch bases. The number of nozzles can be switched between 1, 2 or 3, and has switchable heights. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 可多配置的径向向外点火引发器（ROFI）——即“打火器”——适用于所有发射基座。喷管数量可在1、2、3之间切换，高度亦可切换。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Multi-configurable twin-arm umbilical that retracts in a folding motion, styled after the one used for the Ariane V rocket. Deploy limit sliders are used to adjust the arm spread, inner and outer arm lengths, and the rotation of the arms. The arms havr 8 color options, and each of the arm pipes have 5 color options. The umbilical retraction can be done manually or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 可多重配置的双臂脐带臂，以折叠动作收回，造型参考阿丽亚娜5号火箭所用的同款。可用展开限制滑块调节摆臂张开角度、内外臂长度以及摆臂转角。摆臂有8种配色，每根臂上的管路各有5种配色。脐带收回既可手动触发，也可由分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Multi-height stackable section for the N1 basic tower, which is fixed in place. The separate tower platforms are attached to the front nodes. 9 color options are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: N1基本塔架的多高度可叠放节段，该塔固定不动。另购的塔架平台附着在前侧节点上。提供9种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Munar Industries Ltd. saw the wild success of the CDL-2 decal, and wanted to develop a decal set for their own line of Heluim mining bases. These decals are more explicit than the Semiotic Standard and aimed at the hazards that come with more advanced techonologies. (Based on the work of Gavin Rothery) From Conformal Decals mod
zh: Munar Industries Ltd. 目睹了CDL-2贴纸的巨大成功，便想为自己一条氦气开采基地产品线开发一套贴纸。这些贴纸比符号学标准更为直白，针对的是更先进技术所伴随的种种危险。（基于Gavin Rothery的作品）来自 Conformal Decals mod

en: N1 Block V is the third stage of the N1. Block V has 4 NK-21 engines. From SXT mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: N1 的 V 号段（Block V）是 N-1 火箭的第三级，装有 4 台 NK-21 发动机。 来自 SXT mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: NK-9V rerated for N1 Block G use. Gimbal, throttle. testedBurnTime=600
zh: 为 N1 Block G 使用而重新定级的 NK-9V。带万向摆动与节流。testedBurnTime=600

en: NK-9V rerated for N1 Block V use. No gimbal, differential throttle. testedBurnTime=650
zh: 为 N1 Block V 使用而重新定级的 NK-9V。不带万向摆动，差动节流。testedBurnTime=650

en: Natively developed Indian upgrade of the KVD-1 following embargos and poor performance. Used for GSLV Mk.II. testedBurnTime=1700
zh: 禁运与性能不佳之后，印度在 KVD-1 基础上自行研制的升级型号。用于 GSLV Mk.II。testedBurnTime=1700

en: New from Strutco! A new connector that connects at right angles! Brilliant! From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 支杆公司（Strutco）新品！全新连接件，可直角连接！天才设计！ 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: New from Strutco! A new connector that connects at right angles, and in two directions! Radical! From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 支杆公司（Strutco）新品！全新连接件，可直角连接，还能双向连接！太革新了！ 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: No gimbal, planned to replace the NK-33 on Soyuz 2-1v. testedBurnTime=1590
zh: 无万向摆动，计划在联盟 2-1v 上取代 NK-33。testedBurnTime=1590

en: Node-attached launch clamp styled after various hold-down assemblies used by the Thor/Delta/Delta II rockets, sized for 1.5m diameter rockets. It is designed to sit flush with the ground, so move it down so the bottom sits slightly below the VAB floor. It has three style variants: Thor type, Delta II type and a mini type with just the hold-down mounts, and 8 color options. Each style has three hold-down bolt height options: short, tall and extra-tall, the latter two for use with SRB-using Thor/Delta variants. The bolts have two position options, either for the BDB LR-79 engine (early Thors and Deltas) or the RS-27 engine (later Deltas and all Delta IIs). The stand has two manual generators that output electric charge and fuel resources. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 节点式发射夹具，造型仿照Thor/Delta/Delta II火箭所用的多种压紧组件，尺寸对应直径1.5米的火箭。它设计为与地面平齐，因此可将其下移，使底部略微低于VAB地面。有三种样式变体：Thor型、Delta II型，以及只保留压紧安装座的迷你型，另有8种配色。每种样式都有三档压紧螺栓高度：矮、高、超高，后两档供使用SRB的Thor/Delta变型使用。螺栓有两种位置选项，分别对应BDB的LR-79发动机（早期Thor与Delta）或RS-27发动机（后期Delta与所有Delta II）。支架装有两台手动发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Nose-mounted Launch Escape System for Block II D-2 vehicle. Place on top of attached docking port. From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: Block II D-2 飞行器的头部安装式发射逃逸系统。安装在已装好的对接端口顶部。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: Not a launch base. A slim general-use clamp platform for mounting and attaching ground structures. The suppport beams extend downwards for a long distance for use on uneven terrain. Comes in 8 frame color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这不是发射基座。这是一块薄型通用夹具平台，用于安装与附着地面设施。支撑梁向下延伸很长，适合在起伏不平的地形上使用。框架有8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Now you can strut the gaps between your dreams. The Cubic Octagonal Strut MK IV is here! From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 现在你可以为你梦想之间的缝隙架支杆了。立方八边形支杆 MK IV 登场！ 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: OMS engine for the Buran orbiter testedBurnTime=1800
zh: 暴风雪号轨道器的轨道机动系统（OMS）发动机。testedBurnTime=1800

en: One of the biggest crew storage solutions available to any space program, the IKU-03 is able to inflate to nearly double it's initial size, letting it hold a total of 10 kerbals comfortably. If it isn't inflated, however... let's just say that they'll have very little to no room to do anything. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: IKU-03 是所有航天计划可用的最大乘员贮存方案之一，它能充气膨胀到初始尺寸的近两倍，可舒适地容纳共 10 名坎巴拉人。不过如果不充气……只能说他们几乎没有活动空间。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: One of the most crucial skills that the Gemini program is meant to develop is the ability to rendezvous and dock in space. This simple docking mechanism doesn't have the ability to transfer crew or resources, but it will allow you to connect two vessels in flight. This male active docking mechanism corresponds to the female Agena Docking Adapter. It include an indexing key, that slides into the V shape on the Agena Docking Adapter, to help line the two craft up properly. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 计划要培养的最关键技能之一，就是在太空中交会对接。这种简易对接机构不能转移乘员或资源，但能让你在飞行中把两艘飞船连接起来。这个主动式凸端对接机构与 Agena 对接转接器的凹端相配。它带有一个定位键，可滑入 Agena 对接转接器上的 V 形槽，帮助两艘飞船正确对准。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: One-person inline crew hab section for spaceplanes. Rated for suborbital reentries. X-15 class. From Ven Stock Revamp mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 单人直列式乘员舱段，用于空天飞机。可用于亚轨道再入。X-15 级。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod 此零件不允许 EVA！

en: One-person inline spaceplane cockpit. Rated for suborbital reentries. X-15 class. From Stock (RO Config) mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 单人直列式空天飞机座舱。可用于亚轨道再入。X-15 级。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 此零件不允许 EVA！

en: One-person spaceplane cockpit. Rated for suborbital reentries. X-15 class. From Stock (RO Config) mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 单人空天飞机座舱。可用于亚轨道再入。X-15 级。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 此零件不允许 EVA！

en: Operational Viking variants with bell nozzle. Includes those used on the first stage of Ariane 1-4, as well as those used on the Ariane 4 boosters. The Viking is a hypergolic booster engine developed for the European Ariane launch vehicle. Used as both a first stage engine and second stage engine when equipped with an extended nozzle. A version was also created for the Ariane 4 strap-on liquid boosters. Average performance compared to its contemporaries, but reliable. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 实用的维京改进型，采用钟形喷管。包括用于阿丽亚娜 1-4 第一级的型号，以及用于阿丽亚娜 4 助推器的型号。维京是为欧洲阿丽亚娜运载火箭研制的自燃推进剂助推级发动机，配装延伸喷管后既可用作第一级发动机，也可用作第二级发动机。另有一个版本专供阿丽亚娜 4 的捆绑液体助推器。性能与同代发动机持平，但胜在可靠。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Optimised for Kerbin straight out of its wooden crate - though tweakable for higher gravity - this wheel is designed for large, high-mobility planetary rovers. Criticised for being power-hungry, but never for being over powered! (Warning: Extremely over powered. Warranty void when used under the influence of gravity.) From Kerbal Foundries 2 mod
zh: 这款车轮出厂即针对Kerbin调校——当然也能为更高重力重新调整——专为大型、高机动性的行星漫游车设计。它因为费电而挨批评，却从没人嫌它动力不足！（警告：动力严重过剩。在重力作用下使用时保修失效。）来自 Kerbal Foundries 2 mod

en: Original Gamma-2 used on all Black Arrow launches testedBurnTime=600
zh: 所有黑箭发射所用的原始 Gamma-2。testedBurnTime=600

en: Original Gamma-8 used on flown Black Arrows testedBurnTime=600
zh: 实际飞行的黑箭所用的原始 Gamma-8。testedBurnTime=600

en: Original vacuum version of NK-9 for the GR-1 rocket. testedBurnTime=450
zh: GR-1 火箭所用 NK-9 的原始真空版。testedBurnTime=450

en: Originally an admittedly boring magnet company, Clamp-O-Tron expanded into the aerospace industry after an engineer suggested using their magnets to "stick things together... but in SPACE!". The famed Clamp-O-Tron Docking Port has received numerous collaborations with well-known conglomerates, such as C7 Aerospace Division, to help bring the joy of clamping things together to your own space program and beyond. Clamp-O-Tron representatives would also like to remind the general public to "Please stop leaving our products on the side of the road", and to browse their online catalog instead if they wish to purchase any of their world-renowned docking ports.
zh: 夹具装置原本只是一家乏味的磁铁公司，直到某位工程师提议用他们的磁铁来“把东西粘在一起……但是在太空里！”，公司这才进军航天业。著名的夹具装置对接口曾与C7航天部等知名集团多次合作，把“把东西夹在一起”的乐趣带进你自己的航天计划乃至更远的地方。夹具装置的代表同时希望提醒公众：“请不要再把我们的产品丢在路边了”，若想购买任何一款享誉世界的对接口，请浏览他们的线上产品目录。

en: Originally designed and built for the N1F, the NK-43 is a derivative of the NK-33 with a longer bell and restart capability for use on upper stages. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: NK-43 最初为 N1F 设计与制造，是 NK-33 的衍生型，喷管钟形段更长并具备重启能力，用于上面级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Originally developed for a standoff weapon for the B-58 Hustler, the XLR81 is a gas-generator engine with storable propellants. Later space variants improved performance and capability. Engine restart was added on the Agena B's XLR81-BA-7 (Model 8081). The XLR81-BA-11 (Model 8096) used on Agena D used propellant sumps to handle ullage. The XLR81-BA-13 (Model 8247) powered the Gemini Agena Target Vehicle (a modified Agena D) and was rated for up to 14 restarts. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: XLR81 最初是为 B-58 Hustler 的防区外武器研制的燃气发生器循环发动机，使用可贮存推进剂。后来的航天型号提升了性能与能力。Agena B 的 XLR81-BA-7（Model 8081）增加了发动机重启能力。用于 Agena D 的 XLR81-BA-11（Model 8096）采用推进剂集液槽来处理沉底问题。XLR81-BA-13（Model 8247）为 Gemini 的 Agena 目标飞行器（改装版 Agena D）提供动力，额定重启次数达 14 次。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Originally part of Jebediah Kerman's Junkyard and Spacecraft Parts Co., the Stratus Corporation has only recently left the nest to pursue bigger goals out in the aerospace world. While not the largest fuel supplier in the market, Stratus earned its reputation by cementing itself as one of the few manufacturers to experiment with Monopropellant. They've effectively cornered the market due to the apparent lack of interest in this fuel type. Regardless, they currently have a lucrative deal with the KSC to supply all Monopropellant fuel for our astronauts' EVA packs and command pods. Their flagship line, the 'Stratus-V' series of tanks, won them several awards at last year's 3rd annual Fuel Tanks & Swimming Pools Expo.
zh: 层云公司原本是Jebediah Kerman废品与航天器零件公司的一部分，直到最近才离巢单飞，去航天界追逐更大的目标。它虽算不上市场上最大的燃料供应商，却靠成为少数试验单组元推进剂的厂商之一而立住了名声。由于这种燃料似乎没人感兴趣，他们实际上独占了这一市场。无论如何，他们目前与KSC签有一份利润丰厚的合同，为我方宇航员的EVA背包与指令舱提供全部单组元推进剂。他们的旗舰产品“层云-V”系列燃料箱，在去年第三届年度燃料箱与游泳池博览会上为他们拿下了好几个奖项。

en: RD-0410 was a Soviet nuclear thermal rocket engine developed from 1965 through the 1994 using liquid hydrogen propellant. The engine was ground-tested at the Semipalatinsk Test Site, and its use was incorporated in the Kurchatov Mars 1994 manned mission proposal. Its moderator and fuel are quite different from the US designs and Metal Carbide (MC) versions of the fuel are rumoured to have reach as high as 3500K without melting in the early 1990's. Use of Heptane to reduce hydrogen corrosion of the carbides was critical to function (~1%). First run tests occurred in 1985. Some Russian sources list it as dual mode using not only Hydrogen but also liquid Methane without additives. During the SNTP program the US tried to acquire MC fuels from Russian sources but planned purchases fell through. This engine is very heavily built compared to US designs and incorporates a four lobed spiral fuel rod to eliminate risk of fuel being ejected if the rods shattered. This design uses a short regeneratively cooled nozzle and is intended as an upper stage. Design stats Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=972 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=1.73 Chamber Pressure=4000kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons. In Methane mode the nozzle is slightly expanded by 12cm length and slightly enlarged. Nozzle Ae=46 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=467 Reactor Power=173MW(th) TWR=3.56 Chamber Pressure=4800kPa Ignitions =10 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:2tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-0410 是苏联的核热火箭发动机，1965 年至 1994 年间研制，使用液氢推进剂。该发动机在塞米巴拉金斯克试验场进行了地面试车，并被纳入库尔恰托夫研究所 1994 年的火星载人任务方案。其慢化剂与燃料与美国设计差别很大；据传在 1990 年代初，金属碳化物（MC）燃料版本的耐温已达 3500 K 而不熔化。用庚烷抑制氢对碳化物的腐蚀对正常工作至关重要（约 1%）。首次试车在 1985 年。一些俄方资料把它列为双模式，除氢以外还可使用无添加剂的液态甲烷。在 SNTP 计划期间，美国曾试图从俄方获得 MC 燃料，但计划采购未能落实。与美国设计相比，这台发动机结构非常厚重，并采用四瓣螺旋燃料棒，以避免燃料棒碎裂时燃料被甩出。该设计采用较短的再生冷却喷管，定位为上面级。设计参数：喷管 Ae=46　燃烧室温度=3000　理想 ISP=972　反应堆功率=173MW(th)　推重比=1.73　燃烧室压力=4000kPa　点火次数=10　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：2 吨。在甲烷模式下，喷管加长约 12 cm 并略微扩径。设计参数：喷管 Ae=46　燃烧室温度=3000　理想 ISP=467　反应堆功率=173MW(th)　推重比=3.56　燃烧室压力=4800kPa　点火次数=10　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：2 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 4 号摆动臂。这是 S-II 后部臂。提供适配 5.625m 和 6.4m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm #4 for the Saturn V. This is the S-II Intermediate arm. Two sizes for 5.625m and 6.4m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 4 号摆动臂。这是 S-II 中间臂。提供适配 5.625m 和 6.4m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm #5 for the Saturn V. This is the S-II Forward arm. Two sizes for 5.625m and 6.4m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 5 号摆动臂。这是 S-II 前部臂。提供适配 5.625m 和 6.4m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm #6 for the Saturn V. This is the S-IVB Aft arm. Two sizes for 3.75m and 4.25m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 6 号摆动臂。这是 S-IVB 后部臂。提供适配 3.75m 和 4.25m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm #7 for the Saturn V. This is the S-IVB Forward arm, which includes the LM umbilical. Two sizes for 3.75m and 4.25m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 7 号摆动臂。这是 S-IVB 前部臂，含登月舱（LM）脐带。提供适配 3.75m 和 4.25m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm #8 for the Saturn V. This is the Service Module arm. It has only one size for 2.5m Apollo CSM parts. Two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号的土星塔架 8 号摆动臂。这是服务舱臂，仅有一种尺寸，适配 2.5m 的 Apollo 指令服务舱（CSM）部件。右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn Tower swing arm for the Saturn IB's first stage (called the S-IB). Two sizes for 3.75m and 4.25m tanks, and two color options are available from the right-click menu. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星塔架上用于土星 IB 第一级（即 S-IB）的摆动臂。提供适配 3.75m 和 4.25m 贮箱的两种尺寸，右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn V animated retracting hold-down arm. Four were used on the Saturn Launcher Base, placed in between the F-1 engine fairings. Retraction can be done manually or by staging with Animated Decouplers. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星5号的动画回收压紧臂。土星发射器基座上共用了四条，位置在F-1发动机整流罩之间。回收既可手动触发，也可通过Animated Decouplers分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Saturn V tower damper arm. This V-shaped arm connected to the Apollo LES tower, and was used to stabilize the Saturn V during rollout and times of high winds. Two color options are available from the right-click menu. Arm was retracted before launch. ** Disable staging if retracting manually ** From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星五号塔架减振臂。这条 V 形臂与 Apollo 发射逃逸系统（LES）塔相连，用于在转运和大风时稳定土星五号。右键菜单中提供两种配色选项。发射前该臂已收回。** 手动收回时请禁用分级 ** 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Sea level M-1, but running at 1200 psi chamber pressure. testedBurnTime=2500
zh: 海平面型 M-1，但燃烧室压力按 1200 psi 运行。testedBurnTime=2500

en: Sea level RL10 for use on the Delta Clipper (DC-X) project. testedBurnTime=4500
zh: 用于德尔塔快帆（DC-X）计划的海平面 RL10。testedBurnTime=4500

en: Sea level optimized variant of the Castor 1 SRM.
zh: Castor 1 固体火箭发动机的海平面优化型号。

en: Sea-level variant of HG-3A upgrade testedBurnTime=4615
zh: HG-3A 升级型的海平面型号。testedBurnTime=4615

en: Sea-level variant of HG-3B upgrade. Increased specific impulse compared to other sea-level variants prior to B version development results in slightly higher thrust for the same level of turbopump throughput as the HG-3B vacuum engine. testedBurnTime=4850
zh: HG-3B 升级型的海平面型号。与 B 型研制之前的其他海平面型号相比比冲更高，因此在相同涡轮泵流量下推力略高于 HG-3B 真空型。testedBurnTime=4850

en: Sea-level version of HG-3B-2 upgrade and modification. The improved specific impulse now means that this version produces more vacuum thrust than previous vacuum versions of the engine. testedBurnTime=4615
zh: HG-3B-2 升级改型的海平面版本。比冲提高，使本版本的真空推力高于该发动机此前的真空型号。testedBurnTime=4615

en: Second Generation Raptor-Engine, heavily simplified, lighter, and with uprated thrust. testedBurnTime=3600
zh: 第二代 Raptor 发动机，大幅简化、更轻，推力也更大。testedBurnTime=3600

en: Second stage engine for Ariane 1. testedBurnTime=477
zh: 阿丽亚娜 1 的第二级发动机。testedBurnTime=477

en: Second stage engine for Ariane 2/3. Uses UH25 for extra performance. testedBurnTime=477
zh: 阿丽亚娜 2/3 的第二级发动机。使用 UH25 以提升性能。testedBurnTime=477

en: Second stage engine for Ariane 4. Uses UH25 for extra performance. testedBurnTime=477
zh: 阿丽亚娜 4 的第二级发动机。使用 UH25 以提升性能。testedBurnTime=477

en: Second stage engine for Titan IVA and IVB. Slightly improved thrust. testedBurnTime=350
zh: 泰坦 IVA 与 IVB 的第二级发动机。推力略有提高。testedBurnTime=350

en: Second stage engine module of UR-200, consisting of a RD-0206 main engine and RD-0207 vernier. AKA 8D46 testedBurnTime=300
zh: UR-200 的第二级发动机模块，由一台 RD-0206 主机与 RD-0207 游动发动机组成。又名 8D46。testedBurnTime=300

en: Select the celestial body you will be departing from.
zh: 请选择你将要出发的天体。

en: Select the celestial body you wish to travel to.
zh: 选择你希望前往的天体。

en: Separate standalone version of the Atlas Side Clamp Arm, for use as a hold-down with other launch bases and plates. The arm has 2 color options, and the mount can be turned off for use with the separate Atlas Side Umbilical. The retraction animation can be be done manually or via staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas侧夹具臂的独立单件版本，可与其他发射基座和发射板搭配充当压紧装置。该臂有2种配色，其安装座可以关闭，以便与独立的Atlas侧脐带配合使用。收回动画可手动执行，也可由分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Separate standalone version of the Atlas Side Umbilical, for use with other launch bases and plates. The umbilical has 2 color options. The retraction animation can be be done manually or via staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas侧脐带的独立单件版本，可与其他发射基座和发射板搭配使用。该脐带有2种配色。收回动画可手动执行，也可由分级触发。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Separate version of the short animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 rocket, for attaching to the top plates or nodes of other towers. This arm normally straddled the Centaur interstage-tank junction. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. The retractor device behind the arm can be toggled on/off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于Atlas SLV-3火箭半人马座上面级的矮型动画垂直回收脐带臂的单件版本，可附着在其他塔架的顶板或节点上。该臂通常跨接在半人马座级间段与贮箱的交界处。臂梁有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。臂后方的回收装置可开启或关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Separate version of the tall animated vertical retracting umbilical arm for the Centaur upper stage used on the Atlas SLV-3 rocket, for attaching to the top plates or nodes of other towers. This arm normally straddled the Centaur tank-fairing junction. The arm beam has 8 color options. The arm can be retracted either by manual toggling the animation or by staging. The retractor device behind the arm can be toggled on/off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于Atlas SLV-3火箭半人马座上面级的高型动画垂直回收脐带臂的单件版本，可附着在其他塔架的顶板或节点上。该臂通常跨接在半人马座贮箱与整流罩的交界处。臂梁有8种配色。该臂既可手动切换动画收回，也可由分级触发收回。臂后方的回收装置可开启或关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Service Module for D-2 vehicle, carries fuel and other vital systems. From ROCapsules mod
zh: D-2 飞船服务舱，装载燃料及其他关键系统。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Service bay for protecting small delicate instruments during spaceflight. Note: must be shielded for reentry, bay itself is delicate too. From Stock (RO Addition) mod From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 用于在太空飞行中保护小型精密仪器的服务舱。注意：再入时必须加屏蔽，舱体本身也很脆弱。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: Service bay for protecting small delicate instruments during spaceflight. Note: must be shielded for reentry, bay itself is delicate too. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 用于在太空飞行中保护小型精密仪器的服务舱。注意：再入时必须加屏蔽，舱体本身也很脆弱。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Shielded extendable Level 2 solar panel. 1.5m^2. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 带防护的可伸展式 2 级太阳能电池板，面积 1.5 m²。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Shielded extendable sun-tracking Level 3 solar panel. 1.5m^2. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 带防护的可伸展对日定向 3 级太阳能电池板，面积 1.5 m²。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Significant changes were made to better adapt Apollo to its new role as a crew shuttle for LEO and the Service Module was decreased in size and weight. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward) From ROCapsules mod
zh: 为使 Apollo 更好地适应近地轨道乘员摆渡这一新角色进行了大量改动，服务舱的尺寸与重量也随之减小。虚构（Eyes Turned Skyward） 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Significant changes were made to better adapt Apollo to its new role as a crew shuttle for LEO, and the internal volume was modified to fit 5 crew for reentry. Be sure to bring extra living space by attaching the Mission Module to dock with after orbiting. By only using the Command Module, you will have resources for 5 crew for 72 hours. FICTIONAL (Eyes Turned Skyward) Supports a crew of five for up to 3 days of active operations. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为使 Apollo 更好地适应近地轨道乘员摆渡这一新角色，进行了大量改动，内部容积也经过修改，可在再入时容纳 5 名乘员。请务必加装任务舱，以便入轨后与其对接获得额外生活空间。若只使用指令舱，你的资源只够 5 名乘员维持 72 小时。虚构（Eyes Turned Skyward）可支持 5 名乘员最多 3 天的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Simplified LE-5A to reduce cost for H-IIA testedBurnTime=2336
zh: 为降低 H-IIA 成本而简化的 LE-5A。testedBurnTime=2336

en: Simplified design for the H-IIA. Lower cost and better reliability, at the cost of lower performance. Intended to have a nozzle extension, but it had to be removed due to unexpected combustion instability issues. testedBurnTime=2241
zh: 为 H-IIA 简化的设计。成本更低、可靠性更好，代价是性能较低。原拟带喷管延伸段，但因意料之外的燃烧不稳定问题不得不取消。testedBurnTime=2241

en: Simply a M-200 I-Beam cut more or less in half, perfect for... Things. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 说白了就是一根大致对半剖开的 M-200 工字梁，非常适合……某些东西。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Skirt section for the attachment of 4 engines, for missions requiring high levels of thrust. Originally this was proposed for redundancy and so quick aborts could be performed on circumlunar flights. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 可安装 4 台发动机的裙段，用于需要大推力的任务。最初提出这一方案是为了冗余，以便在绕月飞行中快速执行中止。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Slight upgrade for use on the Proton second stage. AKA 8D411K testedBurnTime=450
zh: 用于质子号第二级的轻微升级型。又名 8D411K。testedBurnTime=450

en: Small 1.89m heatshield for the Mercury capsule. Place underneath, before adding the retropack. Does not include a fairing. Comes with a built in airbag for a nice comfy landing. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Mercury 座舱的小型 1.89m 隔热罩。请先装在底部，再加装反推包。不含整流罩。内置气囊，着陆更舒适。 来自 ROCapsules mod
小型阿波罗式发射夹具

en: Small Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the core stage. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base ring or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally with the deploy limit slider. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 联盟号发射底座及其他底座的小燃料臂，外形仿照现实中为芯级服务的联盟号燃料臂。提供三种配色选项。它附着在联盟号底座环上的某个辅助节点上，其他底座则用塔架节点。有六种高度可选，脐带可用展开限制滑块水平调节。摆臂收回既可手动完成，也可通过分级完成。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Small radial decoupler originally designed for use on Thor rockets with the Castor I and II SRBs. From ROEngines mod
zh: 小型径向分离器，最初为配 Castor I 与 II 固体助推器的雷神火箭设计。来自 ROEngines mod

en: Small size General Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp platform, with mobile wheel style. Has two special exhaust hole variants for the BDB Atlas V and KNES Ariane 5, plus other shapes in 2m, 3m and 4m widths. The base frame has 9 color options, and the side panels have 2 color options. Optional support pads for hold-downs cane be configured in various ways. The ladders can be toggled in various configurations, and are available in 5 colors. Has manually operated Electric Charge and Fuel Generators, these must be turned on to operate, but can be switched off as well. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用发射基座，节点连接的发射夹具平台，采用移动轮式。除BDB Atlas V与KNES Ariane 5专用的两种排气孔变体外，还有2米、3米与4米宽的其他形状。基座框架有9种配色，侧板有2种配色。可选配的压紧装置支撑垫可有多种配置方式。梯子可切换多种配置，并有5种配色。配有手动操作的电能与燃料发电机，需开启后才能工作，也可随时关闭。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Small size launch base for the Space Shuttle, made for smaller flat launch pads, and inspired by the launch mount for the shuttle at Vandenberg's SLC-6 pad. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. Service towers are attached to the nodes around the outside of the mount. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机的小型发射底座，专为较小的平面发射台设计，灵感来自范登堡 SLC-6 发射台的航天飞机发射支座。底座通过中心的大节点与航天飞机外贮箱相连，且需要外贮箱中心下方有一个空闲的附着节点才能安装。服务塔则安装在支座外围的节点上。SRB 压紧装置集成在底座内，用展开限制滑块调节。航天飞机尾部服务桅杆附着在方形主发动机排气孔两侧，可用两个节点或表面附着方式安装。整个底座可通过切换器旋转，以使支撑腿处于正确位置。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Small solid motor use to help separate one stage from another or perform ullage. Best used with others. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 小型固体发动机，用于帮助级间分离或执行沉底。最好与其他同类配合使用。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: Small solid motor use to help separate one stage from another or perform ullage. Best used with others. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 小型固体发动机，用于帮助级间分离或执行沉底。最好与其他同类配合使用。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: Small solid motor use to help separate one stage from another or perform ullage. Best used with others. Smaller and less advanced than the radial separation motor. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 小型固体发动机，用于级间分离或沉底。最好与同类配合使用。比径向分离发动机更小、也更简陋。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: Small static Level 0 solar panel. 0.05m^2. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 小型固定式 0 级太阳能电池板，面积 0.05 m²。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: Small whip antenna for the Sputnik PS-1 satellite. From SXT mod
zh: 「斯普特尼克」PS-1 卫星用的小型鞭状天线。 来自 SXT mod

en: Small-size animated drop umbilical for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and both have 8 color options. The pipe can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型动画垂降脐带，适用于小型服务塔与乘员升降机，管路有4种配色。安装座可在标准短型与留出更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，两者均有8种配色。管路长度可用展开限制滑块调节。动画可分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组执行。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Small-size animated general swing arm for the general and specialty towers, available in 8 colors. The arm swing can be done in the default or alternate direction by using the appropriate toggle; arm swing done by staging is only in the default direction. The umbilical connectors can be switched between conventional end type and Delta IV side type; side type can be on either side of the arm depending on arm swing direction. The end connecters have 5 style options, and the side connectors can be tall or short, with the center and outer sets separately toggleable. Each of the arm pipes can be switched among 4 colors. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. The spacing of the outer umbilical rails for the side style can be decreased using its deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型动画通用摆臂，适用于通用塔与专用塔，提供8种配色。用相应开关可让摆臂按默认方向或反向摆动；由分级触发的摆动只有默认方向。脐带接头可在常规端头型与德尔塔4号侧置型之间切换；侧置型可随摆动方向装在臂的任一侧。端头接头有5种样式，侧置接头分为高型与矮型，中央与外侧两组可分别开关。臂上各条管路均可在4种颜色之间切换。臂长可用展开限制滑块调节。侧置型外侧脐带导轨的间距可用其展开限制滑块收窄。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Small-size simple beam-type animated swing arm for small service towers and crew elevators, with 4 color options for the pipe. The the mount can be switched between the standard short type and a long beam type for more clearance, and arm beam and mount have 8 color options. The arm can be adjusted in length by using the deploy limit slider. Animation can be either staged or done manually/action-grouped. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型简梁式动画摆臂，适用于小型服务塔与乘员升降机，管路有4种配色。安装座可在标准短型与留出更大间隙的长梁型之间切换，臂梁与安装座有8种配色。臂长可用展开限制滑块调节。动画可分级触发，也可手动或通过动作组执行。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Solar panels for the Orion. Solar Panels degrade, affecting the power output over time. Check this effect in the PAW. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Orion 的太阳能板。太阳能板会发生衰减，随时间推移影响输出功率。 可在 PAW 中查看该效果。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: Solid Sounding Rocket Motor / AIM-7 motor
zh: 固体探空火箭发动机 / AIM-7 发动机
南太平洋电信 - 1 级 - 维护

en: Soviet Maritime Satellite Communications - Level 3 - Maintenance
zh: 苏联海事卫星通信 - 3 级 - 维护
苏联电信 - 2 级 - 维护
苏联电信 - 3 级 - 维护
苏联电视 - 1 级 - 维护
苏联测控船 - 1 级 - 维护
苏联测控船 - 2 级 - 维护
苏联测控船 - 3 级 - 维护

en: Soyuz Launch Base, a node-attached launch clamp pad styled after the actual Soyuz launch pad facility at Baikonur. Three color options are available. It attaches via the upper larger node in the central hole to a center node at the bottom of a rocket. The clamp arms, service gantry, large fuel arm, and small fuel arm are separately attached. The clamp arm pads can be switched among several options. 8 auxiliary nodes for the fuel arms or other tower are on the deck. Has two manual fuel and electric charge generators. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 联盟号发射底座，一款节点附着的发射压紧平台，外形仿照拜科努尔发射场的联盟号发射台设施。提供三种配色选项。它通过中央孔内上方较大的节点，附着到火箭底部的中心节点上。压紧臂、服务桁架塔、大燃料臂和小燃料臂分别安装。压紧臂垫可在多种样式间切换。甲板上有 8 个辅助节点，可安装燃料臂或其他塔架。自带两台手动燃料与电力发电机。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: SpaceX-inspired crew access arm for the Tundra Exploration Rodan (Crew Dragon) command pod, designed to fit on the Shuttle FSS tower crew access section. The arm uses the Rodan Crew Arm setting in the FSS crew access section, and attaches on the left main vertical beam of the section. The arm only has one retraction direction. There are 4 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 1.25m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 2 types of pod hatch interfaces. How far the arm retracts can be adjusted using the arm's deploy limit sider. From Modular Launch Pad mod

The arm has 8 color options, and the two sets of arm pipes can be separately switched among 4 colors. Arm retraction is in only one direction. From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The "KIWI A" series is an older 132MW reactor with the lowest power density of all the rover tests. Most tests resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of liquid hydrogen pumping is a major accomplishment. Its core is capable of starting up twice. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted two to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be six to nine meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. All subsequent US nuclear thermal rocket designs build off this concept. This version features a very small fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 24:1 area expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae/A*=24 Chamber Temp=2300 Ideal ISP=874 Reactor Power=132MW(th) TWR=0.24 Chamber Pressure=1415kPa Ignitions =2 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 12.08tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「KIWI A」系列是较老的 132 MW 反应堆，功率密度在所有 ROVER 试验中最低。许多试验因燃料元件碎裂或试验设备故障而失败，但收获良多；液氢泵送技术的研制本身就是一大成就。堆芯可启动两次。采用一体式钨屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱二至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机六至九米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。此后美国所有核热火箭设计都从这一概念发展而来。本版本采用极小的固定式再生冷却喷管，面积膨胀比 24:1。设计参数：喷管 Ae/A*=24　燃烧室温度=2300　理想 ISP=874　反应堆功率=132MW(th)　推重比=0.24　燃烧室压力=1415kPa　点火次数=2　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：12.08 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "KIWI B" series is an older 1100MW reactor with more than 10 times the power density of the A series. Most tests early resulted in failure with shattered fuel elements or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and heat pipes. The final test B4E ran smoothly and even restarted from a cold condition. The first Kiwi B test was run on gaseous hydrogen since hydrogen pumping and storage was in its infancy. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the basic and conservative solid core rocket design. The NERVA designs build off this concept. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 66:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=66 Chamber Temp=2473 Ideal ISP=864 Reactor Power=1166MW(th) TWR=2.04 Chamber Pressure=3606kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 14.89tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「KIWI B」系列是较老的 1100 MW 反应堆，功率密度是 A 系列的十倍以上。早期多数试验因燃料元件碎裂或试验设备故障而失败，但从中收获良多，并推动了先进涂层、化学气相沉积与热管的研制。最后一次试验 B4E 运行平稳，甚至能从冷态重新启动。最初的 KIWI B 试验使用气态氢，因为当时氢的泵送与贮存技术尚处起步。堆芯可启动四次。采用一体式钨屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱三至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机八至十二米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。这款火箭代表了基础而保守的固体堆芯火箭设计。NERVA 系列设计正是从这一概念发展而来。本版本采用固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比 66:1。设计参数：喷管 Ae=66　燃烧室温度=2473　理想 ISP=864　反应堆功率=1166MW(th)　推重比=2.04　燃烧室压力=3606kPa　点火次数=4　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：14.89 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "Milkstool", as it was nicknamed, was a stand created to allow the Saturn IB-Apollo to use the Saturn V's Launch Umbilical Tower on LC 39. The three Skylab crews and the Apollo CSM for the Apollo-Soyuz Test Project were launched from LC 39 with the milkstool. In reality it was a gray color, but a red variant is also available as an alternative. Attach the milkstool to a bottom center node of a rocket, then attach the launcher base to the bottom node of the milkstool. The center ring at top has switchable hold-down arm support and node arrangements. There is a built-in decoupler for separating the milkstool from a rocket for liftoff. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: “挤奶凳”是其绰号，这个支架的用途是让土星1B-阿波罗组合能在LC 39使用土星5号的发射脐带塔。三个天空实验室乘组，以及阿波罗-联盟测试计划的阿波罗指令/服务舱，都是从LC 39带着挤奶凳发射的。现实中它是灰色，但也提供红色变体作为替代。把挤奶凳附着到火箭底部的中央节点，再把发射器基座附着到挤奶凳底部的节点。顶部的中央圆环有多套可切换的压紧臂支撑与节点布置。内置分离器，可在起飞时把挤奶凳与火箭分离。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The "Nerva NRX" series is a 1200MW reactor. A partial flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E replacing the "Hot End Seal" with peripheral systems. Its core is capable of starting up thirty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2550 Ideal ISP=943 Reactor Power=1197MW(th) TWR=2.19 Chamber Pressure=4151kPa Ignitions =30 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 11.33tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「Nerva NRX」系列是 1200 MW 的反应堆。它是一台部分飞行试验原型，最初以 KIWI B4E 为基础，用外围系统取代「热端密封」。堆芯可启动三十次。采用一体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱三至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机八至十米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。这款火箭是更强劲、更能干一代的开端。本版本采用固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比 50:1。设计参数：喷管 Ae=50　燃烧室温度=2550　理想 ISP=943　反应堆功率=1197MW(th)　推重比=2.19　燃烧室压力=4151kPa　点火次数=30　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：11.33 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "Nerva XE" series is a 1550 MW reactor. A full flight test prototype originally based on the KIWI B4E. Its core is capable of starting up sixty times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to ten meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2500 Ideal ISP=945 Reactor Power=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 Chamber Pressure=3806kPa Ignitions =60 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 10.38tons From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: “Nerva XE”系列是一座 1550 MW 的反应堆。它是最初基于 KIWI B4E 的全尺寸飞行试验样机。其堆芯可启动六十次。它带有整体式钨硼复合屏蔽层，整个组件采用再生冷却。二回路把停堆后的气体送经一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本交流发电功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料箱三到六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运行时乘员位置应在距发动机八到十米处。额外部件如水箱或高密度燃料可在一定程度上缩短这一距离。这枚火箭代表着一系列更强、更能干的火箭的开端。本版本采用膨胀比 100:1 的固定式再生冷却喷管。Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2500 Ideal ISP=945 Reactor Power=1163MW(th) TWR=2.34 Chamber Pressure=3806kPa Ignitions =60 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 10.38tons 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "PEWEE" series is a smaller 572MW reactor with the highest power density of all the rover tests. It also recorded the Highest ISP ratings of the test at 901s. Its core is capable of starting up to 12 times. An integral Tungsten Boron Composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shutdown gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be nine to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. Most modern NASA study reactors such as the BNTR are derived in turn from this test reactor. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2750 Ideal ISP=998 Reactor Power=572MW(th) TWR=5.07 Chamber Pressure=4344kPa Ignitions =12 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 2.23tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「PEWEE」系列是较小的 572 MW 反应堆，功率密度在所有 ROVER 试验中最高，并创下试验中 901 s 的最高 ISP 记录。堆芯可启动最多 12 次。采用一体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱三至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机九至十二米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。如今 NASA 研究的多数反应堆（如 BNTR）又都衍生自这台试验反应堆。本版本采用固定式再生冷却喷管。设计参数：喷管 Ae=100　燃烧室温度=2750　理想 ISP=998　反应堆功率=572MW(th)　推重比=5.07　燃烧室压力=4344kPa　点火次数=12　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：2.23 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "Phoebus 1" series is a 1500MW reactor. Most tests early resulted in failure from pumping or faulted test equipment however much was learned and the development of advanced coatings chemical vapour deposition and lighter materials. Its core is capable of starting up four times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be eight to twelve meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents the beginnings of a more powerful and capable series of rocket. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 50:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=50 Chamber Temp=2445 Ideal ISP=881 Reactor Power=1500MW(th) TWR=3.33 Chamber Pressure=3772kPa Ignitions =4 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 9.14tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「Phoebus 1」系列是 1500 MW 的反应堆。早期多数试验因泵送问题或试验设备故障而失败，但从中收获良多，并推动了先进涂层、化学气相沉积与更轻材料的研制。堆芯可启动四次。采用一体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱三至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机八至十二米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。这款火箭是更强劲、更能干一代的开端。本版本采用固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比 50:1。设计参数：喷管 Ae=50　燃烧室温度=2445　理想 ISP=881　反应堆功率=1500MW(th)　推重比=3.33　燃烧室压力=3772kPa　点火次数=4　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：9.14 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "Phoebus 2" series is a 5000MW reactor. Most tests resulted in success proving new coatings worked well and existing at the time as the most powerful reactor core on the planet. Its core is capable of starting up eight times. An integral Tungsten Boron composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket represents a more powerful and capable series of rocket with a TWR of nearly 6. This version features a fixed regeneratively cooled nozzle with a 100:1 expansion ratio. Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=2245 Ideal ISP=889 Reactor Power=4182MW(th) TWR=5.48 Chamber Pressure=3825kPa Ignitions =8 Tonnage including integral shadow shield: 16.97tons From Bornholio Nuclear mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「Phoebus 2」系列是 5000 MW 的反应堆。多数试验都获得成功，证明新涂层效果良好，它也是当时地球上功率最大的反应堆堆芯。堆芯可启动八次。采用一体式钨硼复合材料屏蔽，整个组件均为再生冷却。二次回路把关机后的气体导入一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本的发电机功率。该发动机应安装在距最近燃料贮箱三至六米处。燃料应能为乘员提供屏蔽，运转时乘员位置应距发动机十至十五米。水贮箱或高密度燃料等额外屏蔽可在一定程度上减小这一距离。这款火箭代表了更强劲、更能干的一代，推重比接近 6。本版本采用固定式再生冷却喷管，膨胀比 100:1。设计参数：喷管 Ae=100　燃烧室温度=2245　理想 ISP=889　反应堆功率=4182MW(th)　推重比=5.48　燃烧室压力=3825kPa　点火次数=8　含一体式阴影屏蔽的总质量：16.97 吨。 来自 Bornholio Nuclear mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "SNTP-PFE" series is a 1000MW reactor. The reactor is a particle bed using metallic carbide coated uranium granules embedded in a graphite rod that hydrogen is passed through. This allows for power densities of up to 40MW/liter. Its core is capable of starting up five times. An integral Tungsten Boron Lithium Hydride composite shield is included and the whole assembly is regeneratively cooled. A secondary circuit runs the shut down gasses through a small heat engine to minimize fuel loss and provide basic alternator power. This engine should be mounted three to six meters from the closest fuel tank. Fuel should shield any crew and crew positions when running should be ten to fifteen meters from the engine. Additional shielding such as a water tank or high density fuel can somewhat reduce this amount. This rocket has impressive stats for its size (Nozzle Ae=100 Chamber Temp=3000 Ideal ISP=991 Reactor Power=1054MW(th) TWR=13.94 Chamber Pressure=6800kPa Ignitions =5 Tonnage including integral shadow shield:1.504tons ) The nozzle is a fixed ablatively cooled filament wound carbon-carbon design. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「SNTP-PFE」系列是一台 1000 MW 的反应堆。该反应堆为颗粒床式，把涂覆金属碳化物的铀颗粒嵌入石墨棒中，让氢气从中流过。这使功率密度可达 40 MW/升。其堆芯可启动五次。 整套组件包含一体式钨硼氢化锂复合屏蔽层，并采用再生冷却。二次回路把停堆后的气体送经一台小型热机，以尽量减少燃料损失并提供基本发电功率。本发动机应安装在距最近燃料箱三至六米处。运行时燃料应能屏蔽乘员，乘员位置应距发动机十至十五米。增设水箱或高密度燃料之类的屏蔽层可略微缩短这一距离。以它的体积而言，这台火箭的性能数据相当惊人（喷管出口面积 Ae=100 燃烧室温度=3000 理想比冲=991 反应堆功率=1054 MW(th) 推重比=13.94 燃烧室压力=6800 kPa 点火次数=5 含一体式阴影屏蔽层的重量：1.504 吨 ）喷管为固定式烧蚀冷却缠绕碳-碳结构。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. Has 3 color variants; the IRL arm was still mostly gray with some red beams at the rear. The arm is attached to a node on the front of top section, not on the square-sided mast base, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: SLC-6 航天飞机塔的“小圆帽”液氧排放臂。有 3 种配色变体；现实中的该臂仍以灰色为主，后部带一些红色梁。该臂安装在顶部段前侧的节点上（不在方形侧板的桅杆底座上），罩帽居中置于航天飞机外贮箱顶部正上方，几乎与贮箱相接。倒计时进行到 T-2 分钟左右时该臂收回。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The "beanie cap" Liquid Oxygen Vent Arm for the shuttle launcher's FSS tower. The arm is attached to a side node on the FSS top section, with the cap centered over the top of the shuttle's External Tank and almost touching the tank. The arm was retracted at around the T-2 minute point in the countdown From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的“小圆帽”液氧排放臂。该臂安装在 FSS 顶部段侧面的节点上，罩帽居中置于航天飞机外贮箱顶部正上方，几乎与贮箱相接。倒计时进行到 T-2 分钟左右时该臂收回 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The 3m short section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower with optional details. Attach the tower core sections to the top of the base. The section has 3 optional platforms that can be moved down up to 6m using the deploy limit sliders, or be turned off. A structural detail pole also can be turned on and moved up 6m with its deploy limit slider. Umbilical attach nodes can be toggled between the Titan II Tower and General types. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔模块化版本的3米矮节段，带可选细节。塔架核心段可拼接到基座顶部。该节段有3个可选平台，可用展开限制滑块下移最多6米，也可关闭。结构细节立柱也可开启，并可用其展开限制滑块上移6米。脐带附着节点可在Titan II塔型与通用型之间切换。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The 46-inch (1.2-m) diameter GEM 46 was used on the Delta III and Delta II Heavy in sets of nine, with six ignited at liftoff and three ignited after burnout of the first six. On the Delta III, three ground-lit boosters were equipped with TVC while all the remaining boosters used fixed nozzles. The Delta II Heavy used no boosters with TVC. Burn time 75 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 直径 46 英寸（1.2 米）的 GEM 46 以九台一组用于 Delta III 与 Delta II Heavy，其中六台在起飞时点火、三台在前六台燃尽后点火。在 Delta III 上，三台地面点火助推器带推力矢量控制（TVC），其余助推器全部用固定喷管。Delta II Heavy 则不用带 TVC 的助推器。燃烧时间 75 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The 5-segment Reusable Solid Rocket Motor (RSRMV) was first studied as an upgrade for the Space Shuttle, and entered full-scale development for Ares I. Development continued for SLS after the cancellation of Ares. Nose Cone 6.50662m tall. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 5 段式可重复使用固体火箭发动机（RSRMV）最初是作为航天飞机的升级方案研究的，随后为「战神一号」进入全尺寸研制；「战神」取消后，研制延续到 SLS。头锥高 6.50662 m。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The 60-inch (1.5-meter) diameter GEM 60 is used on the Delta IV in sets of two or four. When two boosters are used, both are equipped with thrust vector control (TVC). When four are used, two boosters use TVC while the other two use fixed nozzles to reduce weight. Burn time 90 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 直径 60 英寸（1.5 米）的 GEM 60 以两台或四台一组用于 Delta IV。用两台时都带推力矢量控制（TVC）。用四台时两台带 TVC，另两台用固定喷管以减轻重量。燃烧时间 90 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the full length version of the engine. With a gross mass of 1,648 tons, it provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was designed as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as a booster for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: AJ-260 是有史以来试验过的最大固体火箭发动机。这是发动机的全长版本：总质量 1,648 吨，可提供 35,391 kN 推力达两分钟以上。该版本原拟作为土星 IB 的替代方案，并用作阿波罗应用计划运载器的助推器。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor ever tested. This is the short length version, a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that weighed more than 842 tons fully loaded. It was capable of providing over 15 MN of thrust for 120 seconds. The program was ultimately cancelled, but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: AJ-260 是有史以来试验过的最大固体火箭发动机。这是缩短版本，21.6 x 6.6 米的庞然大物，满载时重逾 842 吨，可在 120 秒内提供超过 15 MN 推力。该计划最终取消，但取消前已进行三次试车，发动机性能完全符合设计指标。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Full Length version of the engine that has a gross mass of more than 1600 tons and provides a thrust of 35,391 kN for more than 2 minutes. This version was te be used as an alternative to the Saturn IB and as booster motors for Apollo Applications launch vehicles. This is the radially attached version to be used as a Solid Rocket Booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m] From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: AJ-260 是有史以来试验过的最大固体火箭发动机。这是发动机的全长版本，总质量超过 1,600 吨，可提供 35,391 kN 推力达两分钟以上。该版本原拟作为土星 IB 的替代方案，并用作阿波罗应用计划运载器的助推发动机。本型号为径向安装版本，可用作固体火箭助推器。[直径：6.6 米] 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AJ-260 was the largest rocket motor to ever be tested. This is the Short Length version that was a 21.6 x 6.6 meter behemoth that, when fully loaded, weighed more than 842 tons. It was capable of providing over 15,000 kN of thrust for 120 seconds. Ultimately the program was cancelled but not before three test firings where the engines performed exactly to specifications. This is the radially attached version to be used as a Solid Rocket Booster. [Diameter: 6.6 m] From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: AJ-260 是有史以来试验过的最大固体火箭发动机。这是缩短版本：21.6 x 6.6 米的庞然大物，满载时重逾 842 吨，可在 120 秒内提供超过 15,000 kN 推力。该计划最终取消，但取消前已进行三次试车，发动机性能完全符合设计指标。本型号为径向安装版本，可用作固体火箭助推器。[直径：6.6 米] 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AJ-60A is an SRB produced by Aerojet Rocketdyne. They are currently used as strap-on boosters on United Launch Alliance's Atlas V rocket. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: AJ-60A 是 Aerojet Rocketdyne 生产的固体火箭助推器，目前用作联合发射联盟宇宙神 V 火箭的捆绑助推器。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The AL-31 is a early 1980s low-bypass turbofan, designed to power the Su-27. Despite difficult development, resulting in early Su-27s being equipped with the AL-21 engine, it ultimately proved successful, powering the Su-27, Su-30, Su-34, Su-35, Su-57, J-10 and J-11. Later models were also equipped with thrust vectoring capability. Modernized AL-31s were designated AL-41F-1, not to be confused with the AL-41, an unrelated design from the late 1980s. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: AL-31 是 1980 年代初的低涵道比涡扇发动机，为苏-27 提供动力。研制过程十分艰难，早期苏-27 不得不装 AL-21，但它最终获得成功，驱动了苏-27、苏-30、苏-34、苏-35、苏-57、歼-10 与歼-11。后期型号还具备推力矢量能力。现代化改进的 AL-31 定名 AL-41F-1，不要与 1980 年代末另一项无关设计 AL-41 混淆。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Aerojet AJ10-137 was used as the Service Propulsion System on the Apollo CSM. It was designed to operate for up to 750 seconds and could restart 50 times. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Aerojet AJ10-137 用作 Apollo CSM 的服务推进系统。设计工作时间最长 750 秒，可重启 50 次。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Allison/General Electric J35 is an axial flow turbojet, and one of the first turbojets natively designed in the United States. Although not as well known as its later derivative, the J47, it still powered many late 40s aircraft such as the FJ-1, F-84, F-89, XP-86, XB-45, XB-47, X-5, and D-558. From SXT (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 艾利逊/通用电气的 J35 是一款轴流式涡轮喷气发动机，也是美国最早自行设计的涡喷发动机之一。虽然不如其后来的派生型 J47 知名，它仍驱动了许多 1940 年代末的飞机，如 FJ-1、F-84、F-89、XP-86、XB-45、XB-47、X-5 与 D-558。 来自 SXT (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Androgynous Peripheral Attach System series 89/95. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 异体同构周边式对接系统（APAS）89/95 型。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: The Antares II solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the majority of the Scout launch vehicle launches. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Antares II 固体火箭发动机曾用作绝大多数侦察兵运载火箭发射任务的第三级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Antares solid rocket motor was used as the third stage for the Scout launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Antares 固体火箭发动机曾用作侦察兵运载火箭的第三级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Apollo Lunar Module descent stage. Equipped with storage boxes for storing equipment. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 登月舱下降段。配有用于存放设备的储物箱。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The Apollo Service Module contains the main propellant tanks, the fuel cells, life support and everything else that it is needed for a flight to the Moon. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 服务舱内装有主推进剂贮箱、燃料电池、生保设备，以及飞往月球所需的其余一切。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The Atar 08/09 was a late-1950s redesign of the Atar 101, increasing thrust (creating the Atar 08) and adding an afterburner (creating the Atar 09). The Atar 09 powered the next generation of French jet aircraft, including the Cheetah C/D/E/R, Mirage III/IV, and Mirage F1. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 阿塔 08/09 是 1950 年代末对阿塔 101 的重新设计，增大了推力（成为阿塔 08），并加装了加力燃烧室（成为阿塔 09）。阿塔 09 驱动了法国下一代喷气机，包括「猎豹」C/D/E/R、「幻影」III/IV 与「幻影」F1。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Atar 101 was one of the first jet engines developed in France following WW2. It was used in many early French jet aircraft, including the Vautour I/II, Gerfaut I, and Mystère II. From SXT (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 阿塔 101 是二战后法国研制的第一批喷气发动机之一。它用于许多早期法国喷气机，包括「秃鹫」I/II、「热尔福」I 与「神秘」II。 来自 SXT (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Atlantic Spaceport Complex (ASX) is a commercial space launch facility in Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada. The launch site is located near the town of St. Lawrence - about 350 kilometers southwest of St. John's. Construction of the facility was announced in August 2025.
zh: 大西洋航天港综合体（ASX）是位于加拿大纽芬兰与拉布拉多省的一处商业航天发射设施。发射场位于圣劳伦斯镇附近，地处圣约翰斯西南约350公里。该设施的建设计划于2025年8月对外公布。

en: The Atlas Skirt Decoupler is designed to be used as part of the Stage and a Half Designs used by the Atlas Launch Vehicle. From ROTanks mod
zh: 宇宙神裙段分离器是作为宇宙神运载火箭「一级半」方案的一部分而设计的。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: The Avon was Rolls-Royce's first axial-flow turbojet, introduced in 1950. It powered most British aircraft of the 1950s and 60s, including the Sea Vixen, Canberra, Lightning, Hunter, Swift and Valiant. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 雅芳（Avon）是罗尔斯·罗伊斯的第一台轴流式涡轮喷气发动机，1950 年推出。它驱动了 1950—60 年代大多数英国飞机，包括「海狐」、「堪培拉」、「闪电」、「猎手」、「雨燕」与「勇士」。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The BE-3 (Blue Engine 3) is a hydrolox rocket engine developed by Blue Origin, using a combustion tap-off cycle. The BE-3PM is used on New Shepard, a re-usable single-stage suborbital space tourism vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: BE-3（Blue Engine 3）是 Blue Origin 研制的氢氧火箭发动机，采用燃烧抽气循环。BE-3PM 用于新谢泼德号——一种可重复使用的单级亚轨道太空旅游飞行器。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The BE-4 is an oxidizer-rich staged combustion methalox engine. Though initially developed for use on a Blue Origin launch vehicle, United Launch Alliance announced in 2014 that their new Vulcan launch vehicle will be powered by a pair of BE-4 engines. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: BE-4 是富氧分级燃烧的甲烷氧发动机。虽最初为 Blue Origin 的运载火箭研制，但联合发射联盟于 2014 年宣布其新型火神运载火箭将由两台 BE-4 提供动力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The CASTOR 30 is a low cost, robust, state-of-the-art upper stage motor. This commercially-developed motor is 144 inches long and nominally designed as an upper stage that can function as a second or third stage depending on the vehicle configuration. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CASTOR 30 是低成本、高可靠的当代上面级发动机。该发动机由商业部门研制，全长 144 英寸，名义上按上面级设计，可依运载器构型用作第二级或第三级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The CASTOR 30XL is more than a stretched version of the CASTOR 30. The motor is 235.8 inches long and designed to function as a second or third stage depending on vehicle configuration. The nozzle is 8 feet long and submerged, with a high expansion ratio (55.9:1), a dual density exit cone for high altitude operation, and an electro-mechanical TVA system. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CASTOR 30XL 并不只是 CASTOR 30 的加长型。发动机全长 235.8 英寸，可依运载器构型用作第二级或第三级。喷管长 8 英尺、为内埋式，膨胀比高（55.9:1），出口锥为双密度设计以适应高空工作，并配电动机械式推力矢量（TVA）系统。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The CF6 high-bypass turbofan was developed from the TF39, the first ever production high-bypass turbofan. It powered many large aircraft, including the A300, A310, A330, B747, B767, DC-10, KC-10, MD-11, E-4, C-2, and C-5M. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CF6 高涵道比涡扇由 TF39 发展而来，后者是史上第一台量产的高涵道比涡扇。它驱动了许多大型飞机，包括 A300、A310、A330、B747、B767、DC-10、KC-10、MD-11、E-4、C-2 与 C-5M。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Castor 1 was first used for a suborbital launch of a Scout X-1 rocket in 1960. Castor 1 stages were also used as strap-on boosters for vehicles with Thor first stages, including the Delta-D. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: Castor 1 于 1960 年首次用于侦察兵 X-1 火箭的亚轨道发射。Castor 1 级也被用作捆绑助推器，装在以雷神为第一级的运载器上，包括 Delta-D。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The Castor 120 is a medium solid booster used on the Minotaur and Athena launch vehicles. Its design was based on the TU-903, which serves as the first stage of the Peacekeeper ICBM. The standard thrust curve can be modified to produce a regressive burn that reduces maximum acceleration or a saddle-shaped profile that limits aerodynamic forces. Burn time 79 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: Castor 120 是用于 Minotaur 与 Athena 运载火箭的中型固体助推器。其设计基于 TU-903，即和平卫士洲际弹道导弹的第一级。标准推力曲线可改为递减燃烧以降低最大过载，或改为马鞍形剖面以限制气动载荷。燃烧时间 79 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The Castor 4 was developed as the second stage of the Athena H missile and first flew in 1971. It was later adapted to replace Delta's Castor 2 boosters, increasing GTO capacity from 723 kg to nearly 900 kg. The Delta 3000-series launched in 1975 with a staggered booster staging sequence. Previous Deltas burned their motors in a 6-3 sequence and then jettisoned all SRMs at once. The heavier and longer-burning Castor 4 required that the motors be jettisoned as soon as they ran out to reduce dead weight. A less efficient 5-4 sequence was used until Delta was strengthened in the early 80s to handle the acceleration of a 6-3 sequence. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: Castor 4 最初作为 Athena H 导弹的第二级研制，1971 年首飞。后被改用为 Delta 的 Castor 2 助推器的替代品，使 GTO 运力从 723 kg 提高到近 900 kg。Delta 3000 系列于 1975 年服役，采用错时分离助推器的顺序。早期 Delta 以 6-3 顺序燃尽发动机后一次性抛掉全部固体助推器。更重、燃烧更久的 Castor 4 要求发动机一燃尽就抛掉以减小死重。在 1980 年代初 Delta 结构加强、足以承受 6-3 顺序的加速度之前，一直采用效率较低的 5-4 顺序。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The Castor 4A was introduced on the first generation of Delta II launchers, the 6000-series, and offered improved thrust and specific impulse by replacing PBAA with higher energy HTPB.
