This, combined with a stretched first stage (the Extra-Extended Long Tank Thor), and a return to the more efficient 6-3 SRM ignition sequence, improved Delta's performance by 11% over the 3000-series. The Castor 4A was flown on the Delta II from 1989 until 1993, when it was replaced by the GEM 40. The boosters were also used on the Atlas IIAS from 1993 until 2004. Burn time 53 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: Castor 4A 随第一代 Delta II（6000 系列）推出，以更高能的 HTPB 取代 PBAA，从而提高了推力与比冲。再加上加长的第一级（Extra-Extended Long Tank Thor）以及回归更高效的 6-3 固体助推器点火顺序，Delta 的性能比 3000 系列提升了 11%。Castor 4A 于 1989 至 1993 年在 Delta II 上飞行，之后被 GEM 40 取代。该助推器还于 1993 至 2004 年用于宇宙神 IIAS。燃烧时间 53 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The Churchill Rocket Research Range was used beginning in 1954 for sub-orbital launches of sounding rockets to study the upper atmosphere. Over 3,500 sub-orbital flights were launched from the site. Akjuit Aerospace signed a 30-year lease in 1994 with the goal of developing the world's first commercial spaceport.
zh: 丘吉尔火箭研究靶场自1954年起就用于发射探空火箭执行亚轨道任务，以研究高层大气。该场地累计进行过3,500余次亚轨道飞行。Akjuit Aerospace于1994年签下一份30年租约，目标是建成全球首座商业航天港。

en: The Command Module of the Apollo spacecraft. Apollo was the spacecraft that transported humans to the Moon in the 1960's and 1970's. It has room for three crew. Supports a crew of three for up to 14 days of active operations. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Apollo 飞船的指令舱。Apollo 是 20 世纪 60 至 70 年代把人送上月球的飞船。舱内可容纳 3 名乘员。可支持 3 名乘员最多 14 天的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Common Berthing Mechanism. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 通用泊位机构（CBM）。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The Core section of the Mini General Crew Elevator tower for use with all launch bases, with a 32.0m high elevator car. The core has three height options; add additional Mini Crew Elevator Tower Sections to increase the core's height. The front wall can be partial on, full on or off. Uses the Small General Crew Arm - Mini mount, the Mercury-Atlas Crew Walkway or the Mini Crew Walkway for crew access to a spacecraft. Also has 8 color options. Adjust the height of the elevator car downward with the deploy limit slider to match the height of the crew arm or walkway and to use with the Tier 1 launch pad. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 迷你通用乘员升降机塔的核心段，可与所有发射基座搭配使用，配有一台32.0米高的电梯轿厢。核心段有三种高度可选；再拼接迷你乘员升降机塔节段即可增高。前墙可设为半开、全开或完全关闭。乘员进入航天器时可使用小型通用乘员臂-迷你底座、水星-宇宙神乘员走道或迷你乘员走道。同样有8种配色。用展开限制滑块把电梯轿厢高度下调，即可与乘员臂或走道的高度对齐，也可与Tier 1发射台搭配使用。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The D-18 was the largest high-bypass turbofan developed in the Soviet Union, created in the 1980s for the An-124 and An-225. From SXT mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: D-18 是苏联研制的最大高涵道比涡扇发动机，1980 年代为安-124 与安-225 研制。 来自 SXT mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The D-30 is one of the first turbofan engines developed in the Soviet Union, and the most successful. While originally developed to power the Tu-134 airliner, it found its way into many Soviet aircraft, including the Tu-154, Il-62, Il-76, M-55, and with afterburner, MiG-31 and Su-47. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: D-30 是苏联最早研制的涡扇发动机之一，也是最成功的一款。它原本为图-134 客机研制，后来装上了许多苏联飞机，包括图-154、伊尔-62、伊尔-76、M-55，加装加力燃烧室后还用于米格-31 与苏-47。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The DTS-M1 is a fully deployable communications and data transmission system. It has been designed to have a minimal form factor when stowed. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: DTS-M1 是一套可完全展开的通信与数据传输系统。它的外形经过精心设计，收拢状态下的尺寸尽可能小。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The Derwent was a development of the W.2 / Welland engine with "straight through flow" rather than "reverse flow," leading to an increase in thrust and efficiency. It was a short-lived line of engines, ending with World War II; indeed, the Derwent V was in fact a scaled-down Nene. Powered the Meteor F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14, Nord 1601, Sagittario II, and Yak-23/25/30 and La-15 as the license-built RD-500. From SXT mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 「德文特」（Derwent）是 W.2/「韦兰」发动机的发展型，采用「直流」而非「回流」气流，从而提高了推力与效率。这是一个短命的发动机系列，随二战结束而终止；实际上「德文特」V 就是缩小版的「尼恩」。它驱动了「流星」F.3/F.4/NF.12/NF.14、Nord 1601、「射手座」II，以及以许可证仿制的 RD-500 驱动的雅克-23/25/30 与拉-15。 来自 SXT mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Early Film Camera is used to take photographs of Earth from space. This is a very early camera and lacks resolution in the images. Historically, these were flown on V-2 Rockets, or other larger sounding rockets. From RP-1 (Stock Model) mod
zh: 早期胶片相机用于从太空拍摄地球照片。这是非常早期的相机，图像分辨率有限。历史上，这类相机曾搭载于 V-2 火箭或其他较大的探空火箭。 来自 RP-1 (Stock Model) mod

en: The F-1B engine was designed to power the proposed Pyrios advanced boosters for the Space Launch System. A highly modified version of the original F-1, the F-1B uses modern manufacturing techniques including 3-D printing and features a simpler gas generator exhaust arrangement in order to reduce manufacturing costs and increase thrust at a slight cost of efficiency. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: F-1B 发动机是为太空发射系统（SLS）所提议的 Pyrios 先进助推器提供动力的设计。它是在原始 F-1 基础上大改的型号，采用包括 3D 打印在内的现代制造工艺，并改用更简单的燃气发生器排气布局，以降低制造成本，并以略微牺牲效率换取更大推力。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The F100 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-15 and F-16. Its advanced design and high power allowed the F-15 and F-16 to achieve a thrust to weight ratio greater than one. It was used in all F-15 and most F-16 variants. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: F100 是 1970 年代为 F-15 与 F-16 研制的低涵道比涡扇发动机。其先进的设计与强劲动力使 F-15、F-16 的推重比超过 1。它用于所有 F-15 与大部分 F-16 型号。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The F135 is a 2000s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F-35. Two variants exist, with a conventional nozzle for the F-35A/C, and one with a forward PTO shaft and gimbaled nozzle for the VTOL-capable F-35B. From SXT mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: F135 是 2000 年代为 F-35 研制的低涵道比涡扇发动机。它有两种变体：一种配常规喷管，用于 F-35A/C；另一种带前向 PTO 轴与万向喷管，用于具备垂直起降能力的 F-35B。 来自 SXT mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The F404 is a 1970s low-bypass turbofan designed for the F/A-18. It was designed for reliability rather than performance, in order to replace the notoriously unreliable F-4s and F-14s used by the US Navy and Marines at the time. It was used in the F/A-18A/B/C/D, F-20A, F-117A, T-7A, T-50, JAS-39, and Tejas. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: F404 是 1970 年代为 F/A-18 研制的低涵道比涡扇发动机。它侧重可靠性而非性能，用以替换当时美国海军与海军陆战队使用的、以不可靠著称的 F-4 与 F-14。它用于 F/A-18A/B/C/D、F-20A、F-117A、T-7A、T-50、JAS-39 与「光辉」。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Filament-Wound Casing (FWC) boosters were developed to allow the shuttle to launch into polar orbits from Vandenberg. Two sets of flight hardware existed when the FWC boosters were cancelled after the Challenger disaster.
zh: 纤维缠绕壳体（FWC）助推器是为让航天飞机能够从范登堡发射进入极地轨道而研制的。FWC 助推器在挑战者号事故后被取消时，已有两套飞行硬件完工。

en: The Gas Chromatograph - Mass Spectrometer (GC-MS) is an analytical instrument used for identification of multiple different substances in a selected gas sample, capable of detecting even trace amounts of them. Ideal of analyzing the atmospheric composition of unknown environments. From SXT mod
zh: 气相色谱—质谱联用仪（GC-MS）是一种分析仪器，用于在选定的气体样品中鉴定多种不同物质，甚至能检出痕量成分。它非常适合分析未知环境的大气组成。 来自 SXT mod

en: The Gemini Adapter Equipment Section. It contains O2 and H2 for fuel cell consumption and life support. It also contains fuel for manoeuvring and attitude control thrusters. This is the configuration as found on Gemini 10+. RCS O/F Ratio 1.223:1. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Gemini 转接设备段。内装供燃料电池消耗与生保使用的 O2 和 H2，也装有供机动与姿控推力器使用的燃料。此为 Gemini 10 及以后各次任务所用的构型。RCS 氧燃比 1.223:1。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Gemini cabin. Contains two astronauts. When equipped with fuel cells and combined with its service module, it is capable of complex, long duration space missions. Supports a crew of two for up to maximum 14 days of active operations but it will require fuel cells. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Gemini 座舱。可容纳两名航天员。配备燃料电池并与服务舱组合后，可执行复杂的长时程航天任务。可支持 2 名乘员最多 14 天的主动运行，但需要燃料电池。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The General Purpose Heat Source - Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator as found on the Galileo spacecraft. Includes a protective cover. From SXT mod
zh: 通用热源—放射性同位素温差发电机（GPHS-RTG），即「伽利略」号探测器上使用的型号。含防护罩。 来自 SXT mod

en: The General Purpose Heat Source - Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator as found on the Galileo spacecraft. From SXT mod
zh: 通用热源—放射性同位素温差发电机（GPHS-RTG），即「伽利略」号探测器上使用的型号。 来自 SXT mod

en: The Graphite-Epoxy Motor (GEM) replaced the steel case used on earlier Castor-series boosters with a lighter composite case. The 40-inch (1-meter) diameter GEM 40 was used on the Delta II 7000-series in sets of three, four, or nine. When nine boosters were used, six were ignited at liftoff and the remaining three were ignited after burnout and jettison of the first six. Burn time: 58 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 石墨环氧（GEM）固体发动机以更轻的复合材料壳体取代了早期 Castor 系列助推器的钢壳体。直径 40 英寸（1 米）的 GEM 40 以三台、四台或九台一组用于 Delta II 7000 系列。用九台时，六台在起飞时点火，其余三台在前六台燃尽抛离后点火。燃烧时间：58 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles, as well as late-model Delta rockets (as the RS-27). The RS-27A has a higher expansion ratio optimized for performance at altitude since liftoff thrust on the Delta II is augmented by solid boosters. This part is configured to mount on a Delta, rather than a Saturn 1. Slightly different form factor, same performance. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: H-1 是原始 LR79 发动机的升级型，曾推动土星 I 与土星 IB 运载器，也用于后期型号的德尔塔火箭（型号为 RS-27）。RS-27A 的膨胀比更高，针对高空性能优化，因为德尔塔 II 起飞时的推力由固体助推器补足。本部件按装在德尔塔（而非土星 1）上设计。外形略有不同，性能相同。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles. This is the H-1C variant. It is intended to be mounted inboard in a cluster of engines as it does not have the ability to gimbal. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: H-1 是推动土星 I 与土星 IB 的原始 LR79 发动机的升级型。本型号为 H-1C 变型。因不具备万向摆动能力，它预期装在发动机集束的内侧位置。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The H-1 is an upgrade to the original LR79 engine that propelled the Saturn-I and IB vehicles. This is the H-1D variant. It is intended to be mounted outboard in a cluster of engines and is equipped with an aspirator to redirect exhaust out the edge of the nozzle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: H-1 是推动土星 I 与土星 IB 的原始 LR79 发动机的升级型。本型号为 H-1D 变型。它预期装在发动机集束的外侧位置，并配有一个吸气器，把排气流引向喷管边缘。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Hinge for the Shuttle Launcher Rotating Service Structure (RSS). The hinge attaches to a large node located on the FSS Tower's base section. The RSS itself is then attached to the hinge. The hinge has two color options, default gray and alternate black&white. The hinge details (the platforms and discs) can also be turned off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架旋转服务结构（RSS）的铰链。铰链附着在 FSS 塔基段上的一个大节点处，RSS 本体则安装在铰链上。铰链有两种配色：默认灰色与备选黑白。铰链上的细节件（平台与圆盘）也可关闭。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Hollow Interstage allows you to change the Diameter of the part to fit many different configurations for your craft. It allows for customization of Decoupling just the bottom node as normal, or both nodes like a separator. From ROTanks mod
zh: 空心级间段可让您改变零件直径，以适配飞行器的多种布局。解耦方式也可定制：只像普通那样解耦底部节点，或像分离器那样同时解耦两个节点。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: The Intertank Access Structure for the Shuttle Launcher FSS tower. This attaches to a side node on the FSS tower, and was used to access the External Tank's intertank. The intertank access arm is attached to the front node off to the sie, and the hydrogen vent arm are attached to to the top node on the walkway. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的级间段通道结构。它附着在 FSS 塔侧面的节点上，用于接近外贮箱的级间段。级间段通道臂安装在前侧偏向一旁的节点上，氢气排放臂则安装在步道顶部的节点上。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Intertank Structure for the SLC-6 shuttle tower. It attaches to one of the nodes on the side of the tower opposite the crew arm. The main structure can be adjusted sideways with the deploy limit slider. The one thing that was mounted on this structure was the Hydrogen Vent Arm, which attaches to the node at the end of the main structure. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: SLC-6 航天飞机塔的级间结构。它附着在塔侧面、与乘员臂相对的一侧节点上。主体可通过展开限制滑块横向调节。该结构上唯一安装的部件是氢气排放臂，它附着在主体末端的节点上。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The J-2S (J-2 Simplified) was a improvement on the J-2 Engine. It was completely tested and logged more than 30,000 seconds of static fire before the program was terminated. Five minutes minimum between restarts. testedBurnTime=12000
zh: J-2S（J-2 简化型）是 J-2 发动机的改进型。在项目终止前它已通过完整试车，累计超过 30,000 秒的地面试车。两次重启之间至少间隔五分钟。testedBurnTime=12000

en: The J48 was also known as the Rolls-Royce Tay. Essentially an enlarged Nene, it was abandoned by Rolls-Royce in favor of the Avon. However, Pratt & Whitney was able to acquire the design, and produced it as the J48. It was used in the F9F-5 Panther, F9F-6/8 Cougar, F-94C Starfire, and YF-93. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: J48 又名罗尔斯·罗伊斯「泰」（Tay）。它基本就是放大的「尼恩」（Nene），罗尔斯·罗伊斯放弃它转而发展雅芳。不过普惠取得了该设计，以 J48 的型号生产。它用于 F9F-5「黑豹」、F9F-6/8「美洲狮」、F-94C「星火」与 YF-93。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: J57 是名副其实的主力机型，1950 年代初设计，驱动了 B-52、大多数「百系列」战斗机，甚至 U-2。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The J57 was a workhorse, designed in the early 1950s and powering the B-52, most of the Century Series fighters, and even the U-2. From Stock (RO Addition) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: J57 是名副其实的主力机型，1950 年代初设计，驱动了 B-52、大多数「百系列」战斗机，甚至 U-2。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: J85 最初是作为小型一次性喷气发动机研制的，用来驱动诱饵与无人机，后来经过升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它驱动了许多小型飞机，包括 F-5、CF-5、G.91Y、T-2、T-38 与 A-37。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The J85 was developed as a small, disposable jet engine to power decoys and drones, but was later upgraded for use on manned aircraft. It powered many small aircraft, including the F-5, CF-5, G.91Y, T-2, T-38, and A-37. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: J85 最初是作为小型一次性喷气发动机研制的，用来驱动诱饵与无人机，后来经过升级用于有人驾驶飞机。它驱动了许多小型飞机，包括 F-5、CF-5、G.91Y、T-2、T-38 与 A-37。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The KTDU-35 is a gas generator hypergolic engine capable of multiple ignitions, used on the first generation Soyuz and Progress spacecrafts (the 7K series). It consists of the single nozzle S5.60 main engine and the dual nozzle S5.35 backup engine. If the main engine fails, the backup one will assume its position. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: KTDU-35 是一款可多次点火的自燃推进剂燃气发生器发动机，用于第一代联盟号与进步号飞船（7K 系列）。它由单喷管的 S5.60 主发动机与双喷管的 S5.35 备份发动机构成。主发动机一旦故障，备份发动机即接替其位置。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The LE-5 is a gas generator hydrolox engine, the first natively-developed Japanese hydrolox engine, designed for use on the second stage of the H-1 launch vehicle. It was then completely redesigned into the world's first expander bleed cycle engine for use on the H-II. It has gone through several evolutions since, being used on the H-IIA, H-IIB, and planned for the H-3. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: LE-5 是燃气发生器氢氧发动机，也是日本首台自行研制的氢氧发动机，为 H-1 运载火箭第二级设计。之后它经过彻底重新设计，成为世界上第一台膨胀排放循环发动机，用于 H-II。此后又历经数次演进，用于 H-IIA、H-IIB，并计划用于 H-3。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The LEROS 4 High Thrust Apogee Engine is an ESA-funded 1100 N engine undergoing development by Moog. It will support the agency's future interplanetary missions by reducing the mass of spacecraft propellant required for orbit insertion maneuvers, allowing more scientific payload to be carried. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: LEROS 4 高推力远地点发动机是由 ESA 资助、Moog 研制中的 1100 N 发动机。它将通过降低航天器做轨道插入机动所需的推进剂质量，支持该机构未来的行星际任务，从而能携带更多科学载荷。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The LM Taxi Ascent Stage Cockpit provides accommodations for up to three crew to ride to the Moon's surface atop the LM Decent Stage, perform an extended surface stay, then return to orbit. During surface operations, the Taxi is shut down and put in a dormant state to save resources, while the crew operates out of a separately landed shelter. Includes radiators and deployable insulation for the dormancy period. Remember to have all crew members on board before launching. Due to low performance with 3 crewmembers, it is recommended to leave behind all equipment before launching. Supports a crew of three for up to 46 hours of active operations. From ROCapsules mod
zh: LM 出租车上升段座舱最多可容纳 3 名乘员，乘员坐在 LM 下降段顶部抵达月面，进行长时间地表驻留，然后返回轨道。在地表作业期间，出租车会关机并进入休眠状态以节省资源，乘员则在另行着陆的掩蔽舱内活动。为休眠期配备了散热器与可展开隔热层。发射前记得让所有乘员登舱。由于搭载 3 名乘员时性能偏低，建议发射前丢弃所有装备。可支持 3 名乘员最多 46 小时的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The LR91 powered the second stage of Titan launchers. Exhaust from the gas generator provided roll control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: LR91 为泰坦系列运载器的第二级提供动力。燃气发生器的排气用于提供滚转控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Large Apollo Style Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the very bottom of your rockets before launch to hold them in place. From ROEngines mod
zh: 大型阿波罗风格发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭最底部，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Large Fuel Arm for the Soyuz Launch Base and other bases, styled after the actual Soyuz arm which serviced the third stage and spacecraft. Three color options are available. It attaches to one of the auxiliary nodes on the Soyuz base or a tower node on other bases. Six height options are available, and the umbilical can be adjusted horizontally and vertically with the deploy limit sliders. Arm retraction can be either done manually or by staging. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 联盟号发射底座及其他底座的大燃料臂，外形仿照现实中为三级和飞船服务的联盟号燃料臂。提供三种配色选项。它附着在联盟号底座的某个辅助节点上，其他底座则用塔架节点。有六种高度可选，脐带可用展开限制滑块在水平和垂直方向调节。摆臂收回既可手动完成，也可通过分级完成。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Large General Crew Access Arm with a mount sized for the Large General Crew Elevator, with three style variants. The arm can be retracted either to the right (default) or left (alternate) by toggling the swing direction button. There are 6 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 2.5m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 3 types of pod hatch interfaces. There is also an optional "transfer airlock" that can be boarded and used to transfer crew to a spacecraft inside a fairing. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员通道臂，底座尺寸对应大型通用乘员升降机，共有三种样式变体。切换摆动方向按钮，即可让摆臂向右（默认）或向左（备用）收回。摆臂有6种长度变体，末段可用展开限制滑块向内调节，最多2.5m。末段还提供3种舱门对接接口。此外还有可选的“转运气闸”，可进入其中，用于把乘员转运至整流罩内的航天器。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Large General Crew Access Arm with a mount sized for the Small General Crew Elevator, with three style variants. The arm can be retracted either to the right (default) or left (alternate) by toggling the swing direction button. There are 3 arm length variants, and the end section can be adjusted inward up to 2.5m with the deploy limit slider. The end section also has 3 types of pod hatch interfaces. There is also an optional "transfer airlock" that can be boarded and used to transfer crew to a spacecraft inside a fairing. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员通道臂，底座尺寸对应小型通用乘员升降机，共有三种样式变体。切换摆动方向按钮，即可让摆臂向右（默认）或向左（备用）收回。摆臂有3种长度变体，末段可用展开限制滑块向内调节，最多2.5m。末段还提供3种舱门对接接口。此外还有可选的“转运气闸”，可进入其中，用于把乘员转运至整流罩内的航天器。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Large Launch Clamp is designed for use with your second generation launch vehicles and has a 3.0 m opening. From ROEngines mod
zh: 大型发射夹具，适用于第二代运载火箭，开口尺寸 3.0 m。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Large Radial Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the sides of rockets to hold them in place before launching. From ROEngines mod
zh: 大型径向发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭侧面，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Lunar Flying Vehicle was designed to greatly extend the range from the LEM that can be explored. <#ef7b06> AUTHOR'S NOTE: Store inside the LM Descent Stage Assembly's inventory (requires manually placing in a slot), and deploy by placing on the surface with an engineer. After boarding, select "Control From Here" in the PAW to align forward vector with the engines. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 月球飞行器的设计目的是大幅扩展以 LEM 为起点的可探索范围。 <#ef7b06> 作者注：将其存放在 LM 下降段总成的货舱清单中（需手动放入某个槽位），并在表面上由工程师放置以完成部署。登乘后，请在 PAW 中选择“从此控制”，使前向矢量与发动机对齐。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The MK I Mobility Enhancer, known in some circles as a "ladder", is a state-of-the-art vertical mobility device, allowing your intrepid crew to scamper around the exterior of your ship like highly caffeinated rodents. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「MK I 机动增强器」在某些圈子里被称作「梯子」，是一套顶尖的垂直移动装置，可让你勇敢的乘员像喝多了咖啡的啮齿动物一样在飞船外壁窜来窜去。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The MK II Mobility Enhancer, known in some circles as a "ladder", is a state-of-the-art vertical mobility device, allowing your intrepid crew to scamper around the exterior of your ship like highly caffeinated rodents. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「MK II 机动增强器」在某些圈子里被称作「梯子」，是一套顶尖的垂直移动装置，可让你勇敢的乘员像喝多了咖啡的啮齿动物一样在飞船外壁窜来窜去。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The MK III Mobility Enhancer, known in some circles as a "ladder", is a state-of-the-art vertical mobility device, allowing your intrepid crew to scamper around the exterior of your ship like highly caffeinated rodents. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「MK III 机动增强器」在某些圈子里被称作「梯子」，是一套顶尖的垂直移动装置，可让你勇敢的乘员像喝多了咖啡的啮齿动物一样在飞船外壁窜来窜去。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The Mars Landing Engine (MLE) is a derivative of the highly successful MR-80 engine used for the two Viking missions to Mars in 1976. Eight of these engines were used on the sky-crane which landed the Curiosity Rover on the martian surface. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 火星着陆发动机（MLE）是极为成功的 MR-80 发动机的衍生型，后者曾用于 1976 年的两次海盗号火星任务。八台该发动机用于把好奇号火星车送上火星表面的空中吊车。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Medium Apollo Style Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the very bottom of your rockets before launch to hold them in place. From ROEngines mod
zh: 中型阿波罗风格发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭最底部，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Medium Launch clamp is designed to be used with the early launch vehicles like the A-Series US Rockets and R-Series Soviet Rockets. It has a 1.65 m opening. From ROEngines mod
zh: 中型发射夹具，适用于 A 系列美国火箭与 R 系列苏联火箭等早期运载火箭。开口尺寸 1.65 m。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Medium Radial Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the sides of rockets to hold them in place before launching. From ROEngines mod
zh: 中型径向发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭侧面，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Mercury retro motor, intended to deorbit the capsule. Place 3 on the Mercury Retropack. These were fired in sequence at five second intervals. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Mercury 反推发动机，用于让座舱脱离轨道。在 Mercury 反推包上安装 3 台。它们按 5 秒间隔依次点火。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Merlin 1C was the first productive engine used on the Falcon 1 and Falcon 9 launch vehicles. Diameter: [0.94 m]. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Merlin 1C 是猎鹰 1 号与猎鹰 9 号运载火箭上使用的第一种量产发动机。直径：[0.94 m]。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Merlin 1D was the first major production version of the first stage SpaceX Engine. Diameter: [0.94 m]. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Merlin 1D 是 SpaceX 第一级发动机的首个主要量产版本。直径：[0.94 m]。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Mobile Launch Pad (MLP) and Launch Umbilical Tower (LUT) for the Saturn V launch vehicle. From DECQ_SaturnV mod
zh: 土星五号运载火箭的移动发射台（MLP）与发射脐带塔（LUT）。 来自 DECQ_SaturnV mod

en: The Modular Cargo Bay gives you the flexibility to design the size and style of cargo bay needed for every mission and spacecraft. These are based on the Mars DRM trusses. From ROTanks mod
zh: 模块化货舱让您可以按每次任务与航天器的需要，灵活设计货舱的尺寸与样式。它们基于火星 DRM 桁架。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: The Multi-Mission RTG or MMRTG was designed for the Mars Science Laboratory and the Curiosity Rover for use on Mars. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 多任务放射性同位素温差发电机（MMRTG）是为火星科学实验室与「好奇」号火星车在火星上使用而设计的。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The Multihundred-Watt radioisotope thermoelectric generators (MHW-RTG) as found on the Voyager spacecraft and two Lincoln Experimental Satellites. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 多百瓦级放射性同位素温差发电机（MHW-RTG），即「旅行者」号探测器与两颗林肯实验卫星上使用的型号。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The NASA Docking System (NDS) is a spacecraft docking and berthing mechanism for US human spaceflight vehicles, such as the Orion Multi-Purpose Crew Vehicle and the Commercial Crew vehicles. From ROCapsules mod
zh: NASA 对接系统（NDS）是一种用于美国载人航天器的对接与停泊机构，例如 Orion 多用途乘员飞行器与商业载人飞船。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The NK-12 was a large 1950s turboprop. Created to power the Tu-95, it is the largest turboprop to enter production. It powered the A-90, An-22, Tu-95, Tu-114, Tu-116, Tu-126, and Tu-142. From SXT mod
zh: NK-12 是 1950 年代的大型涡轮螺桨发动机，为图-95 研制，是投入量产的最大涡轮螺桨发动机。它驱动了 A-90、安-22、图-95、图-114、图-116、图-126 与图-142。 来自 SXT mod

en: The NK-33 design was sold to Aerojet in the mid 1990s. Aerojet modified it to create the AJ26. Non-reusable version for Antares. testedBurnTime=450
zh: NK-33 设计于 1990 年代中期卖给 Aerojet。Aerojet 将其改进为 AJ26。这是供 Antares 使用的非重复使用版本。testedBurnTime=450

en: The NK-33 design was sold to Aerojet in the mid 1990s. Aerojet modified it to create the AJ26. This is a single start reusable version, intended for the K-1 first stage. testedBurnTime=5870
zh: NK-33 设计于 1990 年代中期卖给 Aerojet。Aerojet 将其改进为 AJ26。这是单次启动的可重复使用版本，供 K-1 第一级使用。testedBurnTime=5870

en: The NK-33 design was sold to Aerojet in the mid 1990s. Aerojet modified it to create the AJ26. This is a single start reusable version, intended for the K-1 second stage. testedBurnTime=5870
zh: NK-33 设计于 1990 年代中期卖给 Aerojet。Aerojet 将其改进为 AJ26。这是单次启动的可重复使用版本，供 K-1 第二级使用。testedBurnTime=5870

en: The NK-33 design was sold to Aerojet in the mid 1990s. Aerojet modified it to create the AJ26. This is a two start reusable version, intended for the K-1 first stage. testedBurnTime=5870
zh: NK-33 设计于 1990 年代中期卖给 Aerojet。Aerojet 将其改进为 AJ26。这是两次启动的可重复使用版本，供 K-1 第一级使用。testedBurnTime=5870

en: The Nord 1500 ramjet was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to an Atar 101E. Used on the Griffon II experimental aircraft, the Atar 101 would accelerate the aircraft up to the speed of sound, at which point the ramjet could act as a thrust augmentor and accelerate aircraft up to speeds over Mach 2. Although the Griffon II performed well, it was cancelled in favor of more conventional aircraft. From Advanced Jet Engines mod
zh: Nord 1500 冲压发动机是一台组合循环冲压发动机，与阿塔 101E 配合使用。在「狮鹫」II 试验机上，阿塔 101 先把飞机加速到声速，之后冲压发动机可作为推力增强器把飞机加速到 2 马赫以上。尽管「狮鹫」II 表现良好，它仍被取消，转而发展更常规的飞机。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod

en: The Pegasus II Mobility Enhancer, known in some circles as a "ladder", is a state-of-the-art vertical mobility device, allowing your intrepid crew to scamper around the exterior of your ship like highly caffeinated rodents. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「飞马 II 机动增强器」在某些圈子里被称作「梯子」，是一套顶尖的垂直移动装置，可让你勇敢的乘员像喝多了咖啡的啮齿动物一样在飞船外壁窜来窜去。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The Pegasus III Mobility Enhancer, known in some circles as a "ladder", is a state-of-the-art vertical mobility device, allowing your intrepid crew to scamper around the exterior of your ship like highly caffeinated rodents. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 「飞马 III 机动增强器」在某些圈子里被称作「梯子」，是一套顶尖的垂直移动装置，可让你勇敢的乘员像喝多了咖啡的啮齿动物一样在飞船外壁窜来窜去。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The RD-0110R is a four-chamber, gas generator, surface kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the first stage of the Soyuz-2-1V launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-0110R 是一台四燃烧室的燃气发生器表面式煤油液氧游动发动机。它用于联盟-2-1V 运载火箭系列的第一级，做双轴姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RD-012 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the La-350 Burya cruise missile up to Mach 3.1. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-012 是一款超声速冲压发动机，为 La-350「暴风」巡航导弹研制，速度可达 3.1 马赫。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RD-120 is a staged combustion vacuum kerolox engine used as the main power plant on the Zenit launch vehicle family second stage. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-120 是一台分级燃烧真空煤油液氧发动机，作为天顶号运载火箭系列第二级的主动力装置。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RD-180 is a two-chamber derivative of the four-chamber RD-170/171 and powers the first stage of the Atlas III & Atlas V. Diameter: [3.5 m]. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-180 是四燃烧室 RD-170/171 的双燃烧室衍生型，为宇宙神 III 与宇宙神 V 的第一级提供动力。直径：[3.5 m]。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RD-8 is a four-chamber, staged combustion, vacuum kerolox vernier engine. It is used on the second stage of the Zenit launch vehicle family for two-axis attitude control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-8 是一台四燃烧室分级燃烧真空煤油液氧游动发动机。它用于天顶号运载火箭系列的第二级，负责双轴姿态控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RJ43 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the CIM-10 Bomarc surface to air missile at speeds up to Mach 3. It was also used on the X-7 and XQ-5/AQM-60 target drone, and was modified to power the D-21 up to speeds over Mach 3.3. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RJ43 是一款超声速冲压发动机，为 CIM-10「波马克」面对空导弹研制，速度可达 3 马赫。它也曾用于 X-7 与 XQ-5/AQM-60 靶机，并改装后把 D-21 推进到 3.3 马赫以上。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RJ47 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the SM-64 Navaho cruise missile up to Mach 2.75. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RJ47 是一款超声速冲压发动机，为 SM-64「纳瓦霍」巡航导弹研制，工作速度可达 2.75 马赫。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RJ55 was a combined cycle ramjet, mated to a J67. At low speeds, the RJ55 functioned as an afterburner for the J67 turbojet, but at mach 2.24 the turbojet would be shut down and the RJ55 would power the aircraft up to Mach 3. Designed for the XF-103, but difficuties with the J67 turbojet meant the prototype never flew under it's own power. From Advanced Jet Engines mod
zh: RJ55 是一台组合循环冲压发动机，与 J67 涡喷发动机配合使用。低速时 RJ55 相当于 J67 的加力燃烧室；到 2.24 马赫时涡喷发动机关机，由 RJ55 把飞机推进到 3 马赫。它为 XF-103 设计，但 J67 涡喷的困难使原型机始终未能靠自身动力飞行。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod

en: The RJ59 was a supersonic ramjet, designed to power the Convair Super Hustler. Although the Super Hustler was cancelled, the RJ59 was fitted to the X-7 for testing, where it was able to achieve speeds over Mach 4. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RJ59 是一款超声速冲压发动机，为「超级走私者」（Super Hustler）研制。虽然「超级走私者」被取消，RJ59 仍被装到 X-7 上试验，达到了 4 马赫以上的速度。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The RS-25, also known as the Space Shuttle Main Engine (SSME), is a LH2/LOX fuel-rich staged combustion engine. Though complex and expensive, these engines provide very high performance and are extremely reliable. Three of these engines powered each Shuttle Orbiter and four power the core stage of the SLS. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RS-25 又称航天飞机主发动机（SSME），是一台液氢/液氧富燃分级燃烧发动机。虽然复杂而昂贵，但这些发动机性能极高、可靠性极佳。每架航天飞机轨道器由三台这样的发动机驱动，SLS 的芯级则由四台驱动。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Raptor is a methalox full-flow staged combustion engine designed for both Starship & the Super Heavy Launch Vehicle. The Super Heavy first stage uses 33 sea-level optimized engines, and Starship uses 3 sea-level engines and 3 vacuum engines. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Raptor 是为星舰与超重型运载火箭设计的甲烷液氧全流量分级燃烧发动机。超重型第一级使用 33 台海平面优化发动机，星舰则使用 3 台海平面发动机与 3 台真空发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Reaction Motors XLR10 was an early rocket developed to power the Viking sounding rocket. Intended to replace the V-2, the Viking sounding rocket was successful, but ultimately cancelled due to high costs. It was revived to create the first stage of the Vanguard launch vehicle, with the XLR10 modified to create the XLR50 (X-405). From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 反应发动机公司（Reaction Motors）的 XLR10 是一款早期火箭发动机，用于驱动维京探空火箭。维京探空火箭意在取代 V-2，研制虽然成功，但最终因成本过高而被取消。后来它被重新启用，用作先锋运载火箭的第一级，XLR10 经改型成为 XLR50（X-405）。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Reaction Motors XLR11 (internal designation 6000C-4) was a small rocket motor designed to power experimental high-speed aircraft, including the X-1, early X-15s, X-24B, and D-558-2. Its four combustion chambers were ignited independently, which is represented as the ability to throttle in discrete steps. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 反应发动机公司的 XLR11（内部代号 6000C-4）是一台小型火箭发动机，用于驱动 X-1、早期 X-15、X-24B 与 D-558-2 等试验用高速飞机。它的四个燃烧室可独立点火，游戏中表现为分档节流的能力。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Ring Decoupler allows you to change the Diameter of the part to fit many different configurations for your craft. It allows for customization of Decoupling just the bottom node as normal, or both nodes like a separator. From ROTanks mod
zh: 环形分离器可让您改变零件直径，以适配飞行器的多种布局。解耦方式也可定制：只像普通那样解耦底部节点，或像分离器那样同时解耦两个节点。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: The Rocketdyne HG-3 engine, which served as a stepping stone between the J-2 and RS-25. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Rocketdyne HG-3 发动机，是 J-2 与 RS-25 之间的踏脚石。请按需启用滚转能力或关闭万向摆动。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Rocketdyne J-2 rocket engine was the first large hydrolox engine. Five powered the S-II stage on the Saturn V and one was used on the S-IVB stage of the Saturn IB and V. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Rocketdyne J-2 火箭发动机是第一台大型氢氧发动机。土星 V 的 S-II 级用五台，土星 IB 与土星 V 的 S-IVB 级各用一台。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Rotating Service Structure (RSS) for the Shuttle Launcher Base, used to access and change out the orbiter's payload bay IRL; this version can not be used for that. It attaches to a large node located on the top of the RSS Hinge's central pole. The RSS support legs can be switched between the default height for the stock tier 3 pad and a shorter height for the larger LC-39 pad in Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended. The RSS can be closed and rolled out via an animation...a slow animation, as this thing is huge after all! From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架底座的旋转服务结构（RSS），现实中用于进出并更换轨道器的载荷舱，本模组版本不具备该功能。它附着在 RSS 铰链中心柱顶部的大节点上。RSS 支撑腿可在原版三级发射台的默认高度与 Tundra's Space Center/KSC Extended 更大 LC-39 发射台所需的较矮高度之间切换。RSS 可通过动画合拢与外摆——不过动画比较慢，毕竟这东西实在太大了！ 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Rutherford engine is the world's first electrically pumped engine. It adopts an entirely new propulsion cycle, making use of brushless DC motors and high performance lithium polymer batteries to drive its pumps. The engine is named after the New Zealand-born physicist Ernest Rutherford. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 卢瑟福发动机是世界上第一台电泵发动机。它采用全新的推进循环，用无刷直流电机与高性能锂聚合物电池驱动泵。该发动机以新西兰出生的物理学家欧内斯特·卢瑟福命名。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The S1.5400A engine, as used on Block ML on the Molniya M launch vehicle. Further performance improvements to the basic S1.5400/11D33 engine. testedBurnTime=450
zh: S1.5400A 发动机，用于闪电-M 运载火箭的 ML 段。在基本型 S1.5400/11D33 上进一步提升性能。testedBurnTime=450

en: The S400 400N bipropellant Engine is designed for apogee orbit injection of geostationary satellites and for trajectory and planetary orbit maneuvers of deep space probes. Notable missions include Galileo, Mars Express, Venus Express & the ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter. [Uses RCS Configuration] From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: S400 400N 双组元发动机用于地球同步卫星的远地点入轨，以及深空探测器的轨道与行星捕获机动。著名任务包括伽利略号、火星快车、金星快车与 ExoMars 微量气体轨道器。[使用 RCS 构型] 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The SNAP-19 series were originally developed for the Nimbus weather satellite program, complementing the regular solar arrays and countering their degradation due to radiation. Later, they were also used by the Pioneer 10 and 11 spacecrafts, along with the Viking Mars landers. Similar to the SNAP-9 series but with over 40% better conversion efficiency. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: SNAP-19 系列最初为「雨云」（Nimbus）气象卫星计划研制，作为常规太阳能电池阵列的补充，抵消其在辐射下的衰减。后来也被「先驱者」10 号与 11 号探测器以及「海盗」号火星着陆器使用。与 SNAP-9 系列相似，但转换效率高出 40% 以上。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The SNAP-3 series were the first radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs) to ever operate in space, as part of the Transit system (precursor to the current GPS system). Very low overall efficiency, with target power generation of 2.4 watts. Plutonium-238 variant, with lower power but much longer life. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: SNAP-3 系列是史上首批在太空工作的放射性同位素温差发电机（RTG），作为「子午仪」（Transit）系统的组成部分（该系统是现今 GPS 的前身）。总体效率极低，目标发电功率 2.4 瓦。此为钚-238 版本，功率较低但寿命长得多。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The SNAP-3 series were the first radioisotope thermoelectric generators (RTGs) to ever operate in space, as part of the Transit system (precursor to the current GPS system). Very low overall efficiency, with target power generation of 2.4 watts. Polonium-210 variant, with higher power, but a design life of only 90 days. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: SNAP-3 系列是史上首批在太空工作的放射性同位素温差发电机（RTG），作为「子午仪」（Transit）系统的组成部分（该系统是现今 GPS 的前身）。总体效率极低，目标发电功率 2.4 瓦。此为钋-210 版本，功率更高，但设计寿命仅 90 天。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The SNAP-9 series were evolved designs of the experimental SNAP-3 series, again as part of the Transit system (precursor to the current GPS system), but now featuring over 10 times higher power generation. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: SNAP-9 系列是实验性 SNAP-3 系列的演进设计，同样属于「子午仪」系统（现今 GPS 的前身），但发电功率提升了 10 倍以上。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The SR19 is an improved Minuteman second stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: SR19 是为 LGM-30F 民兵 II 研制的民兵第二级改进型。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The SR73 is an improved Minuteman third stage developed for the LGM-30F Minuteman II. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: SR73 是为 LGM-30F 民兵 II 研制的民兵第三级改进型。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The STAR 37 is a vacuum solid rocket motor originally developed as a braking stage for the Surveyor lunar lander program. Later variants were used exclusively as apogee kick stages. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 星 37 是一款真空固体火箭发动机，最初作为勘测者月球着陆器计划的制动级研制。后来的各变体则专门用作远地点发动机级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The STAR 37E is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the Delta 1000 launch vehicle family as a third stage kick motor. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: STAR 37E 是经典的 STAR 37 固体火箭发动机的改进型，装药量更大、效率更高，真空推力也更大。它最初被用作德尔塔 1000（Delta 1000）运载火箭系列第三级的末助推发动机。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The STAR 37FM is an improved version of the venerable STAR 37 solid rocket motor, featuring increased propellant loading, higher efficiency, and more vacuum thrust. It was first used on the FTLSATCOM satellites as an apogee motor. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: STAR 37FM 是经典的 STAR 37 固体火箭发动机的改进型，装药量更大、效率更高，真空推力也更大。它最初用于 FTLSATCOM 卫星，作为远地点发动机。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The STAR 5D rocket motor was designed and qualified to serve as the Rocket-Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor on the Mars Pathfinder mission. Three of these motors were fired to slow the Pathfinder spacecraft to near-zero velocity before bouncing on the surface of Mars. From ROEngines mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: STAR 5D 火箭发动机是为火星探路者任务的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机而设计并通过鉴定的。三台该型发动机在着陆前点火，把探路者号减速到接近零速，随后弹跳着落到火星表面。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The STAR 8 was developed and qualified as the Rocket Assisted Deceleration (RAD) motor for the Mars Exploration Rover (MER) program. The motor is based on the STAR 5D motor technology developed for JPL’s Mars Pathfinder program. The STAR 8 first flew in January 2004 when three motors were used to decelerate each of the Spirit and Opportunity rovers for landing at Gusev Crater and Meridiani Planum on Mars. From ROEngines mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: STAR 8 是为火星探测车（MER）计划研制并通过鉴定的火箭辅助减速（RAD）发动机。该发动机基于为 JPL 火星探路者计划开发的 STAR 5D 技术。STAR 8 于 2004 年 1 月首飞，当时三台发动机分别用于勇气号与机遇号探测车的减速，使其在火星的古谢夫环形山与子午线高原着陆。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The Small Apollo Style Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the very bottom of your rockets before launch to hold them in place. From ROEngines mod
zh: 小型阿波罗风格发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭最底部，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Small General Crew Access Arm with a mount for the Mini General Crew Elevator, available in 8 colors. Has 4 length variants, each with end or side hatch access styles. The end hatch access section can be adjusted inward using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用乘员通道臂，底座对应迷你通用乘员升降机，提供8种配色。共有4种长度变体，每种都含端部登舱与侧面登舱两种样式。端部登舱段可用展开限制滑块向内调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Small General Crew Access Arm with a mount for the Small General Crew Elevator, available in 8 colors. Has 5 length variants, each with end or side hatch access styles. The end hatch access section can be adjusted inward using the deploy limit slider. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用乘员通道臂，底座对应小型通用乘员升降机，提供8种配色。共有5种长度变体，每种都含端部登舱与侧面登舱两种样式。端部登舱段可用展开限制滑块向内调节。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The Small Launch Clamp is designed for use with Sounding Rockets. From ROEngines mod
zh: 小型发射夹具，适用于探空火箭。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Small Radial Launch Clamp is designed to be attached to the sides of rockets to hold them in place before launching. From ROEngines mod
zh: 小型径向发射夹具，用于在发射前固定在火箭侧面，把火箭稳住。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The Star 13 was developed in the mid-1960s as the braking motor for the AIMP program, and was used on Explorer 33 and 35. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 星 13 于 1960 年代中期作为 AIMP 计划的制动发动机研制，曾用于探险者 33 与 35。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Star 13A was developed in the mid-1960s as an apogee motor for Thor-Burner II. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 星 13A 于 1960 年代中期作为雷神-伯纳 II 的远地点发动机研制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The TF34 is a 1970s high-bypass turbofan. It powered the S-3, S-72, and A-10, while its civilian derivative, the CF34, powered many large private jets and regional airliners such as the Challenger 600 Series, Challenger 850, CRJ100/200/440/700/900, and the Embraer 170/175/190/195. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: TF34 是 1970 年代的高涵道比涡扇发动机。它驱动了 S-3、S-72 与 A-10，其民用衍生型 CF34 则驱动了许多大型公务机与支线客机，如「挑战者」600 系列、「挑战者」850、CRJ100/200/440/700/900 以及巴西航空工业 E170/175/190/195。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The TT06-A Stability Enhancer uses ground-breaking fastening technology to significantly increase the stability of spacecraft during the pre-launch phase. While OMB Demolition has been criticized in the past for using "big fancy words for a rocket holder" in their description of their device, none can say the TT18 series doesn't deliver rock-solid clamping action, as advertised. The owner's manual strongly suggests these devices be placed on the bottommost section of the spacecraft, and activated as soon as the engines are lit, for optimal de-clamping performance. From SXT mod
zh: TT06-A 稳定增强器采用突破性的紧固技术，可显著提高飞行器在发射前的稳定性。OMB 拆解公司过去曾因在自家装置描述里滥用「给火箭支架起的华丽大词」而受到批评，但没人能说 TT18 系列没有像宣传的那样提供稳如磐石的夹持效果。用户手册强烈建议把这些装置装在飞行器最底部，并在发动机一点火就立即启用，以获得最佳的解脱夹持效果。 来自 SXT mod

en: The Titan IVB Solid Rocket Motor Upgrade (also known as the Upgraded Solid Rocket Motor or USRM), was developed with the goal of 25% more capacity than the Titan IVA with the UA1207 SRM. It achieved this through a more energetic propellant and a 3-segment composite case that carried more fuel and weighed less than the UA1207's 7-segment steel case. Burn time 150 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 泰坦 IVB 固体助推器升级型（又称升级型固体助推器或 USRM），研制目标是比使用 UA1207 固体助推器的泰坦 IVA 提升 25% 运力。它通过能量更高的推进剂，以及比 UA1207 的 7 段钢壳体更轻、装药更多的 3 段复合材料壳体实现了这一目标。燃烧时间 150 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The UA1207 was used on the Titan IVA, which was developed to launch payloads that had been designed to fly on the Shuttle from Vandenberg. It was a 7-segment modification of the 5-segment UA1205 used on the Titan 3. Burn time 130 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: UA1207 用于泰坦 IVA，该火箭是为发射原计划由航天飞机从范登堡基地运送的有效载荷而研制的。它是由泰坦 3 所用 5 段式 UA1205 改成 7 段的型号。燃烧时间 130 秒。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The Umbilical Tower functions as both a launch clamp and a fuel pump. This will keep your fuel filled up while waiting on the launch pad for your launch window. To start the fuel flow, right click on the tower. From ROEngines mod
zh: 脐带塔兼具发射夹具与燃料泵的功能。在发射台上等待发射窗口时，它会持续把燃料加满。右键点击塔体即可开始输送燃料。 来自 ROEngines mod

en: The VA command module is part of the TKS/FGB spacecraft. It can be attached either to the FGB module of the TKS, to the front section of the Almaz station or to both. In the latter case, the station could be launched manned with the crew riding to orbit inside the VA capsule. The crew would be able to exit and enter the VA capsule in orbit via a hatch in the heat shield located at the bottom of the craft. Supports three crew for one day. Center of mass can be offset to allow lifting reentry (toggle Descent Mode). From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: VA 指令舱是 TKS/FGB 航天器的组成部分。它既可以接到 TKS 的 FGB 舱段上，也可以接到「金刚石」号空间站的前部，或两者都接。若是后者，空间站就能以载人方式发射，乘员坐在 VA 返回舱中进入轨道。乘员可在轨道上通过位于飞行器底部热防护罩上的舱门进出 VA 返回舱。可支持三名乘员一天。可偏置质心以实现升力再入（切换「下降模式」）。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: The Vernier System as used on the Surveyor Probes. It uses storable hypergolic propellants, has infinite restarts, is not subject to ullage, and is throttleable down to 30%. Historically 3 of them were used on the Surveyor probes which landed on the Moon. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于勘测者（Surveyor）探测器的游标发动机系统。它使用可长期贮存的自燃推进剂，可无限次重启，不受推进剂沉底影响，并可将推力节流至 30%。历史上登陆月球的勘测者探测器各用了 3 台。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Viking lander Terminal Descent Engine (TDE). The lander had three such engines, which were used during the final 45 seconds or so of the descent to the surface of Mars. Multiple small exhaust nozzles are used to diffuse the exhaust plume to eliminate a recirculation zone that could contaminate spacecraft instrumentation and avoid potential extensive erosion of the landing site. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 海盗号着陆器的末端下降发动机（TDE）。着陆器装有三台这样的发动机，在降落火星表面的最后约 45 秒内工作。多个小排气喷管用于分散羽流，以消除可能污染航天器仪器的回流区，并避免对着陆点造成可能的严重侵蚀。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The Voskhod Airlock will allow for your crew to perform an EVA from the Voskhod airlock. Attach this to the node on the side of the Voskhod capsule. Transfer your crew memeber inside and perform your EVA. Be sure to decouple this before re-entry. From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: Voskhod 气闸可让乘员经该气闸出舱活动。将其安装在 Voskhod 座舱侧面的节点上。把乘员转移进去，然后执行 EVA。请务必在再入前将它分离。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The Voskhod SA Descent Module was a re-purposed version of the Vostok SA. It was retrofitted to allow for an Airlock attachment for EVA and even to fit 3 cosmonauts. However, with 3 cosmonauts, there was not enough room to wear pressure suits. The SA stands for Spuskaemiy Apparat (Descent System) and was designed as a ballistic reentry capsule. [Diameter 2.3 m] From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume. THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: Voskhod SA 下降舱是 Vostok SA 的改用途版本。它经过改装，可加装用于 EVA 的气闸，甚至能容纳 3 名航天员。不过搭载 3 名航天员时，舱内已没有穿压力服的空间。SA 意为 Spuskaemiy Apparat（下降系统），按弹道再入舱设计。[直径 2.3 m] 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: The Vostok SA Descent Module was the first spacecraft to carry humans into space when Yuri Gagarin flew on April 12, 1961. The SA stands for Spuskaemiy Apparat (Descent System) and was designed as a ballistic reentry capsule. [Diameter 2.3 m] From ROCapsules mod THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: Vostok SA 下降舱是首个把人类送入太空的航天器——1961 年 4 月 12 日，Yuri Gagarin 乘其飞行。SA 意为 Spuskaemiy Apparat（下降系统），按弹道再入舱设计。[直径 2.3 m] 来自 ROCapsules mod 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: The WS-10 is a modern low-bypass afterburning turbofan, and the first successful Chinese turbofan design. Developed from the earlier experimental WS-6 turbofan, the WS-10 was designed to replace the Russian AL-31 engines used in some Chinese aircraft. The WS-10 powers the J-8II, J-10B/C, J-11B, J-15, J-16, and J-20/A. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: WS-10（涡扇-10）是一款现代低涵道比加力涡扇发动机，也是中国第一个成功的涡扇发动机型号。它由早期试验性的 WS-6 涡扇发展而来，用以取代部分中国飞机上使用的俄制 AL-31。WS-10 驱动了歼-8II、歼-10B/C、歼-11B、歼-15、歼-16 与歼-20/A。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: The Waxwing was a small solid kick motor for circularizing payloads in orbit, used as a third stage on the Black Arrow launch vehicle in 1970-71. 29.4kN average thrust. From SXT mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 「太平鸟」（Waxwing）是一台小型固体末助推发动机，用于在轨道上把载荷圆化；1970—71 年作为「黑箭」运载火箭的第三级使用。平均推力 29.4 kN。 来自 SXT mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The Winged Gemini experiment was designed so that Gemini could land on a runway. It would have greatly reduced the cost of recovery, but it was so unstable and hard to control in tests that it was abandoned. See if you can do better! Keep the AoA high during reentry, and then drop the nose to keep your speed up. Atmosphereic Autopilot or other fly-by-wire mods strongly recommended. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 有翼 Gemini 试验的目的是让 Gemini 能在跑道上着陆。这本可大幅降低回收成本，但它在试验中太不稳定、太难以控制，最终被放弃。看看你能不能做得更好！再入时保持较大迎角，之后再压低机头以维持速度。强烈建议配合 Atmosphereic Autopilot 或其他电传操纵 mod 使用。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The XLR25 was designed for the X-2, to test higher speeds and altitudes than the X-1. It was the first continuously throttleable engine designed in the US. Although the engine was successful, the X-2 proved extremely unstable at high speeds and only a few flights were undertaken. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: XLR25 是为 X-2 飞机研制的，用来试验比 X-1 更高的速度与更大的高度。它是美国设计的第一台可连续节流的发动机。虽然发动机研制成功，但 X-2 在高速下极不稳定，仅进行了少数几次飞行。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The XM-20 Sergeant was a Castor predecessor that was used on the X-17 hypersonic test vehicle.
zh: XM-20 Sergeant 是 Castor 的前身，曾用于 X-17 高超声速试验飞行器。

en: The Zenit Descent Module was developed in parallel with the Vostok Descent Module, for photoreconnaissance use. Placing the camera equipment in a pressurized capsule made development much easier, and the cameras and film could be recovered together, reducing cost. Historically used as a spy satellite, but for our peaceful RP-1 purposes, these represent the earliest weather satellite photos. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Zenit 下降舱与 Vostok 下降舱并行研制，用于照相侦察。把摄影设备放进增压座舱大大简化了研制工作，相机与胶片还能一并回收，从而降低成本。历史上它被用作间谍卫星，但在我们 RP-1 的和平用途里，它代表最早的气象卫星照片。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The abort motor of the LES is a powerful solid rocket motor, designed specifically to carry away the Apollo Command Module in the case of a pad or a low altitude flight abort. The pitch motor of the LES imparts a small attitude change to the Apollo Command Module during an abort. This ensures that the CM will have sufficient clearance from the launch vehicle after the LES abort motor burns out. The first engine module is the Escape Motor, the second module is the Jettison Motor, and the third is the pitch motor. Fire the escape and pitch motors to abort, then activate the jettision motor to pull the tower clear of the CM. From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 发射逃逸系统（LES）的逃逸发动机是一台大推力固体火箭发动机，专门设计用于在台架或低空飞行中止时把 Apollo 指令舱带离。LES 的俯仰发动机在中止过程中为 Apollo 指令舱施加小幅姿态变化，以确保 LES 逃逸发动机燃烧结束后 CM 与运载火箭之间有足够间距。第一级发动机模块是逃逸发动机，第二级模块是抛弃发动机，第三级是俯仰发动机。中止时点燃逃逸发动机与俯仰发动机，随后启动抛弃发动机把塔架从 CM 上拉开。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The aft bay and adapter for Dynasoar, containing liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen for the fuel cells, space for extra supplies and equipment, and a crew tube. Rated for high altitude hypersonic flight, but decouple before reentry. From ROCapsules mod
zh: DynaSoar 的后部舱段兼转接器，内装供燃料电池使用的液氢与液氧，并为额外补给与设备留出空间，另有一条乘员通道。可承受高空高超声速飞行，但请在再入前分离。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The antenna mast for the Titan II GLV Service Tower. It attaches to a small node on the top of the tower, on the top of the arm mount rail. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔的天线桅杆。它附着在塔顶摆臂安装导轨顶端的一个小节点上。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The ascent stage and crew compartment of the Apollo Lunar Module. Supports a crew of two for up to 3 days of active operations. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 登月舱的上升段兼乘员舱。可支持 2 名乘员最多 3 天的主动运行。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The attitude control thruster blocks of the Apollo Service Module (SM). Four of these allow full three-axis attitude control and translation of the Apollo CSM. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 服务舱（SM）的姿态控制推力器组。四组这样的推力器可实现 Apollo CSM 完整的三轴姿态控制与平移。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The auxiliary structure used for the Titan II and IV, mounted on the mobile launch platform and positioned to be directly in front of the main fixed tower. The mast has multiple height variants and 8 color options. The top portion can be swutched between the older solid structure type, the later open-truss type, and the open-truss with a small plate on the front. The center trusses have attach nodes for attaching umbilicals and swing arms if desired. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 泰坦II与泰坦IV所用的辅助结构，安装在活动发射平台上，位置正对主固定塔的前方。桅杆有多种高度变体与8种配色。顶部可在较早的实心结构型、后期的开放式钢架型，以及正面带一块小板的开放式钢架型之间切换。中段的钢架上有附着节点，需要时可用于安装脐带与摆臂。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the Extra Large General Crew Elevator tower with a 130m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options and optional side panels in multiple configurations; the panel color can also be changed. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 超大型通用乘员升降机塔的基座段，配有一台130米高的电梯轿厢。另购的升降机塔节段可向上拼接到其顶部。基座段有8种配色，还可选配多种配置的侧板；侧板颜色同样可以更改。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可用展开限制滑块下调。轿厢也可直接关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the Large General Crew Elevator tower with a 70m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options and two toggleable styles of truss: General and Saturn types. Optional side panels in either 3 or 4-side configurations are also available. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员升降机塔的基座段，配有一台70米高的电梯轿厢。另购的升降机塔节段可向上拼接到其顶部。基座段有8种配色，钢架样式可在通用型与土星型之间切换。还可选配三面或四面配置的侧板。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可用展开限制滑块下调。轿厢也可直接关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the Shuttle Launcher's Fixed Service Structure (FSS) tower. It ataches to a large node off to the side of the shuttle launcher base. Two different height variants allow it to be used with the stock Tier 2 launch pad or the LC-39 pad from KSC Extended. Base has two independent elevators with multiple height options; each elevator can alos be turned off. Elevators have to be brought down first, then can be raised. Adjust the maximum stopping height with the deploy limit slider. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable. Hatches on the elevator cars allow an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架的固定服务结构（FSS）塔基段。它附着在发射架底座侧面的大节点上。两种不同高度的变体使其可用于原版二级发射台，或 KSC Extended 的 LC-39 发射台。基段有两部独立电梯，各有多种高度可选；每部电梯也可单独关闭。电梯须先降至底部，之后才能升起。最大停止高度可用展开限制滑块调节。另有可选的侧板，每侧可单独开关。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the Small General Crew Elevator tower with a 50m high elevator car. The separate elevator tower sections are attached to to the top. The base section has 8 color options, and the front wall can be either partially turned off (leaving the horizontal beam), or fully removed, allowing a short elevator to be made for ground access to the deck of a launch base. The elevator car's stopping height can be moved downward with the deploy limit slider. The elevator car can also be turned off. Hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用乘员升降机塔的基座段，配有一台50米高的电梯轿厢。另购的升降机塔节段可向上拼接到其顶部。基座段有8种配色，前墙可部分关闭（保留横向横梁）或完全拆除，从而做成一部矮升降机，用于从地面登上发射基座的平台。电梯轿厢的停靠高度可用展开限制滑块下调。轿厢也可直接关闭。轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach the mast core sections to the top of the base. Eight color options are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas V斜置式服务桅杆模块化版本的基座段。桅杆核心段可拼接到基座顶部。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the tower core sections to the top of the base. Eight color options are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔2号式服务塔模块化版本的基座段。塔架核心段可拼接到基座顶部。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The base section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower. Attach the tower core sections to the top of the base. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔模块化版本的基座段。塔架核心段可拼接到基座顶部。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The basic D-2 mission module, containing an airlock, life support supplies, and extended battery power, but no docking capability. Contains life support supplies, and extended battery power. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 基础型 D-2 任务舱，内设气闸、生保补给与扩展电池电力，但不具备对接能力。可装生保补给与扩展电池电力。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The booster engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the core engine series (RD-108) with a higher chamber pressure, thrust, and smaller vernier layout. The R-7 family core was supplemented for (roughly) two minutes by four strap-on boosters powered by these engines. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: R-7“谢苗尔卡”及其衍生型号（包括卫星号、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号与闪电号运载火箭）的助推发动机。它与芯级发动机系列（RD-108）的区别在于燃烧室压力与推力更高、游动发动机布局更紧凑。R-7 家族芯级由四个捆绑助推器上的这些发动机补推约两分钟。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The command module of the CST-100 "Starliner" Commercial Crew Transportation System (COTS). Designed to be reusable for up to 10 times. Supports a crew of 7 for 2 days. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CST-100“Starliner”商业载人运输系统（COTS）的指令舱。设计可重复使用最多 10 次。可支持 7 名乘员执行 2 天任务。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The companion service tower for the Vanguard Launch Stand, attaching to one of the outer nodes. The tower is sized for the BDB Vanguard rocket with the stand placed at ground level, with half-height (9m) and full-height (18m) variants. The base frame and top beam can be toggled off to allow stacking of multiple tower sections. The front detail structure can also be turned off. 9 color options are also available. Uses separate umbilicals which are node-attached. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Vanguard发射支架的配套服务塔，附着在外侧节点之一上。该塔的尺寸对应置于地面的支架与BDB的Vanguard火箭，并有半高（9米）与全高（18米）两种变体。基座框架与顶梁可以关闭，以便把多节塔架叠接起来。正面的细节结构也可关闭。另有9种配色。使用以节点附着的独立脐带。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core (lower) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to a large node off to the side of the SLC6 Shuttle Launch Mount. Has multiple height variants, and two color options. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure. Has one crew elevator, which has to be brought down first, then can be raised. Adjust the maximum stopping height with the deploy limit slider. A hatch on the elevator car allows an alternate method of travel. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: SLC-6 航天飞机塔的核心（下部）段。它附着在 SLC-6 航天飞机发射支座侧面的大节点上。有多种高度变体，两种配色。侧面的节点用于安装 SLC-6 航天飞机级间结构。配有一部乘员电梯，须先降至底部才能升起。最大停止高度可用展开限制滑块调节。电梯轿厢上的舱门提供了另一种通行方式。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core engine for the R-7 Semyorka and its derivatives, including the Sputnik, Luna, Voskhod, Vostok, Soyuz, and Molniya launch vehicles. It differs from the booster engine series (RD-107) with a lower chamber pressure, thrust, and a wider vernier layout. It powers the R-7 family core through a very long (roughly) five minute burn that starts on the pad alongside the boosters. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: R-7“谢苗尔卡”及其衍生型号（包括卫星号、月球号、上升号、东方号、联盟号与闪电号运载火箭）的芯级发动机。它与助推发动机系列（RD-107）的区别在于燃烧室压力与推力较低、游动发动机布局更分散。它在发射台上与助推器一同点火，以约五分钟的长时间工作推动 R-7 家族芯级。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The core for the Large General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用模块化服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core for the Large Modular Multi Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型模块化多用途服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core for the Medium General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型通用模块化服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core for the Medium Modular Multi Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型模块化多用途服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core for the Small General Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the towwr. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用模块化服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The core for the Titan III and IV Modular Service Tower, containing the base and a 10m tower section. Attach additional tower sections to the top of the tower. The tower base can be turned off to allow stacking of additional core sections. The front structure can be toggled on or off. Available in 8 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 泰坦III与IV模块化服务塔的核心组件，包含基座与一段10米塔节。附加塔节可拼接到塔顶。塔基可以关闭，以便叠放多个核心段。前部结构可开启或关闭。提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The crew (middle) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It ataches to the top of the core section. Has two crew access height variants plus optional extra core levels on top. Includes an adjustable integrated floor to align with the SLC6 crew arm and the orbiter. The crew arm attaces to the node on the front. A node on the side is for attaching the SLC-6 Shuttle Intertank Structure. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: SLC-6 航天飞机塔的乘员（中）段。它附着在核心段顶部。有两种乘员通行高度变体，并可在顶部加装额外的核心层。含可调的一体化地板，用于与 SLC-6 乘员臂和轨道器对齐。乘员臂安装在前侧的节点上。侧面的节点用于安装 SLC-6 航天飞机级间结构。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The drogue parachute pack is meant to slow down the Apollo spacecraft at a high altitude in preparation for the deployment of the main parachute pack. Attach this to the front node before placing the Forward Heat Shield. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 减速伞包用于在高空为 Apollo 飞船减速，为主伞包的展开做准备。请先把它装到前端节点上，再安装前部隔热罩。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The dual-mode active-cooling RAPIER hypersonic engine which burns Methane. SFC 2.0 lb/lbf/hr, O/F in rocket mode 2.8 to 1. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: 这款双模式主动冷却的 RAPIER 高超声速发动机燃烧甲烷。比油耗 2.0 lb/lbf/hr，火箭模式下氧燃比 2.8:1。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The engine mount for the Apollo SM contains mounting points for the Apollo SPS, HGA, and other accessories. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo SM 的发动机座，设有 Apollo SPS、HGA 及其他附件的安装点。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The explosive bolt interstage connector placed between the ascent and the descent modules of the Apollo Lunar Module. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 装在 Apollo 登月舱上升段与下降段之间的爆炸螺栓级间连接件。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The final development version of the first stage solid rocket motor used on the Scout launch vehicles. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 侦察兵运载火箭第一级固体火箭发动机的最终发展型号。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The final version of the J-2 that flew on the Saturn, the 230k variant flew starting with Apollo 8, SA-208 and all subsequent flights. testedBurnTime=2500
zh: J-2 的最终型号，即 230k 变型，自阿波罗 8 号（SA-208）及其后所有飞行起使用。testedBurnTime=2500

en: The first American spacecraft. Carrying a single astronaut, it can be launched suborbital on a Redstone or into orbit on Atlas LV3B. Supports a crew of one for up to maximum 35 hours of active operations but it will require you to change the resources. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall. THIS PART DOESN'T ALLOW EVA!
zh: 美国的第一艘载人飞船。可搭载 1 名航天员，由 Redstone 发射做亚轨道飞行，或由 Atlas LV3B 发射入轨。可支持 1 名乘员最多 35 小时的主动运行，但需要你更换资源。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。 此部件不支持 EVA！

en: The first US "Mach 2" engine, the J79 saw extensive service, powering the B-58, F-4, A-5, and F-104. From Advanced Jet Engines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 美国第一台「2 马赫」发动机 J79 服役范围极广，驱动了 B-58、F-4、A-5 与 F-104。 来自 Advanced Jet Engines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The first ever operational ion thruster, the SPT-60 Hall Effect thruster was first used in 1971 on Soviet Meteor weather satellites. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 史上第一台投入实用的离子推力器 SPT-60 霍尔推力器于 1971 年首次用于苏联「流星」气象卫星。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: The first expander cycle engine developed in Russia. It was developed in collaboration with Pratt & Whitney as a high performance upper stage for Proton. It was heavily inspired by the RL10, and some of its design elements were integrated into the RL10. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 俄罗斯研制的第一台膨胀循环发动机。它与 Pratt & Whitney 合作研制，作为质子号的高性能上面级。它深受 RL10 启发，其部分设计要素又被整合进 RL10。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The first large gridded ion thruster, the NASA Solar Technology Application Readiness (NSTAR) was used on the Deep Space 1 and Dawn spacecraft to allow for extended operations in the asteroid belt. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 第一台大型栅格离子推力器 NSTAR（NASA 太阳能技术应用就绪计划）曾用于「深空一号」与「黎明」号探测器，使其能在小行星带中长期工作。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The first multi-chamber engine developed by Glushko. After Glushko's attempts to scale up existing engines for what would become the R-7 resulted in unresolvable combustion instability (RD-105/106), Glushko instead combined multiple chambers of his ED-140 engine into one to increase thrust. The result, the RD-200, proved successful and, although it never flew, its design formed the basis of the RD-107/108 and RD-214. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 格鲁什科研制的第一台多燃烧室发动机。格鲁什科曾试图把现有发动机放大到后来成为 R-7 的规模，但因燃烧不稳定问题无法解决（RD-105/106）而作罢，于是他改为把自家 ED-140 发动机的多个燃烧室组合在一起以提高推力。由此得到的 RD-200 获得成功，虽然从未飞行，但其设计奠定了 RD-107/108 与 RD-214 的基础。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The first satellite to orbit the Earth. From SXT mod
zh: 第一颗进入地球轨道的卫星。 来自 SXT mod

en: The first satellite to orbit the Earth. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 第一颗进入地球轨道的卫星。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The first stage engine for the R-9 ICBM. Derived from the RD-107/108 engines of the R-7, the RD-111 was intended to provide a much quicker reaction time than the R-7. Although still using cryogenic liquid oxygen, it could be fuelled and launched in under 20 minutes. This, combined with its high performance, meant it was the last cryogenic ICBM to leave service. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: R-9 洲际弹道导弹的第一级发动机。RD-111 由 R-7 的 RD-107/108 发动机衍生而来，旨在提供比 R-7 快得多的反应时间。虽然仍使用低温液氧，但它可在 20 分钟内完成加注并发射。再加上其高性能，使它成为最后退役的低温推进剂洲际弹道导弹。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The first stage of the Minuteman ICBM, used in various proposed NASA launch vehicles as a solid booster. Burn time 75 seconds. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 民兵洲际弹道导弹的第一级，曾被用作多种 NASA 提议运载器的固体助推器。燃烧时间 75 秒。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The first variant of the Sea Level Merlin engine from SpaceX. Diameter: [0.94 m]. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: SpaceX 海平面型 Merlin 发动机的第一个变型。直径：[0.94 m]。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The flip-up crew access walkway for the Mercury-Atlas Crew Elevator. It also has optional mounts for use with the Mini and Small General Crew Elevators. It attaches to one of the front center nodes on the elevator tower. Has 8 color options and three configurations of the capsule hatch interface plate. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 用于Mercury-Atlas乘员升降机的上翻式乘员通行走道。它还带有可选安装座，可配迷你与小型通用乘员升降机使用。该走道附着在升降机塔前部中央的某个节点上。有8种配色，太空舱舱门接口板有三种配置。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The forward heat shield for the Apollo Command Module. Attach this to the top of the CM after placing the Drogue and Main Parachutes. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 指令舱的前部隔热罩。请先装好减速伞与主伞，再把它装到 CM 顶部。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The gas chromatograph-mass spectrometer (GC-MS) is an analytical instrument used for identification of multiple different substances in a selected gas sample, capable of detecting even trace amounts of them. Ideal of analyzing the atmospheric composition of unknown environments. Mass spectrometry is an analytical technique that ionizes chemical species and sorts the ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio. Historically, these simple experiments were flown on interplanetary crafts including the Mars Viking Lander and Cassini. From RP-1 (Stock Model) mod
zh: 气相色谱—质谱联用仪（GC-MS）是一种分析仪器，用于在选定的气体样品中鉴定多种不同物质，甚至能检出痕量成分。它非常适合分析未知环境的大气组成。质谱分析是一种把化学物种电离、并按质荷比分离离子的分析技术。历史上，这类简单实验曾搭载于「海盗」号火星着陆器与「卡西尼」号等行星际探测器。 来自 RP-1 (Stock Model) mod

en: The heat shield for CST-100 "Starliner" command module. From ROCapsules mod
zh: CST-100“Starliner”指令舱的隔热罩。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The intertank access arm for the Shuttle Launcher's FSS Tower. It was used to allow pad technicians access to the External Tank's intertank and to attach the hydrogen vent arm. The arm attaches to the intertank access structure, on the node at the front and to the side, pointing towards the external tank. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的级间段通道臂。它用于让发射台技术人员接近外贮箱的级间段，并挂载氢气排放臂。该臂附着在级间段通道结构前侧偏旁的节点上，指向外贮箱。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The landing engine for Luna 15-24. The main gas generator engine was used for orbital manuevering and descent, and then switched over to a secondary pressure-fed engine for terminal descent. Use an action group to toggle between the main and secondary engines quickly to make landing easier. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 月球 15—24 号的着陆发动机。主燃气发生器发动机用于轨道机动与下降，随后切换为挤压式供应的备份发动机执行末段下降。可用动作组在主、备份发动机之间快速切换，让着陆更容易。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The large angled top section for the modular version of the Atlas V angled-style service mast. Attach to the highest core section. Eight color options are available. Use with the General Umbilicals and Swing Arms and the Small Umbilical. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Atlas V斜置式服务桅杆模块化版本的大型斜置顶段。拼接到最高的核心段上。提供8种配色。请搭配通用脐带、摆臂以及小型脐带使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The largest single-chamber engine ever built in the USSR, and the first full-flow staged combustion engine, the RD-270 was fueled by NTO and UDMH combined under some of the highest pressures ever encountered in an ignition chamber. Extensively tested to power the first and second stages of the UR-700, it was cancelled with the rest of the UR-700 project and never flew, despite efforts to convert it to kerosene for the N1. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: RD-270 是苏联造过的最大单燃烧室发动机，也是第一台全流量分级燃烧发动机，以四氧化二氮与偏二甲肼为推进剂，燃烧室压力是当时最高之列。为给 UR-700 第一、第二级提供动力，它经过大量试验，但最终随整个 UR-700 项目下马，从未飞行——尽管曾努力把它改为烧煤油以用于 N1。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The launch abort system of the CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft. Uses four RS-88 engines (hypergolic variant). From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CST-100“Starliner”飞船的发射中止系统。使用四台 RS-88 发动机（自燃推进剂型）。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The lower half of the Gemini-B adapter, with batteries and separation motors. Decoupler detaches the bottom node. Designed for the MOL program, it was tested uncrewed, but the program was cancelled before any manned launches. From ROCapsules mod Plume configured by RealPlume.
zh: Gemini-B 转接器的下半部分，装有电池与分离发动机。分离器可脱离底部节点。为 MOL 计划设计，曾进行无人试验，但该计划在任何载人发射之前就被取消。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流由 RealPlume 配置。

en: The main crew compartment for the Orion spacecraft. Secondary life support, reentry systems and personal cargo spaces are located there. The capsule houses four astronauts and can be used multiple times. This variant uses a silver coating for thermal protection. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Orion 飞船的主乘员舱。次级生保、再入系统与个人货物空间都设在这里。该座舱可容纳 4 名航天员，并可多次使用。此变体采用银色涂层进行热防护。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The main parachute pack of the Apollo Command Module. Attach this to the front node before placing the Forward Heat Shield. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 指令舱的主伞包。请先把它装到前端节点上，再安装前部隔热罩。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The major competitor with Kerbal Motion LLC in the "Round Wheels" market, LightYear Tire Company provides Piston Cup-rated rubber tires to the space center, at wholesale prices nonetheless. If you've ever smelled the sweet, sweet scent of burning rubber on the KSC tarmac, there's a good chance that it was from a LightYear tire. Their range of products includes multiple sizes of space-grade landing gear - shock absorbers and spotlights included at no additional cost, their brochure advertises. LightYear is currently locked in a struggle with C7 Aerospace as the conglomerate repeatedly attempts to acquire the company. LightYear is one of the few independent manufacturers left that hasn't been absorbed by the titan of the aerospace world.
zh: 作为坎巴拉运动有限公司在“圆轮”市场上的主要竞争对手，光年轮胎公司以批发价向航天中心供应“活塞杯”级橡胶轮胎。如果你曾在KSC的停机坪上闻到过橡胶烧灼那股甜美的气味，那多半来自一条光年轮胎。他们的产品线涵盖多种尺寸的航天级起落架——宣传册上写着：减震器与聚光灯不额外收费。光年目前正与C7航天陷入拉锯，这家巨头一再试图收购它。光年是少数尚未被这家航天巨头吞并的独立厂商之一。

en: The massive M-1 engine was the largest and most powerful hydrolox engine ever designed and individual components have been tested. It was generally designed as an upper stage engine, but first stage designs with expanding nozzles were also worked on. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 巨大的 M-1 发动机是有史以来设计过的最大的氢氧发动机，也是推力最大的，其各个部件都已单独试车。它一般按上面级发动机设计，但也曾研制过带可延伸喷管的第一级方案。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The massive Rocketdyne F-1 engine. One of the largest, most powerful rocket engines ever built. Ensure you enable roll capability or disable gimbal as required for your application. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall and SmokeScreen.
zh: 巨大的 Rocketdyne F-1 发动机，是有史以来最大、最强的火箭发动机之一。请按需启用滚转能力或关闭万向摆动。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall 与 SmokeScreen。

en: The most basic form of fuel tank. Conventional structure tanks consist of two parts, a support structure (also known as stringers) and a fuel tank. Earlier iterations also had a separate skin surrounding them, but later tanks moved the structure inside the fuel tanks, making the tanks integral to the vehicle structure. This makes them cheap and easy to produce. From ROTanks mod
zh: 最基础的贮箱形式。常规结构贮箱由两部分组成：承力结构（也称桁条）与燃料贮箱。早期方案外面还包有一层独立蒙皮，但后来的贮箱把结构移入贮箱内部，使贮箱成为飞行器结构的一部分。这使它们造价低、易于生产。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: The most basic form of fuel tank. Conventional structure tanks consist of two parts, a support structure (also known as stringers) and a fuel tank. Earlier iterations also had a separate skin surrounding them, but later tanks moved the structure inside the fuel tanks, making the tanks integral to the vehicle structure. This makes them cheap and easy to produce. From RealFuels mod
zh: 最基础的燃料罐形式。常规结构罐由两部分组成：支撑结构（也称桁条）和燃料箱体本身。早期型号外面还有一层独立蒙皮，后来的罐体把结构移到了燃料箱内部，使罐体成为飞行器结构的一部分。这使其造价低廉、易于生产。 来自 RealFuels mod

en: The multi-height core section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower. Attach the tower core sections to the top of the base. There are 4 height options for the core section. Umbilical attach nodes can be toggled between the Titan II Tower and General types. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔模块化版本的多高度核心段。塔架核心段可拼接到基座顶部。核心段有4种高度选项。脐带附着节点可在Titan II塔型与通用型之间切换。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The new NASA Docking System. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 新的 NASA 对接系统。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: The optional tower pedestal for the Saturn Launch Stand, upon which the service tower was mounted. It attaches to one of the nodes around the Saturn Launch Stand. It is not a launch clamp, so it only has a fixed height. There is a working ladder on the front side. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星发射支架的可选塔基座，服务塔原本就装在它上面。它附着在土星发射支架周围的某个节点上。它不是发射夹具，因此只有固定高度。前侧装有一部可用的梯子。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The parachute pack for the CST-100 "Starliner" command module. From ROCapsules mod
zh: CST-100“Starliner”指令舱的降落伞包。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The power plant of the Redstone missile. Originally designed for ethanol/LOX it was later adapted to use Hydyne/LOX for 6% more performance in Jupiter-C / Juno I. When adapted for crewed use under Mercury, the A-7 was used with the original ethalox mixture, accepting slightly lower performance for the lack of toxicity. TVC was provided by carbon thrust vanes and additional attitude control was provided by actuating fins in the guidance section. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Redstone 导弹的动力装置。最初按乙醇/液氧设计，后来改用 Hydyne/液氧，使 Jupiter-C 与 Juno I 的性能提高 6%。在 Mercury 计划下改装为载人使用时，A-7 又改回原来的醇氧混合，以接受略低的性能来换取无毒。推力矢量控制由石墨推力舵提供，额外的姿态控制则通过驱动制导段内的舵面实现。 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The primary High Gain Antenna of the Apollo Spacecraft. Attach to the node on the Service Module Engine Mount. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Apollo 飞船的主高增益天线。安装在服务舱发动机座上的节点。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The primary parachute for the Orion spacecraft. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Orion 飞船的主降落伞。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: The rear compartment of the Dynasoar glider, containing the fuel cells, batteries, avionics, and a very cramped crew passthrough. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: DynaSoar 滑翔机的后部舱室，内装燃料电池、电池、航电设备，以及一条非常狭窄的乘员穿行通道。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The service module for the CST-100 "Starliner" spacecraft. Solar Panels degrade, affecting the power output over time. Check this effect in the PAW. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: CST-100“Starliner”飞船的服务舱。太阳能板会发生衰减，随时间推移影响输出功率。 可在 PAW 中查看该效果。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The service module of the Orion spacecraft contains fuel and oxidizer for the main propulsion system, life support, electrical batteries and everything else needed for extended orbital operations. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: Orion 飞船的服务舱内装有主推进系统所需的燃料与氧化剂、生保设备、蓄电池，以及长期在轨作业所需的其余一切。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: The top (upper) section for the SLC6 Shuttle tower. It attaches to the top of the crew section. Has 3 height variants, though the default height matches the IRL tower.
