The mast base has 6 height variants, with 4x matching the IRL one. The LOX Vent Arm attaches to the node in the top front, while the mast attaches to the node on top of the square-sided mast base. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: SLC-6 航天飞机塔的顶部（上）段。它附着在乘员段顶部。有 3 种高度变体，其中默认高度与现实中该塔一致。桅杆底座有 6 种高度变体，其中 4 种与现实一致。液氧排放臂安装在顶部前侧的节点上，桅杆则安装在方形侧板桅杆底座顶部的节点上。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Large General Crew Elevator tower. The railings and an antenna mast can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用乘员升降机塔的顶板。栏杆与天线桅杆可分别开关。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Large General Modular Service Tower. The railings and an optional antenna mast can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 大型通用模块化服务塔的顶板。栏杆与可选的天线桅杆可开启或关闭。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Medium General Modular Service Tower. The railings and an optional antenna mast can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 中型通用模块化服务塔的顶板。栏杆与可选的天线桅杆可开启或关闭。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Small General Crew Elevator tower. There are two styles of the plate, a full-size one and a U-shaped one. The railings and an antenna mast (different for each style of plate) can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用乘员升降机塔的顶板。顶板有两种样式：整块式与U形。栏杆与天线桅杆（两种顶板样式各不相同）可分别开关。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Small General Modular Service Tower. The railings and an optional antenna mast can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 小型通用模块化服务塔的顶板。栏杆与可选的天线桅杆可开启或关闭。 From Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the Titan III and IV Modular Service Tower. The railings and an optional structural details can be toggled on or off. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 泰坦III与IV模块化服务塔的顶板。栏杆与可选的结构细节均可开启或关闭。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top plate for the modular version of the Delta II-style service tower. Attach the to the top of a tower section. The top has two switchable styles of mast, or it can be turned off. There is also a toggleable detail. Eight color options for the railings and detail are available. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 德尔塔2号式服务塔模块化版本的顶板。可拼接到塔架节段顶部。顶板有两种可切换的桅杆样式，也可关闭。另有一处可开关的细节。栏杆与细节提供8种配色。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top section for the modular version of the Titan II GLV Service Tower. Attach to the top node of a core section. Umbilical attach node can be toggled between the Titan II Tower and General types. There is also an attach node on top of the umbilical mount rail for the Titan II Tower Mast. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: Titan II GLV服务塔模块化版本的顶段。拼接到核心段的顶部节点上。脐带附着节点可在Titan II塔型与通用型之间切换。脐带安装导轨顶端另有一个节点，供Titan II塔桅杆使用。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top section of the Saturn tower, with two color options: default red and alternate gray. An optional roof railing can be turned on if the hammerhead crane is not attached. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 土星塔架的顶部段，提供两种配色：默认红色与备选灰色。若未安装锤头吊车，可开启可选的顶部栏杆。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The top section of the Shuttle Launcher's FSS tower, with two color options: default gray and alternate black and white. A node for attaching the LOX Vent Arm (beanie cap) is located on mount rail on the front; the rail can also be turned off. There are also optional side panels, with each side separately toggleable. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射架 FSS 塔的顶部段，提供两种配色：默认灰色与备选黑白。用于安装液氧排放臂（“小圆帽”）的节点位于前侧的安装导轨上，该导轨也可关闭。另有可选的侧板，每侧可单独开关。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: The uprated 225k variant was flown starting with SA-501 Saturn V. testedBurnTime=2500
zh: 增推至 225k 的变型自 SA-501 土星 V 起飞行。testedBurnTime=2500

en: The world's first closed-cycle engine. The S1.5400 was used as the final stage for the R-7's Molniya configuration to launch communication satellites and interplanetary probes. Unlike prior upper stages, it was restartable (apogee kicks are needed for Molniya orbits). It was given the industry designation 11D33. The 11D33M brought upgrades and was the basis for the RD-58 with higher performance still (designated 11D58). The RD-58 was used on many Russian launchers, including N1 and Buran and is still in use on Proton and Zenit. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 世界上第一台闭式循环发动机。S1.5400 曾作为 R-7 闪电号构型的末级，用于发射通信卫星与行星际探测器。与以往的上面级不同，它可以多次启动（闪电号轨道需要远地点点火）。其行业型号为 11D33。11D33M 带来了升级，并成为性能更高的 RD-58 的基础（型号 11D58）。RD-58 曾用于包括 N1 与暴风雪号在内的许多俄罗斯运载器，至今仍用在质子号与天顶号上。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: These small thrusters are for upper stage or medium probe orientation. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From Realism Overhaul mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这些小推力器用于上面级或中型探测器的姿态调整。 RCS 需要高压贮箱才能工作。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: These small thrusters are for upper stage or small probe orientation. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From Realism Overhaul mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这些小推力器用于上面级或小型探测器的姿态调整。 RCS 需要高压贮箱才能工作。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: These small thrusters are for upper stage or very small probe orientation. RCS requires High-Pressure tanks to function. From Realism Overhaul mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这些小推力器用于上面级或极小型探测器的姿态调整。 RCS 需要高压贮箱才能工作。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Third Generation Raptor-Engine with even greater simplification and even greater thrust, slightly heavier to include built in heatshielding. testedBurnTime=9000
zh: 第三代 Raptor 发动机，进一步简化、推力更大，为容纳内置隔热层而略重一些。testedBurnTime=9000

en: Third stage engine module of UR-500/Proton, consisting of a RD-0213 main engine and RD-0214 vernier. AKA 8D49 testedBurnTime=450
zh: UR-500/质子号的第三级发动机模块，由一台 RD-0213 主机与 RD-0214 游动发动机组成。又名 8D49。testedBurnTime=450

en: This 4-wheeled buggy can be attached to the side of the Apollo LM descent stage, allowing extended exploration on the surface of the Moon. <#ef7b06> AUTHOR'S NOTE: Due to its unstable nature, you should always quicksave and quickload before attempting to board the LRV. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这辆四轮小车可安装在 Apollo 登月舱下降段的侧面，以便在月球表面进行更长时间的探索。 <#ef7b06> 作者注：由于它本身不稳定，在尝试登上 LRV 之前务必先快速存档再快速读档。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This adjustable ramp intake works best between Mach 1.0 and Mach 3.0. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款可调斜板进气道在 1.0～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This blanket solar panel allows you to choose different shapes, resize the panel and select the level of solar panel. From ROSolar mod
zh: 这款毯式太阳能电池板可让您选择不同形状、调整板面尺寸，并选择太阳能电池板的等级。 来自 ROSolar mod

en: This capsule was designed for lightweight non-atmospheric landers, and seats two occupants. From Realism Overhaul mod
zh: 这款座舱为轻型非大气环境着陆器设计，可容纳两名乘员。 来自 Realism Overhaul mod

en: This config represents the RL-10A-4-1 and RL-10A-4-2 variants. Reworked turbopumps and improved performance for usage in a single & dual engine configuration on Atlas II & Atlas III & single engine configuration on Atlas V. testedBurnTime=4500
zh: 本构型对应 RL-10A-4-1 与 RL-10A-4-2 两个变体。重做涡轮泵并提升性能，用于宇宙神 II 与宇宙神 III 的单机与双机构型，以及宇宙神 V 的单机构型。testedBurnTime=4500

en: This decoupler is designed to sit between a capsule's heatshield, and the service module. It includes an umbilical to connect the capsule to the service module's systems. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这种分离器设计安装在座舱隔热罩与服务舱之间。它带有一条脐带，用于把座舱与服务舱各系统连通。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This diverterless supersonic intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 2.0. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款无隔道超声速进气道在 0～2.0 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This experiment is a modified and slightly enhanced version of the Far Ultraviolet Spectrometer. This experiment can be used to study measure emissions from celestial bodies, zodiacal light, solar atmosphere emissions, stellar emissions, and galactic emissions. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 该实验装置是远紫外光谱仪的改进与小幅增强版本。可用它来研究与测量天体、黄道光、太阳大气、恒星以及星系发出的辐射。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This folding solar panel allows you to choose different shapes, resize the panel and select the level of solar panel. From ROSolar mod
zh: 这款折叠式太阳能电池板可让您选择不同形状、调整板面尺寸，并选择太阳能电池板的等级。 来自 ROSolar mod

en: This heatshield can have its diameter and configuration changed to fit many different craft sizes and reentry profiles. From ROHeatshields mod
zh: 这种热防护罩可改变直径与外形，以适应多种飞行器尺寸与再入弹道。 来自 ROHeatshields mod

en: This hinged solar panel allows you to choose different shapes, resize the panel and select the level of solar panel. From ROSolar mod
zh: 这款铰接式太阳能电池板可让您选择不同形状、调整板面尺寸，并选择太阳能电池板的等级。 来自 ROSolar mod

en: This hollow structural adapter is designed to sit on top of the Gemini equipment section and house a quad of retro motors for reentry. Houses six translational control thrusters. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这种空心结构转接器设计安装在 Gemini 设备段顶部，内部容纳一组四台再入反推发动机。还装有六台平移控制推力器。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This hypersonic inflatable aerodynamic decelerator can have its diameter and configuration changed to fit many different craft sizes and reentry profiles. From ROHeatshields mod
zh: 这种高超声速充气气动减速器可改变直径与外形，以适应多种飞行器尺寸与再入弹道。 来自 ROHeatshields mod

en: This is a capsule containing biological samples (fruit flies, fungus, perhaps even a mouse or two). Only recovering the sample safely will give information about life's response to the given situation. From SXT mod
zh: 这是一个装有生物样本（果蝇、真菌，或许还有一两只小鼠）的舱体。只有把样本安全回收，才能获得生命在特定环境下如何反应的信息。 来自 SXT mod

en: This is a capsule containing biological samples (fruit flies, fungus, perhaps even a mouse or two). Only recovering the sample safely will give information about life's response to the given situation. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这是一个装有生物样本（果蝇、真菌，或许还有一两只小鼠）的舱体。只有把样本安全回收，才能获得生命在特定环境下如何反应的信息。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This is a procedural avionics unit. It can be customized for your specific needs. It contains an avionics control unit and a short range antenna. From Procedural Parts mod
zh: 这是一个程序化航电单元。 可按需定制。它包含一个航电控制单元和一根短程天线。来自 Procedural Parts 模组

en: This is a proposed high gain antenna for Gemini upgrades. It is meant to be mounted on the Gemini rendezvous and recovery section. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这是为 Gemini 升级方案提出的高增益天线。设计安装在 Gemini 的交会与回收段上。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This is an enlarged Gemini nose fairing to allow the installation of larger parachutes for Big Gemini. All rendezvous and docking equipment has been removed to save weight. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这是放大的 Gemini 头部整流罩，可安装 Big Gemini 所需的更大降落伞。为减重已拆除所有交会对接设备。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This is the SLC-6 Shuttle tower mast. It attaches to the node on the SLC-6 Tower Top Section's Mast Base. Has 2 color options. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这是 SLC-6 航天飞机塔的桅杆。它附着在 SLC-6 塔顶段桅杆底座上的节点上。有 2 种配色。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: This is the Shuttle FSS tower lightning mast that was first used for the AS-210 Saturn IB launch (ASTP Apollo), mounted on the hammerhead crane. The crane with the mast was also used for a time with the Space Shuttle's FSS tower, then the crane was removed and the mast mounted directly on the top of the tower. This mast has switchable mount styles: FSS Tower, Hammerhead Crane and a General Tower mount. It attaches to the top node on a tower top section or on the top of the Hammerhead Crane. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这是航天飞机 FSS 塔的避雷桅杆，最初用于 AS-210 土星 IB 发射（ASTP Apollo），安装在锤头吊车上。带桅杆的这套吊车也曾在一段时间内用于航天飞机的 FSS 塔，之后吊车被拆除，桅杆直接安装在塔顶。该桅杆可切换安装方式：FSS 塔、锤头吊车以及通用塔架安装。它附着在塔顶段顶部节点或锤头吊车的顶部。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: This is the base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. Includes manually-activated generators for electric charge and fuel resources. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这是土星活动发射器的基座。基座用排气孔开口顶部的5号尺寸节点，附着在火箭下部或芯级中央的自由节点上。塔架基座段则附着在发射器基座另一端的5号尺寸节点上。配有电梯供乘员从地面前往顶层甲板。为获得最佳效果，请把前支腿放在VAB地面大圆圈白色区域内。内置手动启动的发电机，可产出电力与燃料资源。基座的排气孔可配置为三种火箭尺寸：土星5号（6.4/5.625米）、SLS（5米）与土星1B（4.25/3.75米），并针对单芯级或三芯级火箭提供多种方形与矩形孔形。另有多套可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的土星5号尾部服务桅杆附着节点。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: This is the base for the Shuttle Launch Platform, and can be also used with an accurate SLS recreation. The base attaches to the shuttle's External Tank via the large node in the center, and requires a free attach node below the center of the shuttle's External Tank in order to be attached. The base attaches to the SLS via the large attach node on the deck in the area of the SSME exhaust hole. The Fixed Service Structure Tower (FSS) base attaches to the large node off to the side of the launch base. The SLS tower base attaches to the 3rd large node opposite the SSME hole. There are 3 deck variants for different kinds of shuttle stacks and a 4th variant for the SLS. SRB hold-downs are integrated into the base and are adjusted with the deploy limit sliders. The shuttle tail service masts attach on the sides of the square main engine exhaust hole, either with the two nodes or by surface attach. The whole base can be rotated via the switcher to keep the support legs in the right place. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 航天飞机发射平台底座，也可用于精确复刻 SLS。底座通过中心的大节点与航天飞机外贮箱相连，且需要外贮箱中心下方有一个空闲的附着节点才能安装。用于 SLS 时，底座通过甲板上 SSME 排气孔处的大附着节点相连。固定服务结构（FSS）塔基附着在发射底座侧面的大节点上。SLS 塔基则附着在与 SSME 排气孔相对的第三个大节点上。共有 3 种甲板变体，对应不同构型的航天飞机组合体，另有第 4 种用于 SLS 的变体。SRB 压紧装置集成在底座内，用展开限制滑块调节。航天飞机尾部服务桅杆附着在方形主发动机排气孔两侧，可用两个节点或表面附着方式安装。整个底座可通过切换器旋转，以使支撑腿处于正确位置。 来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: This is the drogue (accepting) part of the Apollo Docking System. It will only work with the Apollo Command Module Probe. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这是 Apollo 对接系统的锥套（承接）部件。只能与 Apollo 指令舱探杆配合使用。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This is the free-standing base for the Saturn Mobile Launcher. The base attaches to a free node in the center of a rocket's lower or core stage using the size 5 node at the top of the exhaust hole opening. The tower base section attaches to the size 5 node on the other end of the launcher base. Includes a built-in decoupler and an elevator for crew access from the ground to the top deck. For best results, put the front legs so that they are inside the white part of the big circle on the VAB floor. No launch clamps are necessary. Includes a manually-activated generator for electric charge. The base's exhaust hole can be configured for three sizes of rockets: Saturn V (6.4/5.625m), SLS (5m) and the Saturn IB (4.25/3.75m), with various square and rectangular shapes for either single-core or tri-core rockets. A variety of switchable hold-down arm support configurations are available, along with optional center-mount hold-down and Saturn V tail service mast attach nodes. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这是土星活动发射器的独立式基座。基座用排气孔开口顶部的5号尺寸节点，附着在火箭下部或芯级中央的自由节点上。塔架基座段则附着在发射器基座另一端的5号尺寸节点上。内置分离器，并配有电梯供乘员从地面前往顶层甲板。为获得最佳效果，请把前支腿放在VAB地面大圆圈白色区域内。无需发射夹具。内置一台手动启动的发电机，可产出电力。基座的排气孔可配置为三种火箭尺寸：土星5号（6.4/5.625米）、SLS（5米）与土星1B（4.25/3.75米），并针对单芯级或三芯级火箭提供多种方形与矩形孔形。另有多套可切换的压紧臂支撑配置，以及可选的中央安装压紧装置与土星5号尾部服务桅杆附着节点。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: This is the probe part of the Apollo Docking System. It will only work with the Apollo Docking Mechanism Drogue. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这是 Apollo 对接系统的探杆部件。只能与 Apollo 对接机构的锥套配合使用。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This is the stock docking port sized to the new NASA Docking System. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这是按新的 NASA 对接系统尺寸设计的原版对接端口。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This is the stock shielded docking port sized to the new NASA Docking System. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这是按新的 NASA 对接系统尺寸设计的原版带屏蔽对接端口。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This is the vacuum variant of the Merlin 1C engine used on the second stage of the Falcon 9 launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这是用于猎鹰 9 号运载火箭第二级的 Merlin 1C 发动机的真空型。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This is the vacuum variant of the Merlin 1D engine used on the second stage of the Falcon 9 launch vehicle. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这是用于猎鹰 9 号运载火箭第二级的 Merlin 1D 发动机的真空型。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This is used to decouple the Command Module from the Service Module prior to reentry. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 用于在再入前将指令舱与服务舱分离。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This large docking module is used to connect MOL segments to each other. It is capable of soft docking to line up the segments, before retracting and solidifying the connection. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这个大型对接舱用于把 MOL 各舱段互相连接。它可先软对接对准舱段，随后收拢并锁定连接。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This little solid motor is designed to be attached to the bottom of the Agena equipment rack to provide ullage thrust. Attach one pair 180 degrees apart for each burn that is necessary for the flight profile From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这台小型固体发动机设计安装在 Agena 设备架底部，用于提供沉底推力。按飞行剖面的需要，每次点火请成对安装、相隔 180 度 来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This metal tub attaches to the bottom of the Mercury heatshield, allowing retro solids to be mounted. Decoupling will release the straps to separate from the capsule for reentry. Note that this is purely a structural unit - no propulsion is included. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这个金属槽体安装在 Mercury 隔热罩底部，用于固定反推固体发动机。分离时会松开绑带，使其与座舱脱离以便再入。请注意这纯粹是结构部件——不含推进系统。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This model is based on the Phoenix Mars Lander. Featuring a pair of MR-107 Monopropellant Engines, six of these pairs were used as retro-propulsion for the final decent phase of the Phoenix Mars Lander. [Uses RCS Configuration] From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 本型号基于凤凰号火星着陆器。它配备一对 MR-107 单组元发动机；凤凰号在最终下降阶段用六对这样的发动机做反推。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This modular engine mount allows for many customizations. You can swap out models as well as change the diameter and length. From ROTanks mod
zh: 这款模块化发动机安装架支持多种定制。您可以更换模型，也可以改变直径与长度。 来自 ROTanks mod

en: This module uses an electric motor to spin its internal flywheels, producing torque, which allows for minor attitude adjustments without expending propellant. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 该舱段用一台电动机带动内部飞轮旋转产生力矩，可在不消耗推进剂的情况下做小幅姿态调整。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This module, designed for use on space stations, contains various planetary science and space science equipment designed for use in repeatable experiments. Space is included for one scientist to work in the module, but their sleeping quarters and life support supplies must be provided separately. From SXT mod
zh: 该舱段为空间站设计，装有多种行星科学与空间科学设备，用于可重复实验。舱内留有一名科学家的工作空间，但其睡眠区与生命保障补给需另行提供。 来自 SXT mod

en: This non-controllable module is designed for space stations and very large, long-range spacecraft. It can be stocked with ample consumables, and provides toilets, showers and living quarters for up to four crewmembers. There are no bunks in space, however – instead, sleeping bags are strapped to the internal walls of the module. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款不可控舱段为空间站与超大型远程航天器设计。它可储备充裕的消耗品，并提供厕所、淋浴与最多四名乘员的生活区。不过太空中没有床铺——睡袋被绑在舱段内壁上。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This nose cap for the Mercury capsule includes the drogue chute and the main antenna. It has an attach node for a destabilizing flap. The latter might not accomplish much but its theorized to help self orient a reentering craft and its nice to have. From ROCapsules mod
zh: Mercury 座舱的这个头锥罩包含减速伞与主天线。它带有一个安装节点，用于加装扰流片。后者大概起不了多大作用，但理论上有助于再入飞行器自行调整姿态，装上总没坏处。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This part contains four way RCS thrusters to help orient the Mercury capsule and the main parachute. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 此部件装有四向 RCS 推力器，用于帮助调整 Mercury 座舱与主降落伞的姿态。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This pitot intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 1.5. From SXT mod
zh: 这款皮托管进气道在 0～1.5 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 SXT mod

en: This pitot intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 1.5. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 这款皮托管进气道在 0～1.5 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: This pitot intake works best between Mach 0 and Mach 1.5. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款皮托管进气道在 0～1.5 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This platform is intended to be mounted on top of a LM Descent Stage. Includes extending ramps for deploying a rover to the lunar surface. Rover design or parts not included. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 该平台设计安装在 LM 下降段顶部。配有可伸出的坡道，用于把月球车部署到月面。不含月球车的设计或部件。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This recently developed cargo bay is as small and compact as they come, with just enough space to store a small probe or a few pieces of science equipment. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 这款新近研制的货舱小巧紧凑到极致，空间刚好能放下一个小型探测器或几件科学设备。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: This satellite bus is very large, but it comes with plenty of room for your Communications Satellite needs. Includes data storage for returning data to Earth. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 这款卫星平台体积很大，但为通信卫星提供了充裕的空间。内含用于把数据传回地球的数据存储。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: This section contains fuel and thrusters to provide Gemini 3 axis attitude control after detaching the adapter section. RCS O/F Ratio 1.25:1. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 该段装有燃料与推力器，用于在分离转接段后为 Gemini 提供三轴姿态控制。RCS 氧燃比 1.25:1。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. From SXT mod
zh: 这款激波锥进气道在 1.5～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 SXT mod

en: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款激波锥进气道在 1.5～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the English Electric Lightning. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 这款激波锥进气道在 1.5～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。它类似 English Electric Lightning 上使用的进气道。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the MiG-21. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 这款激波锥进气道在 1.5～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。它类似米格-21 上使用的进气道。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: This shock cone intake works best between Mach 1.5 and Mach 3.0. This one is similar to the intake used on the X-7. From Stock (RO Addition) mod
zh: 这款激波锥进气道在 1.5～3.0 马赫之间效果最佳。它类似 X-7 上使用的进气道。 来自 Stock (RO Addition) mod

en: This shroud protects the fragile exterior of the SM from the high speed airflow around the rocket during launch. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这层护罩用于保护 SM 脆弱的外表，免受发射时火箭周围高速气流的冲刷。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This small airbrake prevents the Mercury from stabilizing in a "nose-first" orientation during reentry. Attach to the offset node on the Mercury Antenna/Drogue Chute unit. Once in orbit, click the brakes action group to extend it for the rest of the mission. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这个小减速板可防止 Mercury 在再入时稳定在“头朝前”的姿态。安装在 Mercury 天线/减速伞组件的偏置节点上。进入轨道后，点击刹车动作组将其展开，此后整个任务期间保持展开。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This small docking port does not have a tube for personnel transfers; at best propellant can be routed through it, but its real purpose is to train crew in docking procedures. From Stock (RO Config) mod
zh: 这款小型对接端口没有供人员转移的通道；最多只能通过它输送推进剂，但它真正的用途是让乘员练习对接程序。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod

en: This small vernier nozzle gimbals the exhaust stream of a gas generator engine, adding roll control to your rocket. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这个小型的游动喷管可对燃气发生器发动机的排气流做万向偏转，为你的火箭增加滚转控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This solid rocket tower is designed to wrench the command pod up and away from a malfunctioning rocket. Use only in case of emergency. WARNING: Staging the LES will also decouple it from the bottom node, in order to dispose of it after launch. Map the engine to the ABORT action group for emergency use. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这座固体火箭塔架用于把指令舱从故障火箭上拉走。仅在紧急情况下使用。警告：分离 LES 时同时会使其与底部节点解耦，以便发射后将其抛弃。请把该发动机映射到 ABORT 动作组以备应急。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This special docking port is designed to capture the Gemini nose cone's docking mechanism. The simple mechanical connection won't allow you to transfer crew, but it will securely attach two vessels together, for berthing or travel. Electrical connections and a gauge cluster mounted just above the docking port allow the crew to control the vehicle they are docked too. From ROCapsules mod
zh: 这种专用对接端口用于捕获 Gemini 头锥上的对接机构。这种简单的机械连接无法转移乘员，但能把两艘飞船牢固连在一起，以便停泊或同行。对接端口正上方的电气接口与仪表组可让乘员控制被对接的那艘飞船。 来自 ROCapsules mod

en: This static solar panel allows you to choose different shapes, resize the panel and select the level of solar panel. From ROSolar mod
zh: 这款固定式太阳能电池板可让您选择不同形状、调整板面尺寸，并选择太阳能电池板的等级。 来自 ROSolar mod

en: This tiny solid rocket motor was originally used to push a Mercury away from its Atlas booster. We're sure you'll think of even more uses for it. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这台微型固体火箭发动机原本用于把 Mercury 从 Atlas 助推器上推开。我们相信你还能想出更多用法。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This tiny thruster is nevertheless more than sufficient to manuever the Gemini capsule around in low orbit. This part is configured as RCS. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这台微型推力器却足以在低轨道上机动 Gemini 座舱。此部件按 RCS 配置。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This tiny thruster is nevertheless more than sufficient to manuever the Gemini capsule around in low orbit. This part is configured as an engine. From ROCapsules mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这台微型推力器却足以在低轨道上机动 Gemini 座舱。此部件按发动机配置。 来自 ROCapsules mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This was an 4 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Knight sounding rocket. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的四燃烧室型，用于黑骑士探空火箭的第一级。Gamma 推力室按径向两两安装，每对装在一个单轴切向万向架上。同向运动提供滚转控制，差动运动提供俯仰控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This was an 8 chamber development of Gamma, used for the first stage of the Black Arrow satellite launch vehicle. Gamma thrust chambers were mounted in pairs radially, each pair on a one-axis tangential gimbal. Collective movement gave roll control while differential movement gave pitch control. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 这是 Gamma 的八燃烧室型，用于黑箭卫星运载火箭的第一级。Gamma 推力室按径向两两安装，每对装在一个单轴切向万向架上。同向运动提供滚转控制，差动运动提供俯仰控制。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This was developed for the NOMAD high energy upper stage, intended to replace Agena. The hydrazine/fluorine propellant mix showed impressive performance in testing, but concerns over the toxicity of fluorine lead to the project being cancelled after extensive work had already been done. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 本发动机为 NOMAD 高能上面级研制，意在取代 Agena。肼/氟推进剂组合在试验中表现出色，但对氟毒性的顾虑使该项目在已投入大量工作后被取消。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: This was the earliest variant of the J-2 that flew on the first 3 Saturn IB flights AS-201 to AS-203. testedBurnTime=2500
zh: 这是 J-2 最早的变型，曾在土星 IB 的前 3 次飞行 AS-201 至 AS-203 上使用。testedBurnTime=2500

en: Three of these tail service masts were located on the launcher base, connected to the lower part of the S-IC stage of the Saturn V, and were retracted at liftoff. These have to be placed separately, and attach to nodes right outside the flame hole, two on one side, and one on the other side. Rotate them 5 degrees to have them properly aligned with the S-IC. From Modular Launch Pad mod
zh: 这种尾部服务桅杆有三根装在发射器基座上，与土星5号S-IC级的底部相连，并在起飞时收回。它们需要单独安装，附着在火焰孔外侧紧邻的节点上，一侧两根、另一侧一根。把它们旋转5度即可与S-IC正确对齐。来自 Modular Launch Pad mod

en: Three-person inline crew hab section for Mk1 spaceplanes. Rated for LEO reentries. From Ven Stock Revamp mod
zh: 用于 Mk1 空天飞机的三座直列式乘员舱段。可用于低地球轨道再入。 来自 Ven Stock Revamp mod

en: Thruster for orbital maneuvers, similar to ones used in the Galileo probe. From Stock (RO Config) mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 用于轨道机动的推力器，与「伽利略」号探测器上使用的类似。 来自 Stock (RO Config) mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Tiny solid rocket motor developed for final velocity adjustment of the early Pioneer probes
zh: 为早期先驱者探测器的末速修正而研制的小型固体火箭发动机

en: Tiny solid rocket motor developed for final velocity adjustment of the early Pioneer probes. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 为早期先驱者探测器的末速修正而研制的小型固体火箭发动机。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Truss structural base for mounting side fairings and your payload. From Procedural Fairings mod
zh: 桁架结构底座，用于安装侧整流罩和载荷。 来自 Procedural Fairings mod

en: Truss structural base for mounting side fairings to support the stage above. From Procedural Fairings mod
zh: 桁架结构底座，用于安装侧整流罩以支撑上方级段。 来自 Procedural Fairings mod

en: Two RD-215 engines mounted together, fitted with thrust vanes to allow limited thrust vectoring, as used on the R-14. From ROEngines mod Plume and sound from Waterfall.
zh: 两台 RD-215 发动机并联安装，并装有推力舵面以实现有限的推力矢量控制，用于 R-14。来自 ROEngines mod 羽流与音效来自 Waterfall。

en: Two of these tail service masts are mounted on the Shuttle Launcher Base, one on each side of the orbiter's engine section. Use mirror symmetry to orient them properly so the umbilicals face towards the shuttle. The umbilicals have an animated retraction. The sparkers have to be started manually with an action group. From Modular Launch Pad mod
